programme.title: Maverick - The White Widow
programme.desc: A beautiful widow hires Bart Maverick to protect her from a mysterious killer, but Bart realizes the poison pen letters and threats are also aimed at him. Intrigue involving money and a dangerous scheme escalate while Bart uncovers the truth.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Sweet Sam
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Rock Springs. He meets Sam Pridemore, who stops a killer and becomes the town hero. He seems to be everyone's friend. But Cheyenne is suspicious, thinking he is planning to rob the bank of its gold.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Sheridan Story
programme.desc: At the end of the Civil War, General Sheridan and his staff arrive at the McCain Ranch. Trouble begins when ex-confederate soldier and hired hand Frank Blandon confronts the general, who shot and wounded him in the war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Retired Gun
programme.desc: Wes Carney, a famous gunfighter, and his new wife Clair move to North Fork. They open a store and settle down. However, three outlaws come to town to challenge him. Carney refuses and they ransack his store, forcing him to put his gunbelt back on.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: When a former Army officer accidentally kills a woman's young son, he offers to escort the grieving mother through dangerous Indian territory on the way to lay the boy to rest at the family homestead.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Test of Courage
programme.desc: A frustrated Army post commander court-martials Cheyenne for cowardice after he abandons a herd of needed Army horses. The commander wants answers and orders Cheyenne to take them to a desolate cavalry base used during enemy strikes.

programme.title: Easy Mark
programme.desc: Bart Maverick impersonates a wealthy railroad heir, Cornelius Van Rensselear Jr., to gain access into a crucial shareholders' meeting in St. Louis. However, Bart is soon the target of rivals who plan to sabotage the meeting.

programme.title: The Saddle Warmer
programme.desc: A former medical student (David Hartman) drifting west feels responsible for a broken leg suffered by Trampas and offers to take the ranch hand's place until he recovers; guests Ralph Bellamy, the Irish Rovers.

programme.title: Fox, Hound & the Widow McCloud
programme.desc: A convict (Victor Jory) on the run from a bounty hunter (Troy Donahue) seeks help from onetime cellmate Trampas; guest Jean Inness.

programme.title: Ride to Misadventure
programme.desc: The Virginian teams with a bounty hunter (Joseph Campanella) to find the gang responsible for robbing gold and cattle vaccine from the Medicine Bow stage; guest Katherine Justice.

programme.title: Price of Love
programme.desc: A young cowboy (Peter Duel) tries to repay past kindnesses by using a gun to settle a land dispute with a neighbor (James Gregory); guest Skip Homeier.

programme.title: Image of an Outlaw
programme.desc: An innocent ranch hand is mistaken for a wanted criminal (Don Stroud in a dual role), and later sees advantages in assuming the fugitive's identity; guest Sandy Kenyon.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Clay's old friend (Anne Baxter) and her Army-officer husband (Hugh Beaumont) cut a visit short after Indians kill a soldier; guest Tim McIntire.

programme.title: Vision of Blindness
programme.desc: An ex-convict (John Saxon) seeking to take revenge on Trampas for his brother's death finds Elizabeth, left blinded and helpless after a stagecoach accident; guests Ben Johnson, the Irish Rovers.

programme.title: The Mustangers
programme.desc: An aging bronco buster (James Edwards) who wants to send his son (Chuck Daniel) to school in Texas turns to a horse thief (Don Knight) to get the necessary money; guest Grace Lee Whitney.

programme.title: Death Wait
programme.desc: A vengeful father (Harold J. Stone) and his gunslinger son (Murray MacLeod) don't believe David killed another son in self-defense; guests Conlan Carter, Sheila Larkin.

programme.title: The Land Dreamer
programme.desc: A foreclosed farmer (James Olson) becomes the target of a lynch mob after killing an unscrupulous investor (Don Francks); guests Cloris Leachman, Ford Rainey, John Daniels.

programme.title: Big Tiny
programme.desc: David poses as the fiancé of a young woman with a persistent suitor, then discovers her admirer is a giant.

programme.title: Crime Wave in Buffalo Springs
programme.desc: Yvonne De Carlo and the Irish Rovers head the list of guest stars in the first comedy ever presented on the Virginian.

programme.title: Halfway Back From Hell
programme.desc: Trampas helps prison probationers succeed with an Arizona ranch despite local opposition.

programme.title: Long Ride Home
programme.desc: A roving cowboy attempts to recoup money from a con man, while his sidekick begins to prefer ranch life.

programme.title: The Power Seekers
programme.desc: Clay discovers politics' unsavory side when he runs against an ambitious opponent (Andrew Prine) for the territorial legislature; guests Barry Sullivan, Dana Elcar, John McLiam.

programme.title: No War for the Warrior
programme.desc: Jim's life is endangered after an Indian (Charles Robinson) running from authorities hides out with the Shiloh wranglers on a cattle drive; guests Henry Jones, Charles Aidman.

programme.title: A Love to Remember
programme.desc: A Boston journalist tracking her family's killer finds articles that belonged to her spouse.

programme.title: A Touch of Hands
programme.desc: Trampas agrees to marry a childhood friend, coming back from finishing school, despite her father's wishes.

programme.title: The Runaway
programme.desc: A boy (Johnnie Whitaker) fleeing a reform-school operator (Peter Whitney) shelters at Shiloh Ranch while the Virginian and Trampas try to find his father (Guy Stockwell).

programme.title: The Bugler
programme.desc: After being whipped, an Army private (Michael Burns) deserts the post commanded by his father (Morgan Woodward) and is found unconscious and injured on Shiloh property; guest Alan Hale.

programme.title: A Woman of Stone
programme.desc: A long-time captive (Bethel Leslie) of an Indian tribe returns to the husband (Charles Drake) who deserted her during a raid, only to find her desire for revenge could destroy her daughter's wedding.

programme.title: A King's Ransom
programme.desc: An Australian couple visits Medicine Bow with plans to kidnap and ransom Clay.

programme.title: A Flash of Darkness
programme.desc: Blinded after a fall, the Virginian strays to the home of a horse thief and his two sons, fired earlier from Shiloh.

programme.title: Journey to Scathelock
programme.desc: Jim heads to Canada on the trail of a saloon girl (Anne Helm) and her con-man boyfriend (Burr De Benning) who disappeared from Shiloh with $4,000; guests Frank Campanella, Lawrence Dane.

programme.title: The Family Man
programme.desc: Jim delivers the baby of a woman (Darleen Carr) whose fugitive husband has run out on her, then cares for her and her property in addition to his responsibilities at the ranch.

programme.title: A Time of Terror
programme.desc: A family (Shelly Novak, Phillip Alford, Pamela Murphy) takes over Shiloh at gunpoint, then lures the Graingers' friend (Joseph Cotten), a Congressional candidate, to the ranch for revenge.

programme.title: Black Jade
programme.desc: Trampas joins forces with his quarry when an outlaw captures them in a ghost town.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Gregg Palmer) waylays Trampas then takes him to a town where he is mistakenly identified as the killer of a beloved local doctor; guests Dennis Cooney, Beverlee McKinsey.

programme.title: You Can Lead a Horse to Water
programme.desc: A stagecoach robbery interferes with the plans of a Southern belle (Elizabeth Hubbard) who is traveling to Clearwater to marry her childhood sweetheart (Anthony Eisley); guest Strother Martin.

programme.title: Rich Man, Poor Man
programme.desc: A poor farmer (Jack Elam) goes on a spree, spending the $10,000 reward for helping capture a bank robber; guest Patricia Morrow.

programme.title: Holocaust
programme.desc: An agent for Eastern interests begins to split the Cattlemen's Association, to grab land.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A newly married woman (Joan Crawford) faces many problems, including a murder charge, after her husband's (Michael Conrad) injury sets off a bid for power in his company; guest Warren Kemmerling.

programme.title: Sins of the Fathers
programme.desc: Clay awaits a showdown with a young gunslinger (Robert Lipton), hired as a Shiloh ranch hand, who blames his father's death 20 years earlier on Grainger and refuses to listen to any explanation.

programme.title: Home to Methuselah
programme.desc: An aging sheriff (John Anderson) arrives to visit old friend the Virginian, then invites him on a hunting trip that is actually a cover for tracking the last of a desperate band of bank robbers.

programme.title: Train of Darkness
programme.desc: A clan avenging the death of kin targets a former gunslinger and his bride.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: A wounded bank robber hides his loot and dies in a saloon girl's room, making her the target of his partner.

programme.title: Throw a Long Rope
programme.desc: The Virginian defends a poor homesteader (Jack Warden) against attacks by Judge Garth and an ex-Army officer (John Anderson); guest Ted Knight.

programme.title: The Executioners
programme.desc: The Virginian hires an itinerant cowboy (Hugh O'Brian), despite the sheriff's (John Larch) suspicions he may be looking for revenge.

programme.title: Woman From White Wing
programme.desc: Carrying a secret that could destroy Garth's relationship with his daughter, a former friend (Barry Sullivan) of the judge's arrives at Shiloh Ranch; guests Tom Reese, Parley Baer.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Northmen

programme.title: Brother's War
programme.desc: In the season 2 premiere, the battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg in a battle which pits brother against brother.

programme.title: Invasion
programme.desc: Four years have passed, but the people grow concerned that Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) has become complacent. So, the time has come for a new raid.

programme.title: Treachery
programme.desc: The brutal Wessex Viking raid is in full swing and King Ecbert (Linus Roache) finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye
programme.desc: A meeting between two great men may pave the way for future compromise as Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) and King Ecbert (Linus Roache) come face to face.

programme.title: Answers In Blood
programme.desc: Lagertha (Katheryn Winnick) and Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) unite once again and together fight to win Kattegat back from the iron fist of Jarl Borg.

programme.title: Unforgiven
programme.desc: King Horik returns to Kattegat with a surprising proposition for Ragnar. Lagertha runs into a less-than-enthusiastic homecoming from her new husband.

programme.title: Blood Eagle
programme.desc: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

programme.title: Boneless
programme.desc: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth, and Ragnar, King Horik and their new ally set sail for Wessex .

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Ragnar's (Travis Fimmel) Viking warriors march on to King Ecbert's (Linus Roache) villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: All Fall Down
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye break their legs skiing and are bedridden in the same room.

programme.title: A Night to Forget
programme.desc: Going to a store to return a duplicate wedding gift for the kids, the mothers are unknowingly getting locked in the store when it closes.

programme.title: The Newlyweds Move In
programme.desc: Checking out the place that the kids have rented, the mothers return their deposit and fix up the Hubbards' garage apartment. Their snooping gets them caught hiding in the kids' shower.

programme.title: The Career Girls
programme.desc: To cut down on their wives' meddling, Herb and Roger suggest that they get jobs. Realizing that all their "suggesting, recommending, and advising" might just be too much, they decide to try it.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Elizabeth Taylor?
programme.desc: When Roger and Herb admit that they would date Liz Taylor if given the chance, their wives console each other at the Buell house, leaving their befuddled husbands to go it alone next door.

programme.title: My Son, the Actor
programme.desc: Jerry decides to major in dramatic arts, giving everyone the showbiz bug. Suzie and all four parents tune up to help him audition for the school musical.

programme.title: How Do You Moonlight a Meatball?
programme.desc: When the kids in a financial bind, Eve and Kaye decide to help pay off Suzie's ring by selling Kaye's famous spaghetti and meatballs on the college campus.

programme.title: I Thought He'd Never Leave
programme.desc: A fugitive bank robber holds everyone at gunpoint at the Hubbards' home, whiling away the time playing gin rummy, and everyone hopes that Kaye's newly acquired karate skills will help.

programme.title: The Thursday Man
programme.desc: For a school project, Cissy wants to write a story about Mr French. She starts following him and finds out what he does every Thursday.

programme.title: Think Deep
programme.desc: Cissy develops an infatuation with her school teacher who teaches philosophy and spouts big ideals that everyone should follow. Bill finds a way to show that the teacher is just a regular man.

programme.title: Hard Hat Jody
programme.desc: Jody talks about having a job with a man who builds buildings. Uncle Bill thinks he is making it up. Bill later meets the man and realizes it is the person he has been trying to meet for a project.

programme.title: That Was the Dinner That Wasn't
programme.desc: Cissy's school is having a mother / daughter dinner. This makes Cissy miss her mother more.

programme.title: All Around the Town
programme.desc: Due to a miscommunication of who would watch Buffy and Jody, the twins find themselves all alone in New York City.

programme.title: One for the Little Boy
programme.desc: Giles French leaves town for a month, so his brother Niles comes to help with the Davis'. Jody is tired of always being around the girls and having to do the things they want to do.

programme.title: Fancy Free
programme.desc: Jody & Buffy are excited to be moved to Upper First Grade at school, but it means more homework. They do not know how to do the math problems nor read some of the new books.

programme.title: A Helping Hand
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody have problems with a building project for school. Bill is hosting a large dinner party, and French has to hire an assistant to help serve the food.

programme.title: Once in Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Bill has to babysit Buffy and Jody and tells friends that he is stuck with the kids. Buffy overhears this, and the twins start to decide if they should stay with Bill or move to their aunt's place.

programme.title: Ballerina Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy gets upset when she does not get the role of The Big Bad Wolf in her ballet recital.

programme.title: The Mother Tongue
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody's new friend at school has them doing things differently. When Marilyn visits, Bill and French learn she speaks only Mandarin, and the kids communicate through child-speak.

programme.title: Everybody Needs Somebody
programme.desc: French congratulates a friend on his wedding, and makes the comment about how wonderful it will be to have a wife and home. Buffy overhears this and tells Jody they need to find French a wife.

programme.title: The Way It Was
programme.desc: Uncle Bill and French look forward to a week of quiet when the children are at camps during a school break. After a few days, Bill and French realize they have grown used to the noise and chaos.

programme.title: All Nephews Are Created Equal
programme.desc: French's nephew David visits French at the Davis' home. David surprises French by announcing he is going into dentistry instead of being a gentleman's gentleman.

programme.title: The Prize
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody enter a cereal contest, hoping to win a boat. But their prize is a lamb. When it arrives at the apartment, they do not understand why a lamb cannot live in an apartment.

programme.title: What Did You Do in the West, Uncle?
programme.desc: Bill takes a week of vacation and plans activities. The Rodeo is in town and Bill's friend Gabe is one of the cowboys. Bill invites Gabe to stay with them and the twins want to do everything with him.

programme.title: The Award
programme.desc: Bill thinks the twins take advantage of him and French because they give in to their every wish. Bill says to deny the twins sometimes so they do not get spoiled.

programme.title: The Butler Method
programme.desc: A friend of Bill's is an actor who wants to shadow Mr. French in preparation for a movie role. Meanwhile, Cissy has trouble finding someone to ask to the Girls Tag Day Dance.

programme.title: Birds, Bees and Buffy
programme.desc: When a neighboring family has a baby, the children start to ask questions about where babies come from. Uncle Bill has to explain.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: Buffy is in love with Jody's friend, but he has eyes for Cissy.

programme.title: Go Home, Mr. French
programme.desc: Mr. French encounters an old friend at the park. Lorna, the nanny for a Duke & Duchess, is visiting in the states. When they are ready to return to England, Mr. French considers returning with her.

programme.title: Arthur, the Invisible Bear
programme.desc: Jody makes up an invisible friend, but it is a large bear.

programme.title: The Other Cheek
programme.desc: A young girl likes Jody, and shows her affection in the only way children know how - she picks on him and hits him.

programme.title: The Candy Striper
programme.desc: Bill thinks he will have a relaxing day, but then Jody wants help, Buffy needs to go to a Brownie meeting, and Cissy wants him to talk to the hospital staff about her being a candy striper.

programme.title: Fat, Fat, the Water Rat
programme.desc: Buffy goes to dance class but finds her teacher is not there. While waiting to be picked up, she meets some kids playing a game and joins them.

programme.title: The Toy Box
programme.desc: Bill falls over one of the twin's toys, and realizes they constantly have toys out which makes the place messy. Bill tells the twins that any toy left out will be taken away from them.

programme.title: Take Me out of the Ballgame
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy try out for the stick-ball team that plays on their street. Only one of the twins has skill and is accepted on the team.

programme.title: You Like Buffy Better
programme.desc: The twins compete for Uncle Bill's undivided attention. Each seems to think he likes the other twin better.

programme.title: Freddie
programme.desc: Bill wants to take Freddie out to dinner, but also has to go to the twins open house at school. Bill takes Freddie to the school, and she just loves it. She starts to think she wants to have kids.

programme.title: Our Friend Stanley
programme.desc: A new family moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live. Stanley is a child with a physical disability that hinders his walking. Buffy and Jody try to be friends with him at school.

programme.title: Somebody Upstairs
programme.desc: Someone new moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live, and it is a Broadway star. Buffy and Jody can't keep their eyes off her.

programme.title: Star Dust
programme.desc: Bill goes to a party where there are famous people. He meets Carol Haven, a movie star. She takes an interest in Bill and they start dating. He considers proposing marriage.

programme.title: Once in Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Bill has to babysit Buffy and Jody and tells friends that he is stuck with the kids. Buffy overhears this, and the twins start to decide if they should stay with Bill or move to their aunt's place.

programme.title: Ballerina Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy gets upset when she does not get the role of The Big Bad Wolf in her ballet recital.

programme.title: The Great Bicycle Race
programme.desc: A physical-fitness kick has the Hubbards and Buells joining a cycling club, and they wind up lose in the desert.

programme.title: Through the Lurking Glass
programme.desc: Roger, wearing a Martian costume to test a scene from a script, is arrested. Everyone comes to the rescue: The mothers and kids in animal costumes, and Herb in his lodge outfit. What a mad masquerade.

programme.title: Divorce Mother-in-Law Style
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Suzie's wealthy ex-boyfriend causes an uproar, with the mothers talking up a divorce for the newlyweds, and the kids faking a divorce to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: The Not Cold Enough War
programme.desc: The Hubbards sell their old refrigerator to the Buells. When it breaks down, the Buells retaliate by launching a raid to steal the Hubbards' new one.

programme.title: You Challenge Me to a What?
programme.desc: A heated argument leads to Roger challenging Herb to a duel at dawn. While they practice with fencing foils, their wives conspire to stop the showdown.

programme.title: Everyone Wants to Be a Writer
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye team up to write a TV script, and wind up begging Roger for ideas, snapping at each other, and trying to retrieve their script, which they plagiarized, after Roger submits it for them.

programme.title: The Kids Move Out
programme.desc: When their mothers' interference becomes too much, the kids move out to a gloomy apartment, where the struggle and strain give them second thoughts.

programme.title: The Hombre Who Came to Dinner, Part 1
programme.desc: The Hubbards get an unexpected visit from a bullfighter Raphael Del Gado and his colorful entourage, whose late-night partying cause a spectacle in the suburbs.

programme.title: The Hombre Who Came to Dinner, Part 2
programme.desc: The Hubbards and Buells work up acts to go to Mexico to be on a variety show hosted by their matador friend. Desi sings "The Straw Hat Song" with Desi, Jr. on drums; Eve and Kaye sing "Turn Around."

programme.title: Don't Give up the Sloop
programme.desc: The Hubbards and the Buells battle as they both want, and then don't want, the boat they won on a telephone quiz show.

programme.title: Best of Breed
programme.desc: A dog follows Jody and Buffy home from school and they take it into the apartment. They hid the dog as long as they could until Mr. French finds the dog.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: Aunt Fran invites them and Uncle Bill to Terre Haute for a family reunion. Once there, she wants the kids to live with her. She tells them Uncle Bill does not have time for kids.

programme.title: A Man's Place
programme.desc: Mr. French considers opening a restaurant after his date starts questioning his life as a gentleman's gentleman.

programme.title: The Great Kow-Tow
programme.desc: Bill entertains friends who are Japanese. The twins are interested by their culture. At the Japanese New Year celebration, the twins meet the grandfather and they tell him how fascinating he is.

programme.title: The Fish Watchers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill is working extra hours and the twins miss spending time with him. A co-worker suggests buying a fish tank and using that as a way to promote togetherness.

programme.title: The Day Nothing Happened
programme.desc: Bill is looking forward to a vacation, and Cissy is looking forward to her date with someone new. But the weather turns bad, and there is a blizzard. Everyone is kept at home.

programme.title: A House in the Country
programme.desc: Bill thinks living in the city is not good for the children, and considers moving to the country.

programme.title: A Matter of Tonsils
programme.desc: When Buffy has an operation to remove her tonsils, Jody complains of a sore throat, too. Uncle Bill and French think he's simply looking for attention until the doctor looks at them.

programme.title: A Member of the Family
programme.desc: Cissy is taking an art class and has been drawing caricature images of the family members, but not for Mr. French. He is hurt, however, Cissy has his picture and wants to surprise him with it.

programme.title: His and Hers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill & Mr. French attend Buffy & Jody's open night at school to view their latest art and work. At school, Bill meets another single parent with two young children and one teenager.

programme.title: The New Cissy
programme.desc: Cissy thinks the boys do not like her because there is something wrong with her, so Uncle Bill pays to have different people coach her in dress, makeup, talking, walking, and more.

programme.title: The Family Outing
programme.desc: Uncle Bill decides a weekend camping trip would be a great way for everyone to spend time together. Only two people enjoy the trip.

programme.title: Mr. French's Holiday
programme.desc: Mr. French takes a two-week vacation to the west with the others staying home. When Bill is called away to South America for work, the children end up flying out west to be with Mr. French.

programme.title: The Beasley Story
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy accidentally pull off the arm of Mrs. Beasley and it is a traumatic event.

programme.title: The Baby Sitters
programme.desc: Cissy agrees to babysit. Cissy gets a chance to go a concert, so she has a friend take her place. She gets sick, so her mother watches the kids, who then calls her husband...

programme.title: Family Portrait
programme.desc: Bill returns home from a business trip and finds that Cissy's hair style is different, Buffy has a new tooth, and he does not know who Jody's best friend is. Bill decides to become a full-time dad.

programme.title: The Latch Key Kid
programme.desc: Buffy wants more independence. Jody is allowed to go to some places on his own, but Buffy is not allowed the same privilege.

programme.title: By a Whisker
programme.desc: Jody wants to a club with the big boys, but they tell him he is too young. To prove he is old enough, they tell him he has to cut of some of Mr. French's whiskers and bring it to them.

programme.title: A Waltz from Vienna
programme.desc: A teenager from a royal family wants to marry Cissy, and she wants to marry him. She thinks she is a grown up who can make her own decisions, but Uncle Bill knows she just wants something different.

programme.title: Your Friend, Jody
programme.desc: A friend of Bill's confides that he is worried about his son growing up in a home with mostly females. That makes Bill wonder about Jody not having enough time with boys. Bill sends him off to camp.

programme.title: The Substitute Teacher
programme.desc: Jody and Buff's school teacher is out for a few days, and there is a substitute teacher. Jody develops a crush on her.

programme.title: Oliver
programme.desc: Uncle Bill allows Buffy & Jody to have a friend stay over for a few days while the parents are out of town. But then Uncle Bill finds out the friend is a dog, and pets are not allowed in the building.

programme.title: Christmas Came a Little Early
programme.desc: Buffy makes friends with a girl in the building, and finds out the girl may not live too much longer. Buffy asks Uncle Bill to have a Christmas holiday because Eve might not be alive in December.

programme.title: The Unsound of Music
programme.desc: Buffy's class is practicing to perform in a singing program, but Buffy's voice is terrible. Uncle Bill hires a singing coach to help her.

programme.title: Albertine
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy make friends with a new girl at school whose father seems to always be out of town. Jody and Buffy find out the girl's father has really left the family and may never return.

programme.title: A Matter of Choice
programme.desc: Uncle Bill feels that Buffy and Jody would benefit from listening to fairy tales than watching war-based programs on TV, but the fairy tales end up giving them nightmares.

programme.title: Ciao, Uncle Bill
programme.desc: While on a job in Rome, Bill falls in love with a much younger woman whom he plans to marry, until learning that she has no desire to share his life with Cissy, Buffy, and Jody.

programme.title: A Nanny for All Seasons
programme.desc: After Mr. French is ribbed by his gentlemen peers about also being a nanny, he resigns himself to return to his role as a gentlemen's gentleman and starts to shun the children.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Bill breaks his leg skiing and Buffy, Jody, and Cissy give up their free time to take care of him. Bill's girlfriend also wants to help him, but he realizes the children care much more than she does.

programme.title: To Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy is delighted to go with Uncle Bill to Puerto Rico because she gets to have his full attention. However, Bill meets a former girlfriend and it seems like he may divide his time between the two.

programme.title: A Family Group
programme.desc: Cissy is excited to have her friend over, who she envies for her glamorous lifestyle, until her friend reveals that her parents are separated and all she wants is a loving family like Cissy has.

programme.title: A Lesson for Grown-Ups
programme.desc: The kids overhear Bill talking about one of his bridge's collapsing. He goes to the construction site to help. The kids think they are going to lose all their money to help pay for the bridge.

programme.title: The Mother Tongue
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody's new friend at school has them doing things differently. When Marilyn visits, Bill and French learn she speaks only Mandarin, and the kids communicate through child-speak.

programme.title: Everybody Needs Somebody
programme.desc: French congratulates a friend on his wedding, and makes the comment about how wonderful it will be to have a wife and home. Buffy overhears this and tells Jody they need to find French a wife.

programme.title: I'd Tell You I Love You but We're Not Speaking
programme.desc: When all channels of communication break down between the Hubbards and Buells, a family-style group therapy session is conducted by Jerry's psychology professor.

programme.title: Herb's Little Helpers
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye turn Herb's office into a model of inefficiency when they take over for his sick secretary.

programme.title: Bye, Bye, Blackmailer
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye try diplomacy and artful deception to prevent a blow-up over Herb's $100 loan to Roger, which is due and which Roger can't repay.

programme.title: The Wig Story
programme.desc: Kaye borrows a blonde wig from Eve, and Roger's romantic reaction succeeds only in depressing Kaye, who's convinced that he now prefers blondes.

programme.title: It's Only Money
programme.desc: Tired of Roger's skinflint ways, Herb plots to play golf and gin rummy for money, but Herb finds himself in the financial hole when Roger's luck turns for the better.

programme.title: I Haven't Got a Secret
programme.desc: Kaye gets a game of charades under way to let everyone in on a secret that she isn't allowed to divulge: Roger's scripts are being considered for a TV series.

programme.title: Jerry's Night out with the Boys
programme.desc: The men side with Jerry's decision to play poker with the guys, so the women plan an all-girl night out for Suzie.

programme.title: The Long, Long Weekend
programme.desc: The Hubbards, Buells, and newlyweds each have secret plans for a weekend away from each other. But it backfires: They all head for the same mountain cabin, where snowstorm traps them together.

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
programme.desc: Thanks to Kaye's overactive imagination, Eve suspects a rekindled romance between Herb and his old flame, who has come to visit.

programme.title: How Not to Manage a Rock Group
programme.desc: Jerry convinces his folks to put up $500 for a hippie rock group to make a demo recording. They scare off the band with talk of crew cuts, tuxedos, and old songs.

programme.title: Oh, to Be in England
programme.desc: Bill gets a job in England which seems like it might last a year. Everyone plans to move, but then it seems like Bill won't be able to go.

programme.title: A Matter of Privacy
programme.desc: The twins start using a tape recorder to record conversations other people have in private.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 1
programme.desc: Uncle Bill takes everyone on vacation to Spain. As they start the great vacation, Mr French and the twins get separated. Bill and Cissy join Mr. French in the search for Buffy and Jody.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 2
programme.desc: Bill, Cissy and Mr. French continue to search for Buffy and Jody in Spain. Meanwhile, the twins are being cared for at a school house run by nuns.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 3
programme.desc: The twins are finally found and reunited with their family.

programme.title: A Diller, a Dollar
programme.desc: Buffy likes a boy at school. She starts purposely failing her classes so she does not seem smarter than him. The school thinks Buffy is able to skip a grade but she does not want to skip.

programme.title: The Young Man from Bolivia
programme.desc: Jody has been exchanging letters with a pen-pal from Bolivia. Finally, the boy gets a chance to visit Jody in New York. When he arrives, everyone is more interested in him than Jody.

programme.title: Speak for Yourself, Mr. French
programme.desc: Mr. French has a new admirer. She is an attractive young secretary, and she is determined to spend time with Mr. French. He starts falling for her, but soon realizes her ultimate goal is Bill.

programme.title: The Flip Side
programme.desc: Cissy falls for a popular musician who writes songs about her. Love-struck Cissy decides to surprise him by going to the concert. She is the one surprised when he starts singing to another woman.

programme.title: The Matter of Dignity
programme.desc: Mr. French is accused of sending questionable letters to a young woman. He and Bill take a stint as a detective to find the source.

programme.title: Flower Power
programme.desc: Cissy meets some flower children in the park and wants to be one of them. Uncle Bill is none too pleased.

programme.title: My Man, the Star
programme.desc: Movie producer Fred Wallace spots Mr. French in the park and thinks he would be perfect for his new production. French flatly declines. After some convincing by his family, he agrees to do it.

programme.title: No Uncle Is an Island
programme.desc: Mr. French, Cissy, Buffy and Jody decide to give Bill some time alone for the weekend. Unfortunately, while they are away, a barrage of neighbors stop by, disrupting Bill's relaxation, peace and quiet.

programme.title: The Wings of an Angel
programme.desc: A former friend of Bill's visits, asking for a favor. Harv has just gotten out of prison and needs a job. The twins are afraid of him , and Cissy thinks she can help him adjust.

programme.title: Uncle Prince Charming
programme.desc: One of Cissy's friends has a crush on Uncle Bill, and he cannot shake her from this feeling.

programme.title: Cissy's Apartment
programme.desc: Cissy decides it is time to move out on her own, so she moves into an apartment with a friend. It seems like she hasn't left home when when her family constantly visits her.

programme.title: The Jody Affair
programme.desc: When playing at school, a ball thrown breaks a window and Jody is blamed. Jody denies doing it.

programme.title: With This Ring
programme.desc: Since most of Cissy's friends are getting engaged and married, Cissy decides it it is time for her and Gregg to be engaged, even if Gregg does not want it.

programme.title: What's Funny about a Broken Leg?

programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: Dirt Track Racing Mini-Honda!
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Lifted Lambo Mud Truck!

programme.title: '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!

programme.desc: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

programme.title: Drag Racing Model A!
programme.desc: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

programme.desc: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

programme.title: Monte Carlo Surprise!
programme.desc: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

programme.title: Pro Street Mirada Makeover!

programme.title: Funny Car Dirt Drags!
programme.desc: The guys transform a '73 Opel funny car into a dirt-roosting machine.

programme.title: Vette Kart vs. 700hp Truck!

programme.title: Waterless Boat Racing!
programme.desc: Newbern, Cotten, and Finnegan participate in an unusual race that requires their boat to survive the competitors' attacks on a dirt track.

programme.title: Motorhome vs. Firetruck!

Steven argues it's Tamira's lack of trust and inability to support his dreams of making it in the music industry is the main reason for their falling out. Can Judge Faith Jenkins provide this couple one last lifeline or will this relationship go to the dogs?

programme.title: Antonett Wilson vs. Miguel Thompson
programme.desc: Antonett says she's tired of Miguel bailing out on their relationship when things get tough. She says Miguel acts like he's single, pawns all their belongings, and constantly accusing her of cheating and claiming their two-year-old son isn't his child. Miguel says he has every right to demand a DNA test on Antonett's son. He claims he's constantly finding her talking to other men and even kissing other women. Will Judge Faith be able to get them to control their reckless love?

programme.title: Latosha "Tosha" Thomas vs. Ferdinand "Freddy" Thomas
programme.desc: Latosha "Tosha" wants Ferdinand "Freddy" to understand his addiction to porn and the turmoil it causes on their relationship. "Tosha" says it's "Freddy's" refusal to be intimate with her that has caused their marriage to fall apart. "Freddy" says he's tired of "Tosha's" excuses for stepping out with other men and needs her to understand what she did isn't okay. Can Judge Faith help mend these two broken hearts or is this relationship already lost?

programme.title: Ebony Strothers vs. Kenneth Walker
programme.desc: Ebony is fed up with Kenneth acting like a man who is single! Ebony says Kenneth is constantly blaming "work" for the reason he's not around and hanging out with other women. Kenneth says he's tired of constantly trying to prove his innocence and says their relationship would thrive if Ebony would stop snooping around. Can Judge Faith perform some magic and resolve this messy quarrel?

programme.title: Kayla Anderson vs. Antione Anderson
programme.desc: Kayla says Antione has failed to provide for their family and abandoned them multiple times. She's willing to give him a second chance but needs him to prove that he can be a reliable partner and financial provider to their family, and quit bailing out whenever another woman gives him attention. Antione says Kayla needs to be more patient and stop flying off the handle every time there's a disagreement between them. Can Judge Faith save this hurting marriage?

programme.title: April Walls vs. Keith Walls
programme.desc: April says she wants her husband, Keith, to come clean once and for all. She says he's never been honest about how he sees other women on the side. She also claims he's an alcoholic who's not financially responsible. Keith argues April not only nags about every little thing but also wants to lead the marriage and be the man in the relationship. He says if she would let him be the man in their marriage, they could live a much happier life.

programme.title: Mavia Clemon vs. Lenoris "Lee" Starks
programme.desc: Mavia says "Lee's" controlling ways are keeping them from being truly happy. She claims he refuses to let her buy her own clothes, constantly makes her feel inferior, and must always know where she's at. "Lee" says if Mavia wants this relationship to work, she needs to be more submissive. Can this over-controlled relationship be salvaged?

programme.title: Janeil Munoz vs. Rico Williams
programme.desc: Janeil says she's tired of being the breadwinner and the only one in her relationship to take commitment seriously. She says Rico is a lazy cheater, who needs to either step up or leave her alone once and for all. Rico says Janiel is a drama queen who's too easily influenced by outside voices and needs to stop listening to other people. Does Judge Faith have what it takes to save this couple or is this relationship doomed?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 1)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! She says her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside of their marriage and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but wants to save his marriage and needs Nicole to hear him out one last time. Is it possible for this marriage to be saved?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! She says her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside of their marriage and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but wants to save his marriage and needs Nicole to hear him out one last time. Is it possible for this marriage to be saved?

programme.title: Chnise Herron vs. Kelisha Amos
programme.desc: Chenise says she no longer knows the person she met 7 years ago. She says not only does she suspect Kelisha is cheating on her but believes she may be in another relationship after she introduced Chenise as her "roommate." Kelisha refutes it's Chenise, not her, who pretends to live as a single woman. Can Judge Faith provide this couple the strength they need to see through this dip, or is this the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Stacie Winchester vs. Keenan Deal
programme.desc: Stacie says she feels stuck in her relationship with Keenan who she describes as a narcissist, a liar, and a cheater. She wants him to start being faithful or lose her forever. Keenan says Stacie neglects him as a man, partner, and entrepreneur. He wants her to accept his line of work and start believing in him. Can Judge Faith Jenkins help them find some middle ground or before this relationship falls apart?

programme.title: Susan Taylor vs. John Cotugno
programme.desc: Susan says that for the last eight years, she's put up with John's poker addiction, their intimacy issues, and his financial irresponsibility! At 51 years old, she says she's no longer willing to wait for John to get his act together. John says he's tired of Susan's controlling behavior and he's here to finally stand up for himself. Is Judge Faith willing to bet on this couple or is it time to for them to fold and walk away?

programme.title: Bella Nicole Rose vs. Kenneth D. Golatt
programme.desc: Bella says she's had enough of Kenneth keeping her and their relationship a secret. She suspects Kenneth may even have another family. She wants the truth today...no matter what! Kenneth says Bella is too demanding and controlling over his life. Will Judge Faith give the guidance this shattered couple needs to move forward?

programme.title: Joseph Arnold vs. Tiffany Solomon
programme.desc: Joseph has one foot out the door unless Tiffany can curb her spending habits and partying lifestyle. Tiffany needs Joseph to understand if he doesn't want to have more kids with her then she will keep spending his money. She refuses to sit home all day and night without the promise of growing their family. Does Judge Faith have what it takes to help lead this couple down a happier path?

programme.title: Christina Smalls vs. George Artis
programme.desc: Christina says she's no longer interested in staying with George if he's going to continue to deal with other women and doesn't take the steps to level-up our life together. George wants Christina to admit to her drinking problem and have more trust in him. Will Judge Faith implore this relationship to be more committed to each other's needs or is it far too little, too late?

programme.title: Inia Withers vs. Nathaniel "Nate" Smith
programme.desc: Inia says her marriage is over and there's nothing "Nate" can say or do to change that. Inia says "Nate" is no longer interested in being intimate with her and suspects another woman may be the reason. "Nate" says Inia treats him like a child instead of her husband and he's had enough. Can Judge Faith Jenkins restore the lost passion and respect in this relationship?

programme.title: Marlayna Lester vs. Ronald Lester
programme.desc: Marlayna says her husband, Ronald, has betrayed her on multiple occasions and is now living with his "roommate" named Shatara. Ronald argues he's innocent and says Marlayna's jealousy and insecurity is the reason their marriage over. Can Judge Faith steer this fractured vessel of a marriage away from the rocks or is it too late?

programme.title: Dahlia Turnbull vs. Noah Healy
programme.desc: After discovering Noah's true nature and secret life, Dahlia says there's no turning back. Dahlia fears that for the last three years she's been in a committed relationship with a habitual liar and she's calling it quits. Noah says Dahlia allows her fears and suspicions to get in the way of their happiness. Can Judge Faith provide the support this relationship desperately needs?

programme.title: Michael Kelly vs. Chasity Williams
programme.desc: Michael says Chasity's angry outbursts and lack of trust has put a damper on their relationship. He says he's sick and tired of Chasity destroying their property and if she doesn't get help for her anger, he's out the door. Chasity says Michael is a liar and manipulator who tries to convince her that he's not cheating. Does Judge Faith have the right words of advice to help rekindle this hurting relationship?

programme.title: "Katie" Hagewood vs. Shawn Hagewood
programme.desc: Katie says she's done with Shawn being a mama's boy and needs him to move on from his plan of living in a bus! She says if Shawn doesn't set boundaries with his meddling mother, their marriage is over. Shawn says Katie is jealous of the relationship he has with his mother and wants her to just accept it. Can Judge Faith Jenkins drop some truth on this troubled marriage and help them avoid outside distractions?

programme.title: Lace Larrabee vs. Jarrod Harris
programme.desc: Lace says she's done with her husband's impulsive spending, constant complaining, and putting having kids on hold. Lace wants Jarrod to stop spending exuberant amounts of money without consulting her and understand how important it is for her to have a baby. Jarrod says Lace needs to stop getting so aggravated at the way he spends and start accepting that he's the man of the house. Can Judge Faith bridge the gap between these two or is the rift already too far wide?

programme.title: Carla Talley vs. Habib Talley
programme.desc: Carla says women frequently call in the middle of the night for husband Habib, saying he has traveled to stay with them for months at a time.

programme.title: "Mychael Jay" Arce vs. "Danny C" Carbone
programme.desc: "Mychael Jay" says his relationship with "Danny C" has hit rock bottom. He says "Danny C" refuses to help with rent or any other household bills, and even suspects he may be cheating on him. "Danny C" says "Mychael Jay" is nothing, but drama and he's had enough. Can Judge Faith filter through the finger pointing and accusations and get this relationship back on track?

programme.title: "Lela" Randle vs. Khalil Kearse
programme.desc: "Lela" says she's done with Khalil's gambling and anger issues and ready to call it quits. She needs him to step up to his responsibilities without giving her a fight every time. Khalil says Lela is controlling and does anything she wants without consulting him first. Though, Khalil says he's here to save his relationship and get "Lela" back. Can Judge Faith serve this couple with a cold dose of reality and wake them up before their relationship is lost?

programme.title: Jasmin Gardner vs. Travis Coleman
programme.desc: Jasmin says she wants to settle down and have kids but can't do that if Travis refuses to get his act together; he refutes that it's her cheating that has caused a major strain on relationship.

programme.title: Lasandra Raheem vs. "Raheem The Dream" (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lasandra says husband Raheem "The Dream," an Atlanta hip-hop legend, is destroying their marriage with his gambling and drinking, and bankrupting their record label; he says she is too controlling over his money, his record and his personal business.

programme.title: Lasandra Raheem vs. "Raheem The Dream" (Part 2)
programme.desc: Lasandra says husband Raheem "The Dream," an Atlanta hip-hop legend, is destroying their marriage with his gambling and drinking, and bankrupting their record label; he says she is too controlling over his money, his record and his personal business.

programme.title: Kristi Taylor vs. Ben Taylor
programme.desc: Kristi says multiple women have called the house looking for Ben at all hours of the night, and he stole her cherished cat, Mr. Pickles, in an act of revenge; he says she is a narcissistic drama queen who wants to destroy his livelihood.

programme.title: Erin Williams vs. Susan Johnson
programme.desc: Erin says she and her partner, Susan, have trust issues, communication issues, intimacy issues and an 11-year age difference that are tearing them apart; she is fed up with Susan's reckless behavior, while Susan says Erin treats her like a child.

programme.title: Macresha Preston vs. Sparkles Bolton
programme.desc: Macresha says she caught Sparkles talking to other people, only to turn around and accuse Macresha of being unfaithful; Sparkles says she has proof Macresha is having a long-distance relationship with a man.

programme.title: Mardrea Johnson vs. Laporcha Johnson
programme.desc: Mardrea says Laporcha has anger issues and shows no compassion toward her desire to have trans-male surgery; Laporcha says if Mardrea goes through with it, their marriage is over.

programme.title: Ryan Rivette vs. Amber Rivette
programme.desc: Ryan says he's had enough of Amber's headstrong attitude and reckless behavior; she says he lacks communication skills and causes arguments.

programme.title: Eddie Esparza vs. "Shari" Maull
programme.desc: Eddie says wife Shari refuses to give him sex, time or attention; she says his lack of communication, accountability and trust have caused major problems in their marriage.

programme.title: Raquel Brown vs. Julius Brown (Part 1)
programme.desc: Raquel says Julius is more like a roommate than a husband; he blames her for their falling out and says she cares more about her well-being than being a good wife.

programme.title: Raquel Brown vs. Julius Brown (Part 2)
programme.desc: Raquel says Julius is more like a roommate than a husband; he blames her for their falling out and says she cares more about her well-being than being a good wife.

programme.title: Natashia Washington vs. Phillip Washington
programme.desc: Natashia says her husband runs their house like a military base, installing cameras to watch her; Phillip says that, as a former Marine, it's his duty to run a tight ship in his home.

programme.title: Sarah Josenhans vs. Kenneth Lyas
programme.desc: Sarah says she's stuck in a relationship with a verbally abusive and financially controlling partner; Kenneth says she always runs away when he starts addressing their issues.

programme.title: Samantha Magarian vs. Darren Sullentrup
programme.desc: Samantha wants to end her five-year relationship with Darren, saying she's tired of his cheating ways; he says he gave up his dreams to support her, and she refuses to reciprocate any affection.

programme.title: Yvette Maddux vs. "Tony" Maddux
programme.desc: Yvette says her 30-year relationship with husband Anthony is hanging by a thread; she's sick of his angry fits and lack of affection; he refutes that she's the one who neglects him.

programme.title: Asha McDowell vs. Jermaine McDowell
programme.desc: Asha wants to divorce her cheating husband of 15 years unless he buys her a first-class ticket to Brazil; Jermaine says she is living in a fantasy world fueled by social media.

programme.title: Crystal Mindus vs. Amanda Bergman
programme.desc: Crystal says Amanda is an alcoholic freeloader who can't keep a job; Amanda says she has physical limitations and blames Crystal for her drinking, as she's the one buying her booze.

programme.title: Alma Rivera vs. Ronnie Mariani
programme.desc: Alma says she has no doubt that her husband, Ronnie, has been cheating on her with various women, including her close friends; he denies cheating and demands that she stop accusing him.

programme.title: Katurah Davis vs. Mikael Thomas
programme.desc: Katurah has reached her limit after five long years of putting up with Mikael's cheating and poor parenting; he says he does his best to make her happy, but it's never enough.

programme.title: Laura Carpenter vs. "Trace" Carpenter III
programme.desc: A woman says her husband has a substance abuse issue, and it's going to kill him; he claims to have put together a path to sobriety that works for him and needs her to accept it.

programme.title: Yogi Harris vs. "Ty" Gidron
programme.desc: Yolanda is over her husband's stalking and weight gain; Tyree says he just wants to be with her, and, as far as his weight is concerned, he's on a special diet of 4,000 calories a day.

programme.title: Wanda Jackson vs. "Tony" Jackson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Wanda says her sex life with her husband, Tony, has not been the same since she had her leg amputated. She says her husband has not been supportive and to make matters worse, her meddling live-in mother-in-law is always in his ear. Tony says his wife is using her disability as an excuse to be a victim and asserts his mother is not going anywhere. Can Judge Star Jones rekindle this dying flame? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Mimi Cruz vs. Keion Green
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Mimi says she's had enough of her much younger boyfriend, Keion, being a liar and a cheater. She wants to settle down and have children and she is tired of putting her life on hold for him. Keion says Mimi is insecure and overbearing and he's tired of her treating him like a child. Can Judge Star Jones get these two to see eye to eye? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Samantha Davis vs. Matthew Davis
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Samantha says she feels trapped in her marriage and is at her breaking point. She says Matthew is verbally abusive cheater who won't pay bills. Matthew says he loves Samantha but wants her to grow up and to be a good wife to him. Can Judge Star Jones set this marriage straight or is it time for it to come to an end? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Ashanti Koranteng vs. "Twan" Scott
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ashanti is done with Twan and his total disregard for her feelings. She says he's cheated on her numerous times and to add insult to injury, he had a baby with another woman knowing that Ashanti can no longer bear children. Twan says Ashanti refuses to forgive him for one mistake. He also says Ashanti is a main part of the problem ever since she put him on a sex schedule.

programme.title: Mark Cernese vs. Lindsay Conard
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Mark says his fiancèe, Lindsay, has been behaving strangely for the last six months after returning home from a business trip. After finding lingerie and mysterious text messages, Mark has been suspecting the real reason Lindsay is dragging her feet with their wedding planning. Lindsay denies cheating on Mark and says she just doesn't want a big wedding. Will Judge Star Jones be able to pull back the curtain and figure out what's really going on in this relationship?

programme.title: Robert Henderson vs. Monique Henderson
programme.desc: Robert says Monique shows him no affection and has gone on a sex strike. She says she loves Robert, but she is not there for his sexual gratification and needs him to try harder.

programme.title: Richard Reed vs. Lanisha Jones
programme.desc: Richard says Lanisha's drug addiction has caused him and his kids grief. She admits to doing drugs in the past but says she's been clean for a year. Richard's not buying it.

programme.title: Anne Steward vs. Staci Cobb
programme.desc: Anne says Staci is a bully who controls everything from her finances to how much she eats. Staci refutes Anne is a manipulator who uses the threat of breaking up to get her way.

programme.title: Trishon Jackson vs. Michael Conners
programme.desc: Trishon says her child's father, Michael, is verbally abusive and an unsupportive cheater. Michael says he is the sole provider in the household and demands loyalty in exchange.

programme.title: Charlie Freeman Jr. vs. Janelle Acevedo
programme.desc: Charlie says his high school sweetheart, Janelle, has turned into an insecure, jealous stalker. Janelle says Charlie caught him in very questionable situations, hence the mistrust.

programme.title: Kat Silva vs. Todd Pierce
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Kat says her fiancé, Todd, used to be the perfect partner, but now he refuses to work, drinks too much, and recently brought home some mysterious blonde hairs. She says this is the end of the line for her and Todd. Todd says he loves Kat and claims he's not cheating. He argues he's been working hard to contribute since his hours at work were cut. Can Judge Star Jones help pull this relationship from the muck? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Raymond Jackson vs. Pa'Shae Hawkins
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Raymond says that after three years with Pa'Shae, he realizes she's not ready for a relationship with him. He says she's cancelled their wedding twice and refuses to start a family with him, and he is tired of competing with the memory of her recently deceased ex. Pa'Shae says Raymond is immature, lazy, manipulative, and a liar. Can Star Jones give this hurting couple a burst of new hope or is it time to part ways? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Matthia Kelsey vs. Charles Kelsey
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Matthia says she's finally ready to let go of her 13-year marriage to her husband Charles and she has the divorce papers. She says Charles has no ambition, shows her no support, cheats on her, and cannot do even the most basic things for himself. Charles is desperate to save his marriage. He says he is willing to make a change and wants Matthia to let him move back into the home.

programme.title: Monica Johns vs. "Chino" Toribio
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Monica is tired of Chino's lies and empty promises. When they got together 4 years ago, he promised her marriage, a home, and a baby. Instead, she says he manipulated her into becoming a webcam girl, started controlling her money, and refuses to let go of his ex. Chino says everything he does is for Monica and denies any cheating allegations. Can Judge Star Jones help mend this broken relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Chiffona Thompson vs. "Orvalle" Williams II
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Chiffona says she's been financially supporting Timothy for the last 5 years. She says he promised her they would get married, but time is running out. She says if he doesn't propose today, she will kick him out and charge him for 5 years' worth of expenses. Timothy says Chiffona treats him like a child and even puts him on punishment when he makes mistakes. He argues she's a party animal who hasn't proven to him she's ready for a family.

programme.title: Ashley Williams vs. Joshua Davis
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ashley says her fiancé, Joshua, is an emotionally unavailable liar and a cheater. She wants to get married and have children, but feels Joshua is not putting in the same amount of effort and she's had enough. She also believes Joshua continuously hides her from his family. Joshua says Ashley's constant nagging and accusations are the real cause of the turmoil in their relationship. Can Star Jones put the brakes on this runaway train of a relationship?

programme.title: "Dawna" Harvey vs. "Wayne" Harvey
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Dawna says she has no doubt her husband, Wayne, has been cheating on her. She says she's seen text messages, tracked his locations, and found his live porn. Now she's ready to end their marriage on the day of their 8th wedding anniversary. Wayne says he's never cheated on his wife and all of her "evidence" is in her head. Can Judge Star Jones perform a miracle and get this marriage back on track or will it end in shambles?

programme.title: Amanda Rodriguez vs. Alonzo Gordon
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Amanda says her fiancé is a passive-aggressive narcissist who lives in a fantasy world and would rather waste money on scams to buy land on Mars than show her any affection or save money. Amanda says their relationship is dying because Alonso has massive control issues and his only concern in life is his own personal gratification. Alonso says he is a dreamer with big ideas and goals and never receives support at all from the mother of his child.

programme.title: Lizabet Comstock vs. Chris Comstock
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Lizabet says her marriage with Chris is crumbling because he has put his failed surfing career over her and their family. On top of that, it seems Chris has been ditching his wife to spend time with a hot new "surf babe." Chris denies cheating with his protégé. He further maintains his wife knew what she was getting into when she married a surfer. Is there still hope for this marriage or have the tides turned? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Cyn Wilson vs. Tyrone Wilson Jr.
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Cyn says the man she met is not the man she married. She says she unknowingly entered a marriage with a man suffering from drug addiction. She says if her husband can't get sober, she wants a divorce! Tyrone argues he's been sober for the last 3 months and needs his wife to trust him. He says his wife is his soulmate and a divorce would be devastating. Will Judge Jones be able to cast this marriage one last thread of hope?

programme.title: Ronneice Reedy vs. Aubrey Murphy
programme.desc: Ronneice says she's caught Aubrey shirtless in their home with three other women. Aubrey is sick of the constant accusations and says she should focus on doing "wife stuff."

programme.title: Lex Andrickson vs. Joseph Dale
programme.desc: Lex says Joseph is avoiding any intimacy with her but cheats with other women. Joseph says Lex needs to stop pressuring him to have a baby when it's not in the cards right now.

programme.title: Ashante Peeples-Hampton vs. Christopher Peeples-Hampton
programme.desc: Ashante says Christopher is a jealous husband who refuses to work, cheats, and even steals from her. Christopher says Ashante is a liar and has no desire to save their marriage.

programme.title: Azaina Smith vs. DMario Gray
programme.desc: Azaina says her fiancé has crossed the line with other women but refuses to show affection to her. DMario says Azaina is just insecure and argues she's no angel either!

programme.title: Viviane Koenig vs. Stuart Koenig
programme.desc: Viviane has been unhappily married for 50 years and she can't take another day of disrespect. Stuart argues Viviane is a spiteful nag who tries to control everything in his life.

programme.title: Tresha Joel vs. "Teejay" Joel
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Tresha says her 1-year marriage to Thomas is hanging by a thread. She says he has major anger problems, unconventional sexual fantasies, and lies to her all the time. Thomas says he and Tresha are not on the same page and she is to blame for many of their problems. Will Judge Jones be able to get these two on the same page? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Deidra Rodriguez vs. Jamar Pinkett
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Deidra says her fiancé and baby's father, Jamar, is an unreliable narcissist and a cheater who only shows up when it's convenient for him and she's sick of it. Jamar says he loves Deidra and is the same person he's always been. Can Star Jones clean up this mess of a relationship or is it too late? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Miriam Te'o vs. Anthony Bridges
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Miriam says Tony has been taking advantage of her for the last 4 years and she's ready to cut ties. He does not contribute financially, does not respect her culture, and worst of all, she just found out he's been swinging with other couples behind her back. Tony says he loves Miriam, but she needs to keep an open mind when it comes to their relationship. Can Judge Star fix this unraveling relationship or will these two only find true happiness elsewhere?

programme.title: Henry Bromin vs. Julia Saavedra
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, after 4 years, Henry is tired of Julia using her religion as an excuse not to have sex with him and he wants a change. Henry says Julia has been hiding behind her religion and refusing to allow their relationship to take its natural course. Julia says Henry needs to respect her religion or their relationship is over. Can Judge Star Jones get these two on the path of a healthier relationship or is it time to part ways?

programme.title: Jillian Allen vs. David Madwin
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Jillian says David has been gaslighting her for 3 years. From vacationing with his ex-girlfriends to spooning with other women, Jillian says she is tired of David's lack of boundaries and respect. David says Jillian is just insecure about his other relationships and she needs to loosen up. Can Judge Star Jones help bring some respect back into this hurting relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.
