programme.title: Equipo de grabación confiscado
programme.desc: Fernando le aclara a Simón que el empleado del restaurante fue despedido por chocar el automóvil; Omar le cuenta a Fernando que se reconcilió con Alicia; un cargamento es confiscado en la aduana por ser contrabando.

programme.title: Malos negocios
programme.desc: Alicia informa a Ariel lo que le dijo Marcia sobre los proveedores de Nueva York; Lety y Fernando inscriben ante el notario la deuda de Conceptos con Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: Embarazo confirmado
programme.desc: Martha recibe un cheque para comprarse un automóvil; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Alicia sí está embarazada; Ariel cuestiona a Marcia sobre el embarazo de Alicia.

programme.title: Grandes avances
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Fernando que Bella Life y la agencia de publicidad aceptaron que Conceptos se encargue de lanzar la campaña; las secretarias convencen a Martha de hacerse una liposucción.

programme.title: Embargo inminente
programme.desc: Omar le cuenta a Fernando sobre el abogado que le recomendaron para embargar Conceptos; Omar le da un cheque a Alicia para ayudarle con el embarazo; Paula María le promete a Jaimito conseguirle un mejor papá.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Las chicas del Club de las Feas sospechan que Alicia no está embarazada. El abogado de Filmo Imagen hace efectiva la demanda de embargo. Fernando tiene muchos remordimientos por la grave situación económica de Conceptos.

programme.title: Situación crítica
programme.desc: El esposo de Martha se decepciona porque ella decidió operarse. Los padres de Fernando llegan de viaje y le piden un informe acerca de la situación de la empresa. Simón intenta que incluyan a Jazmín en la coreografía de Bela Life.

programme.title: Embargo precautorio
programme.desc: Las del club escuchan a Alicia decir que se hizo unos análisis de sangre; Martha habla al laboratorio y, a nombre de Alicia, pide que hagan una prueba de embarazo y se la envíen.

programme.title: Abierto coqueteo
programme.desc: En el ensayo del comercial, Fátima le coquetea a Fernando y Marcia se lo reclama; Lety le pide discreción al licenciado Sánchez para levantar el embargo.

programme.title: Intriga y curiosidad
programme.desc: Luigi le niega a Fernando despedir a Fátima; Fernando se altera porque Alicia no llega; Marcia le reclama a Lety no tener efectivo para pagos; Martha atiende el teléfono de Lety y le dice frente a Fernando que le habló su novio Tomás.

programme.title: Preparativos para el lanzamiento
programme.desc: Fernando duda de la honestidad de Lety; las secretarias deciden hacer dieta en solidaridad con Martha, pero un mesero les revela que Martha está devorando todo; Fernando le encarga la oficina a Lety.

programme.title: Despido justificado
programme.desc: Fernando se entera de que Fátima se emborrachó y lo anda buscando; Fernando le cuenta a Marcia que Luigi despidió a Fátima y le pide a Jazmín que la sustituya.

programme.title: Acceso exclusivo
programme.desc: Omar convence a Fernando para dejar entrar a las del club a un importante evento; el guardia reconoce a Paco y lo deja entrar con Jaimito y Clarita; Marcia se molesta con Fernando por desautorizarla ante las del club.

programme.title: Decisiones importantes
programme.desc: Simón convence a Jazmín de cenar con él y le dice a Efrén que saldrá con las bailarinas; Paula María convence a Simón de irse con ella.

programme.title: Lectura de la suerte
programme.desc: Marcia nota la ausencia de Paula María quien llega a Conceptos oliendo a Simón y con la ropa del día anterior; Ariel le exige a Alicia renunciar a Conceptos.

programme.title: Inicia la conquista
programme.desc: Omar le sugiere a Fernando emborracharse para poder ver a Lety más bonita; Simón intenta conquistar a Paula María y ella les confiesa a las del club que no puede estar con él porque no tiene dinero.

programme.title: Sin embargo
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez le sugiere a Tomás seguir con el embargo a Conceptos, pero Tomás se niega.

programme.title: Sin liquidez
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar que Lety no quiere a Tomás. Tomás le cuenta a Lety todo lo que ha pasado con el licenciado Sánchez. Simón le pide a Paula María formalizar su relación, pero ella lo rechaza.

programme.title: Plan en marcha
programme.desc: Marcia le pide a Lola que le explique por qué las despidió Juanita y le ofrece un préstamo para pagar el celular de Jazmín. Tomás le da una carta a los niños para que se la entreguen a Alicia.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Omar ignora las insinuaciones de Alicia; Lety se molesta porque Omar invita a Fernando a salir con las modelos; Fernando le dice a Lety que no ama a Marcia y le pide que se den una oportunidad para descubrir lo que sienten.

programme.title: Engaño consumado
programme.desc: Omar se burla de Fernando por besar a Lety; Fernando le asegura que logró convencerla de que él está enamorado de ella, pero que ella no siente nada por él.

programme.title: Mentira sobre ruedas
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando que las del cuartel le dijeron a Alicia que Tomás era su novio; Ariel le ofrece a Alicia presentarle a un amigo para hacerse amantes y ella se ofende.

programme.title: Noche de fiesta
programme.desc: Las del cuartel aconsejan a Simón no insistir con Paula María; Omar evita a Alicia, quien le pide dinero prestado a Celso; Fernando deja plantada a Lety en un centro nocturno, dos hombres se le acercan y se alejan al verla sonreír.

programme.title: Engaño malvado
programme.desc: Lety y Fernando se besan en un antro y casi los descubre Paula María; Tomás se pone muy borracho; Fernando se siente confundido; Simón encuentra a Paula María con otro y le arma un escándalo.

programme.title: Sospechas
programme.desc: Martha le dice a Lety que Marcia sospecha que Fernando tiene una amante; Alicia le hace pensar a Marcia que Fernando le está mintiendo; Simón se hace el indiferente ante Paula María.

programme.title: Rival imaginado
programme.desc: Marcia piensa interrogar a Lety para descubrir quién es la amante de Fernando; Omar se burla de Fernando porque Lety no quiere nada con él y le dice que deberá conocer a su adversario.

programme.title: Defendiendo el honor
programme.desc: Alicia esconde las llaves del automóvil de Omar para ofrecerle el suyo, pero él la rechaza y sale con una modelo; Lety le ordena a Tomás quitar la fotografía de Alicia de la computadora.

programme.title: Cambio de imagen
programme.desc: Fernando despierta cuando Marcia le pide que reaccione; Marcia le dice que quien quiera apartarlo de ella tendrá que esforzarse mucho; Lety está decidida a dejar de ser Lety La Fea por Fernando.

programme.title: Última oportunidad
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lola y a Martha que no puede hacer nada por Paula María y reprende a Alicia por no ir a la recepción; Simón lleva a todos a ver como llora Paula María.

programme.title: Relación formal
programme.desc: Ricardo felicita a Conceptos por los comerciales y Luigi presenta su nuevo anuncio para Bella Life; Jazmín se preocupa porque Efrén no contesta el teléfono.

programme.title: Horrible look
programme.desc: Tomás finge ser un ejecutivo y le dice a Alicia que es el gerente de Filmo Imagen; Marcia y Alicia encuentran una fotografía de Patricia Manterola en bikini entre las cosas de Fernando.

programme.title: Totalmente enamorada
programme.desc: Adrianita cuestiona a Lola sobre su divorcio; Simón festeja a los niños; Luigi regaña a Jazmín por no hacer bien su trabajo; Efrén entra a Conceptos enyesado y con muletas.

programme.title: Intuición
programme.desc: Fernando intenta demostrarle a Marcia que no tiene ninguna amante; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que intuye que Marcia lo ama.

programme.title: Celebración cumpleañera
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando salir con Lety para festejar su cumpleaños; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que Lety lo quiere y lo respeta, de modo que él debe valorarla.

programme.title: Última esperanza
programme.desc: José reconoce a Eduardo y permite el acceso a las del cuartel; Eduardo le pide al mariachi que cante; Marcia regaña a Alicia por coquetearle a Tomás; Lola y Efrén discuten frente a la juez.

programme.title: Apuesta inútil
programme.desc: Irmita le dice a Jazmín que Lola y Efrén deberán repartirse los bienes; Alicia se empieza a portar muy amable con Eduardo cuando se entera de que tiene dinero, incluso, apuesta con Luigi que lo va a conquistar.

programme.title: Cena de cumpleaños
programme.desc: Marcia siente que Fernando pone muchos pretextos para no ir con ella y le pide a Alicia que lo siga; Lety les dice a las del cuartel que saldrá a festejar con Tomás y le confiesa a Eduardo que está enamorada de Tomás.

programme.title: Invitación a cenar
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le reclama a Tomás por la cuenta del celular y se niega a pagarla; Lety se ve obligada a invitar a Marcia al festejo, pero ella se niega.

programme.title: Conviviendo con la familia
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando van juntos a un bar y Alicia se disfraza para espiarlos; Tomás juega billar con Sánchez y Rosales.

programme.title: Cita frustrada
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.

programme.title: Después de la fiesta
programme.desc: Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.

programme.title: Noche de amor
programme.desc: Fernando lleva a Lety a un hotel y hacen el amor por primera vez. Fernando no ama a Lety, pero sabe que fue una noche muy especial.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Paula María le cuenta a Lety sobre su noche con Simón; Jazmín se enoja con Efrén porque no quiere pedir la mitad de la casa de Lola; Fernando intenta explicarle a Lety que no pasó nada entre él y Marcia en el departamento.

programme.title: Por el bien de la empresa
programme.desc: Jazmín se niega a salir con Efrén, acepta la invitación de Simón y apaga el celular; Lety se atraganta al escuchar a Lola decir que la cuestionó Marcia; Alicia cuelga el teléfono cuando Román la reconoce.

programme.title: Compromisos obligados
programme.desc: Alicia se niega a empeñar sus joyas y su automóvil. Fernando pone a Carolina, Marcia, Luigi y Omar al tanto de las nuevas contrataciones. Luigi menciona la boda entre Fernando y Marcia, de modo que Lety se pone triste.

programme.title: Hermano despechado
programme.desc: Efrén le dice a Jazmín que pedirá la mitad de la casa de Lola; Ariel amenaza a Fernando con pedir la disolución de la empresa si no se casa con Marcia.

programme.title: Continúa el plan de boda
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety y le pide que se queden juntos; Martha le confiesa a Paco que la liposucción no le sirvió de nada, pero él le asegura que la quiere así.

programme.title: Artista de visita
programme.desc: Lety se emociona al leer la tarjeta que Fernando le dejó; Simón lleva a Patricia Manterola a conocer al personal de Conceptos y Alicia le avisa a Marcia de inmediato.

programme.title: Evento en el museo de cera
programme.desc: Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.

programme.title: Escape del museo
programme.desc: Leticia y el Cuartel de las Feas asisten al museo de cera. Marcia y Alicia van para tratar de descubrir a Fernando con su amante y Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir de nuevo a Lety.

programme.title: Dulce despedida
programme.desc: Alicia le sugiere a Marcia buscar a Fernando; Omar le ofrece su departamento a Fernando para llevar a Lety; Paula María se molesta porque escucha a Simón decirle a Celso que saldrán con unas chicas.

programme.title: La apuesta
programme.desc: Román y sus amigos interceptan a Alicia y le reclaman por sus mentiras; Lety le recuerda a Fernando sobre la llegada de Miguel y la apuesta que hizo con Román.

programme.title: Prioridades
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que no quiere viajar con Fernando quien le confiesa a Omar que ya no quiere seguir engañando a Lety porque ella lo ama.

programme.title: Recocimiento merecido
programme.desc: Román le deja un recado por teléfono a Alicia; Fernando impide que Lety se vaya; Luigi ofende a las del cuartel, Cristina se molesta con él y lo obliga a que se las presente.

programme.title: Borrón y cuenta nueva
programme.desc: Fernando le da a Lety un regalo y una tarjeta donde le pide olvidar el pasado y volver a tener fe; Fernando y Marcia se despiden. Marcia invita a comer a Lety para sacarle información.

programme.title: Bolsa misteriosa
programme.desc: Simón se lleva a los niños y Efrén se lo reclama a Lola, pero ella le hace ver que Paco y Simón han sido mejores padres que él; Lety se niega a contarles a las del cuartel lo que habló con Marcia.

programme.title: Venganza cobrada
programme.desc: El chisme de que Fernando se peleó llega a oídos del cuartel. Los papás de Fernando le piden a Lety que arregle el regalo de bodas.

programme.title: La bolsa perdida
programme.desc: Omar urge a Fernando que encuentre la bolsa roja, pues si cae en manos equivocadas, se sabrá todo lo que han ocultado para salvar la empresa: Fernando le dice a Sara que la bolsa tiene muestras para laboratorio.

programme.title: Confusión total
programme.desc: Fernando confunde a Marcia con Lety por teléfono; Marcia le dice a Fernando que no lo quiere perder, Lety se convence de dejarlo ir.

programme.title: Falsas acusaciones
programme.desc: Alicia cuestiona a las del cuartel y culpa a Juanita de haber tomado la bolsa; Matilde intenta besar a Tomás durante la filmación, pero él le dice que se casará con Leticia.

programme.title: El Cuartel en acción
programme.desc: Luigi se va a Alemania para filmar el comercial de Sport Wing; Fernando le entrega a Lety un dibujo que le hizo; Lety habla por teléfono en clave con Teresita para explicarle su encargo.

programme.title: Los nuevos productores
programme.desc: Fernando deja su automóvil a media calle para ir tras Lety; las del cuartel se encargan de conseguir lo necesario para filmar el comercial; Raúl y Simón hacen la audición a las modelos.

programme.title: Cambio de giro
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo en Conceptos la audición de las modelos en traje de baño, y Alicia decide que ella quiere ser la modelo del comercial y hará todo para conseguirlo.

programme.title: Equipo eficiente
programme.desc: Efrén busca a Jazmín y Fernando le pide a Simón que le ayude a encontrarla; Paula María logra que Pilar Zacarías, la modelo a la que quería contratar Luigi, se presente en Conceptos.

programme.title: Todo casi listo
programme.desc: El cuartel de las feas trata de complacer los deseos de Pilar para la realización del comercial y Lety le dice que Fernando tiene una doble vida.

programme.title: Batalla de supermercado
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le cuelga a Matilde; Alicia y Pilar chocan sus carritos en el supermercado; Lety le cuenta a Fernando por qué nunca aprendió a cocinar y él acepta que tampoco sabe.

programme.title: Romance interrumpido
programme.desc: Julieta le aclara a Matilde que es la esposa de don Erasmo, ella se disculpa y sale en busca de Tomás; Fernando le dice a Lety que se siente muy bien con ella y después atiende una llamada de Marcia.

programme.title: Fuera de la oficina
programme.desc: Fernando le cuenta a Omar cómo le fue con Lety; Alicia se queja con Marcia porque Fernando no la deja filmar el comercial y conseguir el dinero que necesita para pagar su deuda.

programme.title: Filmación caótica
programme.desc: Pilar se niega a filmar una subida en un caballo, un guardia impide que Alicia entre al club; don Riquelme y su acompañante le enseñan a don Erasmo a jugar golf.

programme.title: Cambios de último minuto
programme.desc: Gerardo le dice a Fernando que habrá problemas con el color del vestuario de las modelos. Ricardo llega a la locación y presenta a Francisco Riquelme como el cliente del comercial.

programme.title: Plan de diva
programme.desc: Fernando, Ricardo y Gerardo siguen el plan dictado por Luigi; el señor Riquelme y su acompañante llegan al bar con don Erasmo; Alicia espía el cámper de Pilar y Tomás la espía a ella.

programme.title: Sabotaje exitoso
programme.desc: Don Erasmo regaña a Lety por dejar que la abracen y le pide a Fernando que le ayude a cuidarla, pues al parecer anda en malos pasos y Tomás está en el club.

programme.title: Confesiones
programme.desc: Pilar le cuenta a su amiga que Fernando aceptó ser Pavel, pero que se dio cuenta de que ya no lo quiere; Lety cuestiona a Fernando y Pilar le dice lo que le confesó.

programme.title: No más mentiras
programme.desc: Lety intenta que su padre entienda la farsa entre Sara y Fernando, por lo que debe decirle la verdad que le ocultó cuando entró a Conceptos; Fernando le cuenta a Julieta cómo se unió el cuartel para que saliera el comercial.

programme.title: Miedo a volar
programme.desc: Alicia entra a la oficina de Fernando, pero él la corre porque sabe que solo quiere obtener información; Ricardo le da instrucciones a Fernando para cuando estén en Alemania.

programme.title: Out of Control
programme.desc: JAL Flight 123's steering system stops working 12 minutes after takeoff, causing the plane to crash into the side of a mountain and kill 520 people in 1985.

programme.title: Suicide Attack
programme.desc: A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board.

programme.title: Bomb on Board
programme.desc: On December 11, 1994, a terrorist bomb explodes on Philippine Airlines Flight 434, yet only one passenger dies.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Kid in the Cockpit
programme.desc: A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people.

programme.title: Impact on the Rails
programme.desc: With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy.

programme.title: Express Samina
programme.desc: A Greek ferry, the Express Samina, is pushed off course by strong waves and crashes into a rock formation causing eighty passengers to lose their lives in the freezing water as they wait for rescue.

programme.title: Unstoppable Train
programme.desc: A freight train carrying an excess of cargo loses its brakes while descending a mountain causing it to gain speed and derail into a neighborhood killing several people.

programme.title: African Hijack
programme.desc: When three hijackers ordered an Ethiopian plane to fly to Australia, the pilot tricked them by flying south along the African coast, with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Desperate Escape
programme.desc: In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane.

programme.title: All Engines Failed
programme.desc: British Airways Flight 9 falls toward the ocean when all four engines mysteriously fail, and then restart.

programme.title: Fiery Landing
programme.desc: When fire erupted aboard Air Canada Flight 797, the pilot made an emergency landing; flames engulfed the plane when the doors opened, killing half of the passengers.

programme.title: Missed Approach
programme.desc: Korean Airlines Flight 801 overshoots a runway during the final approach for a night landing and crashes into a hillside on Aug. 6, 1997.

programme.title: Mystery Crashes
programme.desc: Mystery surrounds two 737 crashes until USAir Flight 427's near miss gives investigators the information to solve the case.

programme.title: Panic Over the Pacific
programme.desc: A stalled engine causes China Airlines Flight 006 to go into a deadly spin before crew members were able to regain control.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: A 1986 midair crash between Aeroméxico Flight 498 and Piper Archer N4891F near Los Angeles results in the creation of a collision-avoidance system.

programme.title: Inbound
programme.desc: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 others are killed in 1996 when their Air Force 737 crashes on a mountain in Croatia.

programme.title: Deadly Disorientation
programme.desc: Flash Airlines Flight 604 crashes into the Red Sea shortly after take-off, killing all 148 people on board.

programme.title: Unconscious Pilot
programme.desc: The worst crash in Greek aviation history occurs in 2005 when all 121 people on board Helios Airways Flight 522 lose consciousness.

programme.title: Invisible Killer
programme.desc: During a storm, a strong gale slams Delta Air Lines Flight 191 to the ground killing most people on board.

programme.title: Miracle Flight
programme.desc: A pilot heads for a decommissioned air force base, not knowing it is hosting a weekend family event, when the passenger jet he is flying unexpectedly runs out of fuel.

programme.title: Behind Closed Doors (American Airlines Flight 96 and Turkish Airlines Flight 981)
programme.desc: A design fault leads to an explosion on a DC-10 and two years later the same design fault causes another tragedy.

programme.title: Fanning the Flames (South African Airways Flight 295)
programme.desc: A complex recovery operation is launched to find out if a 747 which disappeared into the Indian Ocean was carrying illegal weapons.

programme.title: Dead Weight (Air Midwest Flight 5481)
programme.desc: Air Midwest Flight 5481 plane plummets to the ground just after take off killing all on board and injuring one on the ground.

programme.title: Southern Storm (Southern Airways Flight 242)
programme.desc: The pilots of Southern Airways Flight 242 must try to land on a Georgia highway after the engines die and the windshield shatters.

programme.title: Explosive Evidence
programme.desc: A bomb explodes on Air India Flight 182 en route from Canada to India causing it to disintegrate over the coast of Ireland.

programme.title: Mixed Signals (Birgenair Flight 301)
programme.desc: The conflicting alarms confuse pilots of Birgenair Flight 301 before it crashes into the ocean with no survivors.

programme.title: Miami Mystery
programme.desc: The pilots of Eastern Airline Flight 401 try to determine why both landing-gear lights do not function, distracting them.

programme.title: Phantom Strike (Gol Transportes Aéreos Flight 1907)
programme.desc: In September 2006, a new Embraer Legacy business jet collides with a Boeing 737 over the Amazon Rain Forest.

programme.title: Ripped Apart
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Fatal Flaw
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Who's Flying The Plane?
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Scratching the Surface (China Airlines Flight 611)
programme.desc: After taking off from Taiwan, a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar and crashes, killing 225 people.

programme.title: Explosive Device
programme.desc: The tragic circumstances surrounding the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 by terrorists.

programme.title: Silent Killer
programme.desc: In September 1989, Partnair Flight 394 crashed into the sea killing all 55 people on board.

programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: Saudi Airways and Kazakhstan Airlines jets hit each other at 14,000 feet sending both planes spiraling to the ground.

programme.title: Operation Babylift (C-5 Galaxy 68-0218 )
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War when over 250 children, who were being airlifted to safety on a US Air Force C5A Galaxy, died in an explosion.

programme.title: Falling Fast
programme.desc: Investigators discover a shocking mistake when pilots must ditch their plane in the Mediterranean, killing 14 of the 34 passengers.

programme.title: Flight 574: Lost (The Plane That Vanished, Adam Air Flight 574)
programme.desc: An Adam Air Boeing 737 crashes into the Makassar Strait killing 102 people on board; the pilots inadvertently disengaged the autopilot while trying to fix the inertial reference system, causing the plane to plunge to the water.

programme.title: Deep Freeze
programme.desc: A design flaw sends American Eagle Flight 41-84 smashing into a cornfield outside of Chicago, killing all 68 people on board.

programme.title: System Breakdown
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Panic on the Runway (British Airtours Flight 28M)
programme.desc: On August 22nd, 1985, 55 people died aboard British Airtours flight 28M when its engine caught fire as it accelerated.

programme.title: Alarming Silence
programme.desc: Northwest Airlines Flight 255 crashes shortly after takeoff in Detroit in 1987, proving to be one of the worst aviation disasters in U.S. history.

programme.title: Pilot vs. Plane (Air France Flight 296)
programme.desc: Air France Flight 296 fails to regain altitude after performing a flyby during an air show at Mulhouse-Habsheim Airport.

programme.title: Cleared for Disaster (USAir Flight 1493/Skywest Airlines Flight 5569)
programme.desc: An air traffic controller's mistake causes a Boeing 737 to land on a runway already occupied by another aircraft.

programme.title: Objetivo destruido
programme.desc: During the Cold War, Korean Air Lines Flight 007 is shot down by a fighter jet when it violates Soviet airspace.

programme.title: Cold Case (Air Ontario Flight 1363)
programme.desc: Two similar plane crashes in Ontario and New York prompt an investigation which determines that the source of the crashes was due to a design flaw on the wings of the planes, both Fokker F28s.

programme.title: Doomed to Fail
programme.desc: An Air Inter flight crashes into the Vosges Mountains while attempting to land, killing most of the 96 passengers.

programme.title: Miami Mystery
programme.desc: Chalk's Ocean Airways flight 101 crashes just after take-off from Watson Island in Miami on Dec. 19, 2005, killing 20 people.

programme.title: Cockpit Failure
programme.desc: Minutes before they're scheduled to land in Zurich, the pilots of a routine passenger flight can't find the runway; they abort and power up the engines in order to climb, but they are too late.

programme.title: The Heathrow Enigma
programme.desc: British Airways' flight number 38 suffers from double engine failure and crashes near Heathrow in 2008.

programme.title: Scandinavian Airlines 751
programme.desc: Two minutes after Scandinavian Airlines Flight 751 leaves Stockholm in 1991, smoke filters through the cabin and both engines fail, one erupting into flames.

programme.title: Dead Tired
programme.desc: In the worst U.S. crash in more than seven years, a Buffalo-bound flight stalls and plummets into a suburban home in 2009.

programme.title: Ditching on the Hudson
programme.desc: Shortly after take-off, US Airways Flight 1549 encounters a bird strike and lands on the Hudson River.

programme.title: Mid-Air Landing
programme.desc: Investigation into the 2009 crash of Turkish Airlines Flight 195; just before landing in Amsterdam, the plane mysteriously fell from the sky, killing nine people.

programme.title: Disaster Runway
programme.desc: On July 17, 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slides off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashes at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station killing nearly 200 people.

programme.title: The Plane That Flew Too High
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 crashes down killing 160 people in 2005, ultimately leading to the bankruptcy of the troubled airline.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight 1285 with 248 American soldiers on board crashes seconds after refueling in Newfoundland.

programme.title: Break Up Over Texas
programme.desc: Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky.

programme.title: Mayday Munich
programme.desc: A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard.

programme.title: Turning Point
programme.desc: A Northwest Airlines flight cruises above the Bering Sea before problems develop and pilots must make an emergency landing in Anchorage.

programme.title: Bad Attitude
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999.

programme.title: Hiding in Plane Sight
programme.desc: In 1978, PSA Flight 182 collides with a Cessna and crashes into a San Diego residential area killing people on both planes and seven people on the ground.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: On July 11, 1991, the crew of Nigeria Airways Flight 2120 unsuccessfully tries to return to the airport after a burst tire creates an in-flight fire which causes 247 Nigerian pilgrims and 14 crew to perish.

programme.title: I'm the Problem
programme.desc: Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin.

programme.title: Nowhere to Land
programme.desc: Pilots of TACA Flight 110 make a remarkable landing on a narrow levee, but investigators must find out why the engines in a brand-new plane failed.

All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: City Lynx
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Baked Alaska
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Wisdom
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.

programme.title: Urban Warrirors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes. It presents a staggering number of difficulties for those creatures that find themselves cut off from their natural habitat, but there is a growing band of urban warriors stepping up to the challenge. City life for some means living on the breadline, while others discover a land of opportunity - a new concrete frontier.

programme.title: Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Being a wild mum is one of the toughest jobs on earth. From the second a mother gives birth, everything changes. No longer footloose and fancy free, they find themselves completely responsible for tiny, delicate little lives - lives that would be helpless without them. For some, being a mother comes naturally, whilst for others it will take a little practoce. But while the responsibility is immense, being a mum is also incredible.

programme.title: Easter The Start of Something Big
programme.desc: Easter, not just a chocolate feast loved by children. One of the biggest events in the religious calendar, celebrated by millions and steeped in customs and traditions. And for all its different meanings there are some key characters we associate with the holiday: chicks, bunnies and lambs have become integral to our celebrations. How have these animals become a part of Easter tradition? There are many twists and turns in the story, but without a doubt this is the start of something big!

programme.title: Episode 001
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Kaua''i
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: June
programme.desc: It's chaos in the Northern hemisphere, our bird feeders are busy as parents work around the clock to raise their young. There's a baby boom, and young foxes, even in our city centres, leave their dens to explore. Its winter in the south though, cold times for guanacos on the slopes of the Andes. And dry times for elephants in Botswana. They migrate north to the life-giving waters of the Chobe River

programme.title: Nature's Oddballs - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: hile we sleep comfortably in our beds, one of the most spectacular groups of animals go to work - prepare to meet the creatures of the night!

programme.title: Fresh Waters
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: American Mountains
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Islands come in all shapes and sizes all over the world. Any land mass surrounded by water is an island. They are found in seas, oceans lakes and rivers. Atolls, Islets, keys or cays are formed either as result of land brea-king away, water encroaching on the land, or by volcanic eruptions on the sea bed . Islands are often isolated, which leads to the development of a unique flora, fauna and wildlife. The environmental eco-structure of islands differs widely, as does the wildlife.

programme.title: Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: The Amazon. A magnificent broad-leafed rainforest. The heart of Brazil. The Amazon basin covers an impressive 7 million square kilometres. Rainforests are often known as the lungs of our planet. The Amazon Rainforest is the largest. Its value in terms of the Oxygen that it provides, and the Carbon Dioxide that it consumes is immeasurable. It is home to splendid, exquisite plant and animal species. The most diverse and numerous array of species found anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.

programme.title: Giant's Migration
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: On a wildlife mission
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Brown Bears and Salmon
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: The last rhinos
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: January
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Zanzibar: Land of Giants
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: The Dry Forest
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Death
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Kipling's Paradise
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Place of Hope
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Europe's Green Heart
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Water Kingdoms
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Manawatāwhi/ Three Kings islands
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: African Savannah
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: American Praire
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: The Killer Coast
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Mountains of Extreme
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Return to the Wild
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Weird and Wonderful
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Chiribiquete
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.

programme.title: Galapagos: Darwin's Eden
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: The Fragile Islands/Andaman
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Rhino Rescue Cote d'Ivoire
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: The Marine Ecosystem
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to some of the richest marine ecosystems in the world; biologists and conservationists have undertaken a race against time to better understand and protect marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Return of the Shan/Hemis
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: July
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Real Mexican
programme.desc: Frozen Margaritas and chorizo, cheese and green chile enchiladas.

programme.title: Vegetarian Main Courses
programme.desc: Some delicious meatless entrées.

programme.title: The Magic of Phyllo
programme.desc: Honey soaked and butter drenched baklava and a delightful appetizer, tuna tartare in phyllo cups.

programme.title: Diner Classics
programme.desc: Old-fashioned soothing chicken noodle soup; hot and cheesy fries, crispy fries with gravy and kicked up tuna melts.

programme.title: Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Lasagna bolognese; Big Boy Meatballs.

programme.title: Cooking With Your Kids
programme.desc: Emeril shares three easy children's recipes for kids of all ages. Recipes include grilled almond butter sandwiches with bananas and chocolate, french bread pizza and mac and cheese.

programme.title: Turn up the Heat
programme.desc: Emeril cooks for a group of firefighters. He prepares sizzling red-hot shrimp with rooster sauce over sticky rice, blazing hot braised and barbecued pork shanks with a spicy New Mexican barbecue sauce served with a side of cheddar jalapeño cornbread.

programme.title: Bivalves: Oysters and Mussels
programme.desc: How to properly prepare oysters.

programme.title: Kale Soup
programme.desc: Kale and chorizo soup; New England clam chowder.

programme.title: Turkey
