programme.desc: Charlie tries to help Patrick through a crisis of confidence by getting him stoned.

programme.title: Charlie and Lacey Go For Broke
programme.desc: Charlie accidentally causes Lacey to become engaged to a creepy billionaire (Gilbert Gottfried).

programme.title: Charlie & The Terrible, Horrible, No Good Very Bad Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Charlie almost destroys Ed's marriage and Jordan hits on Nolan.

programme.title: Charlie Rolls The Dice in Vegas
programme.desc: Charlie goes to Vegas and life gets complicated after a night of heavy drinking.

programme.title: Charlie & The Return of the Danger Girl
programme.desc: Charlie risks his life to sleep with a thrill-seeker.

programme.title: Charlie Gets in Bed with Jordan and Her Ex
programme.desc: Charlie gets between Jordan and her ex-husband.

programme.title: Charlie's Living the Dream
programme.desc: Charlie becomes trapped in a wild dream where he can't distinguish between what's real and what's not.

programme.title: Charlie Meets his Match
programme.desc: A matchmaker sets up Charlie and Sean with the wrong dates.

programme.title: Charlie and The Epic Relationship Fail
programme.desc: Charlie interferes with Lacey and Nolan's love life and gets Nolan kidnapped by prisoners.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Tied Up with A Catholic Girl
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie and the Sexy Swing Vote
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie & The 100th Episode
programme.desc: Charlie has to make a decision between keeping his group and being a sports psychologist for a baseball team.

programme.title: Charlie Goes Back to Therapy
programme.desc: The first episode in which Charlie - a baseball player with anger issues turned anger management therapist - decides to return to therapy after a bad run-in with his ex wife's new boyfriend. The only problem is he just happens to be sleeping with the one therapist he trusts: his best friend, Kate.

programme.title: Charlie & The Slumpbuster
programme.desc: The new "evolved" Charlie has to deal with a ghost from his old carousing, baseball-playing days when a unattractive woman he slept with just to break a batting slump shows up as a new patient in group therapy.

programme.title: Charlie and Kent Battle over a Patient
programme.desc: A long-standing rivalry over who's a better therapist leads to war when Kate steals Patrick, one of Charlie's group patients.

programme.title: Charlie Tries Sleep Deprivation
programme.desc: Charlie challenges his group to do thirty-six hours of sleep deprivation therapy so that their "inhibitions come down and the truth comes out" - except the result turns out to be the exact opposite.

programme.title: Charlie's Patient Gets Out of Jail
programme.desc: Charlie and his ex, Jennifer, are having an issue with how Charlie still tries to manage her life when Cleo - one of Charlie's patients from his prison anger therapy group - shows up on his doorstep, fresh out on parole. Jennifer decides to get back at Charlie by dating the ex-con.

programme.title: Charlie Dates Kate's Patient
programme.desc: Inflamed by Kate's comment that he's only "nouveau smart", Charlie starts covertly dating a brilliant coffee-shop barista. The only problem is that the woman is turned on by sex where there's a chance of getting caught -- and she's Kate's patient.

programme.title: Charlie Tries to Prove Therapy is Legit
programme.desc: Charlie falls for Jen's hot new business partner, Lori - played by Charlie's real-life ex, Denise Richards - only to find she thinks therapy is a scam. In the therapy group, Patrick asks Charlie to counsel the angry ghost of his mother, who he believes is haunting his apartment.

programme.title: Charlie Outs A Patient
programme.desc: Charlie has to evaluate the depth of his involvement in his patient's lives when he accidentally helps his patient who vicariously enjoys other people's anger hook up with a crazy woman.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Visits
programme.desc: Charlie gets an unexpected visit from his hyper-critical, bullying father - played by Charlie's real-life dad, Martin Sheen. In the therapy group, Charlie attempts to help Lacey with road rage.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Romantic
programme.desc: After Charlie and Kate have sex, he innocently asks her if she wants to go to a movie. Kate interprets this as a romantic gesture, rushes to fix him up on a date the next day with someone else and the two are forced to exam the nature of their odd relationship. At home, Sam kisses a girl at school and a picture of it ends up on Facebook.

programme.title: Charlies Loses it at a Baby Shower
programme.desc: Charlie gets an invitation to his sister's baby shower and asks Kate to come along. Patrick decides to tell Ed that his daughter is gay.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Starts to Lose It
programme.desc: Charlie believes his father is faking Alzheimer's, and uses a hidden camera to spy on him. Patrick offers to help Nolan change his appearance to help his self-esteem.

programme.title: Charlie and the Ex-Patient
programme.desc: Charlie begins a questionable romantic relationship with an ex-patient after the five-year mandatory waiting period runs out.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Breaks Bad
programme.desc: Charlie tries to persuade his father to join a choir of people his own age, a decision he later regrets. Lacey helps Patrick as an anger ally while he deals with a bully from high school.

programme.title: Charlie & Jen Together Again
programme.desc: Jennifer moves in with Charlie temporarily and Kate gets jealous.

programme.title: Charlie and Deception Therapy
programme.desc: Charlie tries to help his patient, Ed (Barry Corbin), with a placebo pill that's supposedly reduces anger.

programme.title: Charlie Dates a Teacher
programme.desc: Charlie gets involved with Sam's English teacher, he thinks her bad grade is based on his poor sexual performance; Lacey starts to have illicit romantic dreams about both Kate and Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie and Cee Lo
programme.desc: Charlie runs into problems when CeeLo Green hires him as his personal therapist. Kate wants Charlie to drop CeeLo as a patient, because he is interrupting their time together.

programme.title: Charlie Is An Expert Witness
programme.desc: Charlie and Kate face off as expert witnesses in the same trial; Charlie gives Nolan homework to get in touch with his feelings.

programme.title: Charlie & Catholicism
programme.desc: Charlie and his dad (Martin Sheen) get into it when Martin has Charlie's daughter, Sam, baptized behind Charlie's back.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Slugout

programme.title: The Trade
programme.desc: After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.

programme.desc: Eli fires slugs right and left during a fast-paced slugout on mecha-back! "See you back home," Eli tells the slugs he has to leave behind as he races across a cavern during the fight.

programme.desc: After Coop uses cat whispering to make Kat into his new best friend, he becomes a pal to all animals. programme.title: Board Kat // The Treasure of Sierra Munson
programme.desc: Kat and Coop accidentally switch brains the day before a skateboarding competition that Coop really wants to win. Coop goes skateboarding in Kat's body.

programme.desc: Kat tires to relax in private but finds his nap encroached on by Coop and his friends playing Capture The Flag. // When OLM shows an unusual interest in Coop and Dennis' favourite show, they become equally obsessed with finding out why she likes it. programme.title: Let the Games Begin // Night Of The Zombie Cat
programme.desc: Millie brings home a strange, hairless cat and Coop discovers that his once happy life will never be the same again. // Coop defies Dad and stays up to watch a horror movie and finds that his home has been invaded by Zombie cats

programme.title: Bootsville's Most Wanted // Kat of Diamonds
programme.desc: During a battle with Kat, Coop runs afoul of BUCK DIAMOND - a tough, no-nonsense Animal Protection Officer.

programme.title: Slug Fu Showdown Part 2
programme.desc: As Kord, Trixie and Pronto struggle to keep the wily Elemental Slugs out of the wrong hands, Eli and Junjie's Slug Fu training is cut short by a madman.

programme.title: Bandoleer of Brothers
programme.desc: Eli's got a new slug recruit! But in the heat of battle, can this rookie go from frightened novice to the hero of the day?

programme.title: Return of the Elementals Part 1
programme.desc: A new member joins the Shane Gang! His name is Junjie, and he is a master of the mysterious slugslinging art of Slug Fu. But even with the power of five slingers, the Shane Gang find themselves in over their heads trying to protect the ancient Elemental Slugs.

programme.title: Get Pronto!
programme.desc: When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

programme.title: Amazing Feet of Strength // Me Coop you Kat
programme.desc: Kat soups up Coop's new soccer shoes to allow the wearer to run faster and jump higher, and Coop wears the shoes in the championship game. But Kat wants them back.

programme.title: Beware of Were-Coop // Trick or Threat
programme.desc: After Kat scratches Coop under a full moon, Dennis is convinced his best friend will transform into a deadly Were-Cat. // Kat tries to communicate with the Cat Nebula, setting up a rendezvous. In order to stop a feline invasion, Coop and Dennis are forced to pay the ultimate price.

programme.title: Back on the Shane Gang
programme.desc: The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

programme.title: Ghoul from Beyond Part 2
programme.desc: The Dark Slinger and his marauders have invaded Slugterra! But there's more to this new threat than meets the eye. Eli must fight a very different kind of duel to save Slugterra...and himself.

programme.title: Lightwell
programme.desc: Burpy is sick, and the only thing that will cure him is a trip to the Lightwell - a mysterious, hidden power source only slugs (and the Shadow Clan) know the way to.

programme.title: Hit the Road // Never Cry Sheep
programme.desc: When Kat is left at a kennel while the Burtonburgers go on vacation, he leads his fellow animal inmates in revolt against the animal-hating owner.

programme.title: Slug Day
programme.desc: A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. But when a group of thieves make off with the Giver's precious cargo of slugs, our heroes must ride to the rescue-and discover the secret of who the Giver really is.

programme.title: Kat to the Future (part 1) // Kat to the Future (part 2)

programme.title: The Thrill of the Game

David and Katie marry and plan to build a life together, but their once-loving relationship deteriorates after David gives in to his father's demand that he work in the family business.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: A Kind of Murder
programme.desc: Walter Stackhouse is rich, successful and unhappily married to the beautiful but damaged Clara. His desire to be free of her feeds his obsession with Kimmel, a man suspected of brutally murdering his own wife. When Walter and Kimmel's lives become dangerously intertwined, a ruthless police detective becomes convinced he has found the murderer. But as the lines blur between innocence and intent, who, in fact, is the real killer?

Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

programme.title: The Good Heart

The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

One afternoon, a mystifying and beautiful girl, Ondine (Alicja Bachleda), gets caught in his nets as he wades along the water. Aboard the boat, Ondine brings Syracuse great luck, seemingly drawing the fish towards his nets. However, the fisherman starts to fear that Ondine may not be meant for this life.

programme.title: O'Neal Winter vs. Hogle Pankow
programme.desc: Winter will team up with series host Blair O'Neal to take on Hogle and Pankow in a fierce two-versus-two, shamble match with a twist; each team will be offered two mulligans, but taking a second chance will come with consequences, and they are sure to be hilarious.

programme.title: Mehmet O'Neal & vs. Stewart Zuhl
programme.desc: Blair O'Neal teams up with Inci Mehmet for a showdown at Portstewart Golf Club's Strand Course in Northern Ireland; their opponents for this 2v2 match are Henni Zuel and Di Stewart, bringing their own flair and competitive fire to this contest.

programme.title: Balir O'Neal vs. Lucy Robson
programme.desc: Blair O'Neal competes against Lucy Robson on the Riverside course at Portstewart Golf Club in Northern Ireland.

programme.title: Improve Your Short Game
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the most important keys to getting up and down around the green; learn how to set up for success like Phil Mickelson, make solid wedge contact like Luke Donald and control trajectory like Tiger Woods.

programme.title: Make More Putts
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach putting grips, styles and drills used by the world's best players; learn how to stop pushing putts like Tiger Woods, eliminate the pull like Scottie Scheffler and put better roll on the ball like Dave Stockton.

programme.title: Golf Central
programme.desc: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

programme.title: Golf Central
programme.desc: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

programme.title: Better Wedge Play
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to stick your mid-range to full swing wedge shots; learn how to make solid contact like Collin Morikawa, hit it straight down your target line like Steve Stricker and control distance like Rory McIlroy.

programme.title: Worst Swing Faults
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach drills to cure the worst swing faults; learn how to improve your swing plane like Tiger Woods, use a pool noodle to eliminate the chicken wing and fix numerous faults that cause a slice.

programme.title: Chapter 6: Slice Stoppers
programme.desc: The biggest keys to stopping the slice and improving the backswing featuring a drill using a basketball and a tip from Nick Faldo. LPGA winner Matilda Castren demonstrates what she does in practice before every tournament to prevent slicing the ball.

programme.title: Chapter 7: Putting Pointers
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal share putting pointers from the game's best players. Learn how to control speed on the greens like Tiger Woods, improve balance like Jack Nicklaus, square the putter face, and find the right putting grip.

programme.title: Chapter 8: Majors Unclassified
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal share ball striking secrets from Masters Champions and Chevron Championship winners. Learn tips for working the ball used by Jack Nicklaus, Tiger Woods, Dustin Johnson, and Hideki Matsuyama.

programme.title: Chapter 9: The Scoring Zone
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to go low in the scoring zone. Learn to stick wedge shots with lessons on solid contact, swing path, trajectory control, and distance control. Martin also shares wedge play advice from Open Champion Shane Lowry.

programme.title: Chapter 10: Total Driving
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to hit the driver longer and straighter. Learn tips used by Rory McIlroy, Ernie Els, John Daly and more of the game's best all-around drivers. Martin also reveals how to set up for success on the tee.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.title: Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: The Best Fish You're Not Eating
programme.desc: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
programme.desc: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: The Most Underrated Game Bird
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
programme.desc: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

programme.title: Game Day Fried Squab
programme.desc: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

programme.title: The Wild Boar Playbook
programme.desc: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

programme.title: The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches
programme.desc: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

programme.title: El Alamein to Stalingrad: July-September 1942
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: Omaha Beach
programme.desc: A German Tank Gunner and an American Infantryman recollect the US landings at Omaha Beach during the D Day Invasion of France.

programme.title: Breakout from Normandy
programme.desc: American and German Supply Chain Personnel look back at the Allied breakout from Normandy in the weeks after D Day.

programme.title: Big Picture: Army Transportation Corps
programme.desc: We follow the supplies from the factory to the depot in the U.S., to the port to the front line unit in Korea. We show the Port of Embarkation, small boats, the ducks, the rail lines, the trucks. And we show a new development of the TC... the helicopter transportation company in training.

programme.title: The Gothic Line
programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: Africa: Our First Offensive
programme.desc: The Troops of Operation Torch come from the U.S. and Britain. U.S. industry is shown going to full war production. Equipment is shown being loaded up for transport to North Africa, and the landings are made successfully.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Propaganda
programme.desc: There are many weapons of war; fighter planes, heavy tanks and skilled infantrymen but it could be argued that none is more powerful than the power of suggestion. Propaganda and the war of words played an undoubtedly vital role in both the successes and failures of WW2. Governments struggled to gain the upper hand. But one Nazi proved to have a deft talent for spin. Joseph Goebbels.

programme.title: Great Battles of The Civil War: Volume 1
programme.desc: Volume 1 - 1861-1863. This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1861-1863. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1945
programme.desc: In this final film of the series, '1945', the end of the war is now truly in sight. Yet there were still hurdles to overcome, and with the completion of the Battle of the Bulge still to test the Allies, the race for Berlin was on. Discover what happened in Hitler's final hours and enjoy the VE Day celebrations with Winston Churchill and the people of Britain as the dream of victory became reality.

programme.title: Waking a Sleeping Giant
programme.desc: The 1930's bring remarkable advances in military flight and provide Germany and Japan with decisive advantages in the air as World War II begins. The Germans pound London in the Battle of the Blitz while Japanese naval aviation brings the United States into the war with the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Mastering Arms
programme.desc: Whether revered or reviled, the invention of the gun forever changed how wars are fought and won. From humble beginnings to a tool that built empires, toppled kingdoms, and killed millions, its story is one of power and evolution. This episode explores the gun's transformation over centuries and its influence on the battlefield, in politics, and in shaping the very course of human history.

programme.title: The Gothic Line
programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Korean Ceasefire Talks Begin
programme.desc: This program includes a tribute to the men of the Infantry from an officer who served with them as a platoon leader, Lieutenant Robert Fallon of Washington, D.C. Lieutenant Fallon points out the difficult but important job of the man carrying the rifle in combat. Captain Zimmerman interviews Master Sergeant Heidenreith, also of Washington, D.C. Sergeant Heidenreith was a combat engineer in Korea.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Six Day War - Third Arab Israeli War
programme.desc: Arab nations united in antagonism with the goal of wiping Israel off of the map during the 6 Day War. In one of the largest battles in the history of armored warfare, Israel devastatingly demonstrated its military might.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: Hitler's Favourite Royal
programme.desc: Prince Charles Edward was Queen Victoria's youngest grandchild. Brought up at Claremont House and educated at Eton until he was 14, Charles Edward was forced by Queen Victoria to take up the Dukedom of Coburg in Germany after a series of unexpected deaths of uncles and cousins. Transformed overnight from a British Prince to a German Duke, his life was altered in ways he could never have imagined.

programme.title: Air Defense & Surveillance - Helicopters
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: 1940 - Storm Over the Alps
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: Meet the New Boss
programme.desc: As Nazi Germany collapses, Hitler dies by suicide with Eva Braun. Admiral Dönitz briefly leads the Flensburg Government before Germany surrenders on May 7-8, 1945. The war ends, but Allied forces uncover Nazi atrocities, cities lie in ruins, and millions are displaced-marking a final grim legacy of the Third Reich.

programme.title: Animals at War: Wild Heroes of World War II
programme.desc: Fifty million people died in the WWII, the biggest massacre in the history of humanity. But the animal kingdom also paid a heavy toll, despite no official numbers being compiled for the victims. This included combat animals, animals that backed up humans, those that entertained or consoled them, some that fed people, and other animals that were symbols.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: Triumphant on Land
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: The Tide Begins to Turn: October-December 1942
programme.desc: As 1942 drew to a close, the Allies were really beginning to make headway. The British made a crucial breakthrough in North Africa, and the Americans pushed the Japanese out of Burma and New Guinea. In Russia the Germans found themselves surrounded.

programme.title: Facing the Music: January-March 1943
programme.desc: The only option for the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad was surrender, while all across Russia the Red Army consolidated their advantage. Also, as German cities encountered the kind of bombing that Britain faced back in 1940, courtesy of the RAF.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: The landings on the beaches of Normandy, the first step in the operation, codenamed Overlord enterprise by Dwight D. Eisenhower. The greatest amphibious invasion in history.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: The Phoney War
programme.desc: Japan unprovoked invasion had plunged China into war and Europe had been brought to the brink of conflict. In Italy Mussolini introduced fascism to the political landscape and Hitler dismantled democracy. Their expansion threatened neighboring nations.

programme.title: War and Advice
programme.desc: The combined US Forces offer advice to the natives of South Vietnam.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: A journey into his world. The film explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

programme.title: This is Korea
programme.desc: Covers the United States involvement with Korea and testing of Korean weapons. John Ford directed this film which is the only color documentary made during the Korean War.

programme.title: U-Boat Alert!
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: NEWSREEL FOOTAGE OF THE NAZI WAR CRIMINALS
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others

programme.title: America Goes to War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Japanese bombing of Pearl Harbor brings America to war.

programme.title: Why We Fight
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: Carey Mulligan
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive
programme.desc: From September 20 to October 20, 1950 United Nations forces struck hard against the Communist army in Korea. Footage shows the recapture of Seoul, the fall of the North Korean capital city, Pyongyang, an airdrop by the 187th Regimental Airdrop team, and the U.S. Navy battleship Missouri in action.

programme.title: The Secret War
programme.desc: Shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War, the Polish and British have succeeded in de-coding the top secret German military codes known as 'Enigma.' This information, referred to as 'Ultra' by the Allies, becomes vital for the Allies' military situation in North Africa, the Soviet Union, and Northern France.

programme.title: Big Picture: Atrocities in Korea
programme.desc: A documented report of Communist atrocities in Korea, with scenes just released depicting the horror and brutality of Communism. Includes interviews with returned prisoners of war who were eye witnesses to some of these atrocities and Major General William Dean and General Mark W. Clark.

programme.title: Death in Snow and Sand
programme.desc: The third episode opens with Rommel's second offensive in North Africa. The following summer the German offensive at Kharkov and the subsequent push past the River Don towards Volga and Stalingrad, later the scene of Germany's first major defeat - The Battle of Stalingrad. The scene is switched to North Africa following the continuous battle between the British 8th Army, the Desert Rats.

programme.title: Duel in the Desert
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: 1942: Almost 80,000 French Jews are arrested, following the orders of Adolf Hitler and Vichy. From the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup to Auschwitz, thanks to the most recent historiography and reenactment, plunge into the making of the Holocaust.

programme.title: Medal of Honor Winners
programme.desc: True stories of the Medal of Honor, the highest award for valor which can be bestowed upon an individual serving in the Armed Services of the United States.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: Flint & Steel
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: Kristin Scott Thomas
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: Resistance is Never Futile: April-June 1943
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: Tentative Steps: July-September 1943
programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

programme.title: Bombs Away: D-Day and Japan
programme.desc: Explore the role played by the 101st Airborne Division during Normandy. On June 5, General Dwight Eisenhower delivered a rousing speech intended to boost the morale of the division and help make them pivotal in the success of the invasion.

programme.title: Part 3 - New Alliances
programme.desc: In this episode, the complex web of alliances and partnerships forms as the conflict expands. The entry of the Soviet Union and the United States into the war drastically shifts the balance of power. We also explore the significance of Japan's imperial ambitions, culminating in the attack on Pearl Harbor, which brought the U.S. fully into the conflict.

programme.title: The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: Marines with Wings
programme.desc: Threatened by numerous attacks by enemy troops in the Cam Lo area, 8,500 Marines and 3,000 ARVN troops strike along the Demilitarized Zone on July 7, 1966. The battle, Operation Hastings, lasted until August 3rd. The Marines pushed the NVA forces back across the DMZ.

programme.title: Erwin Rommel
programme.desc: This German Field Marshall had tributes paid to him by both Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler. He was revered by his own troops and respected by those who fought against him. A close adviser to The Fuhrer, and part of an attempt to kill him. Rommel's controversial legacy as both a hero, and a War Criminal is still debated today.

programme.title: Mother of Normandy
programme.desc: Leslie Caron narrates 'Mother of Normandy,' a documentary highlighting Simone Renaud, wife of the wartime Mayor of Ste. Mere-Eglise. For 44 years, she expressed gratitude to D-Day veterans and families by tending graves, corresponding, and organizing commemorations. Renaud became a cherished figure, leaving an enduring impact on those touched by D-Day's legacy.

programme.title: The Sparrow Hawks
programme.desc: A film about the Forward Air Controller, whose job it was to spot enemy positions and mark them for attack.

programme.title: Battle for the Marianas
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines the brutal marine invasion of Saipan and the effort to push back the Japanese counter-attack in the Philippians sea. On Saipan , Allied forces eventually push all the way to Marpi Point point and take the island. Japanese soldiers and civilians frequently choose death over surrender. Later, the Americans successfully invade Tinian and later Guam.

programme.title: Josef Goebbels
programme.desc: Master of Propaganda. The fanatic who shaped the first modern political spin machine and the man who harnessed the combined power of radio, print, posters, film and oratory to shape the political agenda.

programme.title: Big Picture: A Day in Korea
programme.desc: Comparison of the life of the individual in the states to the soldier on the front lines of Korea. Despite the truce talks fighting is still going on and we still have a serious need for men and machines. The contrast between their life and the life of the soldier should bring the picture closer.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Six months after the fall of France, V. Molotov visited Berlin to discuss how the world was to be divided after victory. He was told Britain was defeated. But Britain wasn't beaten. Just alone.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944: A monumental Allied force assembles to liberate Europe from Nazi rule. With tension high and WWII entering its fifth year, two million soldiers stand prepared for sacrifice. In France, civilians eagerly await their deliverance, listening to Radio-London. As Allies land in Normandy, civilians, oblivious to danger, emerge to welcome them amidst combat.

programme.title: Night Bombers
programme.desc: Rare archive colour footage of an RAF bombing raid on Berlin in the winter of 1943 - probably the most heavily defended target of them all. 440 Avro Lancaster heavy bombers and 4 de Havilland Mosquitos led the attack causing extensive damage to Berlin.

programme.title: The Campaign
programme.desc: This episode will take you on a journey through the Allied campaign in North Africa, from the daring Operation Torch to the triumphant defeat of the infamous Afrika Korps. You'll also get an exclusive look at the historic Casablanca Conference, where two of the greatest leaders of the 20th century, Franklin D. Roosevelt and Winston Churchill, strategized and plotted their next moves.

programme.title: Blitzkrieg
programme.desc: Six months have passed with very little action in the Phony War. That is about to end and a new word is added to the vocabulary of warfare - Blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Leibstandarte: Hitler's Elite Bodyguard
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler raised a group of 200 men, fanatics known as the 'Stosstrupp-Hitler'. They were brought together by Nazi thug who was also a trusted friend of Hitler's named Sepp Deitrich. He and the men of the bodyguard pledged themselves to defending the life of the man who's name they wore on their sleeves so proudly.

programme.title: The Battle for Iwo Jima
programme.desc: The United States fought two battles here-the U.S. Marines at Iwo Jima against the Japanese, and the U.S. Navy against the typhoon. During the now-legendary events depicted in this episode, the series reaches the final throes of battle in the Pacific war against the Japanese.

programme.title: US Submarines
programme.desc: In this episode, viewers see how the U.S. Navy's submarines contributed to the Japanese empire's defeat, sinking thousands of tons of commercial ships.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Zhenya asks Marina Raskova to intercede for Galya. Raskova orders Galya freed from tribunal and reinstated as Zhenya's navigator. Makeev's team must steal secret documents from a courier protected by twenty truck-mounted submachine gunners. Brave pilots will bomb targets to distract the guards.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: From 1940 to 1945, these two vastly contradictory personalities thought of nothing else but how to destroy each other. For the first time, a film tells the story of this clash of the giants from their common experience in the trenches of the First World War until the end of World War II.

programme.title: Slater's Sister
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) dates Slater's sister despite his friend's nervousness about the matter. With Mario Lopez.

programme.title: Earthquake
programme.desc: Mrs. Belding (guest star Louan Gideon) goes into labor while trapped in an elevator with Zack and Tori (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Leanna Creel).

programme.title: Best Summer of My Life
programme.desc: Zack, Slater, Screech and Lisa (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Dustin Diamond, Lark Voorhies) reflect on the summer they spent at Malibu Sands.

programme.title: School Song
programme.desc: Zack enters a contest to write a new school song and resorts to sabotage.

programme.title: Saved by the Bell: Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Teens from the TV series visit a grandfather's (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) Hawaiian resort, under siege by a greedy developer.

programme.title: Saved by the Bell: Wedding in Las Vegas
programme.desc: California college students from the TV series trek to Las Vegas for the nuptials of Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) and Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar).

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: The gang enters college after graduating from high school; with Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to College
programme.desc: Zack's high-school girlfriend (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) moves into the same suite as his new love interest (Anne Tremko). With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: Zack, Lies & Videotape
programme.desc: For a cultural anthropology class, Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) tries to find out what women want. With Patrick Fabian.

programme.title: Rush Week
programme.desc: Zack and Slater (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez) are invited to join the Sigma Alpha fraternity. With Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: Slater's War
programme.desc: Slater (Mario Lopez) battles with his feelings when he is challenged to take part in a protest. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: The Homecoming
programme.desc: The university's most famous alumnus (Charles Grant) makes advances toward Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen). Guest stars: Gloria Loring, Ed Winter.

programme.title: The Poker Game
programme.desc: Kelly, Leslie and Alex (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen, Anne Tremko, Kiersten Warren) give Mr. Rogers (Bob Golic) some advice about women.

programme.title: Professor Zack
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) poses as Professor Lasky (Patrick Fabian) to get a date with a fellow student (Brittney Powell).

programme.title: Screech Love
programme.desc: Zack and Screech (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Dustin Diamond) fall in love with the same tennis player (Hillary Danner).

programme.title: Dr. Kelly
programme.desc: Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) has a personality change when she works as a waitress. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Story
programme.desc: Zack, Slater, Alex and Kelly (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Kiersten Warren, Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) spend Thanksgiving with underprivileged children.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: Kelly and Professor Lasky (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen, Patrick Fabian) discover a mutual attraction.

programme.title: Kelly and the Professor
programme.desc: Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) asks Professor Lasky (Patrick Fabian) to her sorority masquerade ball.

programme.title: A Question of Ethics
programme.desc: Zack, Slater, Alex and Leslie (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Kiersten Warren, Anne Tremko) take an ethics course with a difficult professor (guest star Robert Guillaume).

programme.title: The Rave
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) has a party to raise money for a trip to Cancun, Mexico. With Holland Taylor.

programme.title: Bedside Manner
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) takes a part-time job at the Student Health Center to be close to Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen).

programme.title: Love and Death
programme.desc: Each of the students tries to deal with the death of a popular professor. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Mario Lopez.

programme.title: Marry Me
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) panics at the thought of losing Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) and asks her to marry him.

programme.title: Wedding Plans
programme.desc: Lisa (guest star Lark Voorhies) visits California University for Kelly's wedding shower. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: Zack's summer romance with an older woman comes to a halt when she discovers he lied to her.

programme.title: Love Letters
programme.desc: Zack promises to help Screech get a date with Lisa if Screech will do Zack's term paper.

programme.title: Wall Street
programme.desc: Zack tries to cash in on a stock-market investment to get money to replace his father's video recorder.

programme.title: Leaping to Conclusions
programme.desc: A student opposed to killing animals for experiments releases all the science class frogs.

programme.title: Parents and Teachers
programme.desc: Zack's father falls for Miss Bliss.

programme.title: Showdown
programme.desc: Screech finds that an intimidating student has a learning disability.

programme.title: Save the Last Dance for Me
programme.desc: Zack and a classmate ask the same girl to an upcoming dance, jeopardizing their friendship.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Rat
programme.desc: Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) scheme to get more time to study for a midterm ends up hurting his teacher. With Dennis Haskins.

programme.title: Let's Get Together
programme.desc: A student argument helps a teacher resolve a problem with a longtime friend. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: Practical Jokes
programme.desc: A teacher turns a practical joke into a lesson about the criminal justice system. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: Stevie
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) schemes to steal a kiss from a returning former student who is now a famous rock star.

programme.title: Clubs and Cliques
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) is offered a chance to join a popular club. With Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: The Mentor
programme.desc: A retired teacher with unorthodox methods stimulates the class when he substitutes for their regular teacher.

programme.title: Dancing to the Max
programme.desc: The gang enters a dance contest being held at the Max and hosted by radio personality Casey Kasem. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.

programme.title: The Lisa Card
programme.desc: Lisa's (Lark Voorhies) friends invent ways to pay the bills she has accrued on her father's credit card. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen and Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: A freak lightning accident enables Screech (Dustin Diamond) to predict the future. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen and Mario Lopez.

programme.title: Fatal Distraction
programme.desc: The guys hide a microphone at the girls' party to find out whom Kelly will ask to the dance.

programme.title: Screech's Woman
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) gets into unusual circumstances and clothes when he tries to help Screech (Dustin Diamond) get a date.

programme.title: Aloha Slater
programme.desc: Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) plan to get rid of Slater (Mario Lopez) backfires; Slater's revenge ends up benefiting Screech (Dustin Diamond).

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: When Ms. Simpson injures her back, a substitute teacher named Tony Crane takes over her class at Bayside; when all the girls fall for Mr. Crane, Zack and Slater become jealous.

programme.title: Cream for a Day
programme.desc: When Kelly is nominated as homecoming queen, her dream is shattered as she faces the prospect of winning after she gets a zit; Zack comes up with a solution, but it does not unfold as he plans.

programme.title: Pinned to the Mat
programme.desc: Zack bets against a Valley wrestler named Marvin Nedick that Slater will win his wrestling match against Nedick; things go wrong when Slater decides to quit wrestling.

programme.title: Beauty and the Screech
programme.desc: In order for Kelly to go to a George Michael concert, she has to pass her science test. Zack persuades Screech to tutor Kelly, a ploy which is more for his benefit than for Kelly's.

programme.title: The Friendship Business
programme.desc: Zack and his friends form a company selling friendship bracelets for a business class project. He names himself as boss, but Kelly, Jessie, and Slater feel he is treating them poorly.

programme.title: The Mamas and the Papas
programme.desc: Everyone is put into pairs for a class assignment to act out married life, so they can be prepared for marriage as adults.

programme.title: The Election
programme.desc: Jessie and Zack (Elizabeth Berkley, Mark-Paul Gosselaar) run for student president, each for different reasons.

programme.title: The Zack Tapes
programme.desc: Zack's use of a subliminal tape to get Kelly to fall for him has results he never intended.

programme.title: The Zack Tapes
programme.desc: Zack's use of a subliminal tape to get Kelly to fall for him has results he never intended.

programme.title: King of the Hill
programme.desc: Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) schemes to get Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) to be his girl land him in detention with a rival for her affections.

programme.title: Save That Tiger
programme.desc: The pranks between rival schools Bayside and Valley escalate during the week of the city cheerleading finals.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Nerd Kind
programme.desc: Screech's (Dustin Diamond) alien disguise is so believable it attracts a government UFO investigator.

programme.title: Screech's Birthday
programme.desc: Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) decides to throw a surprise birthday party for Screech (Dustin Diamond) in the principal's office.

programme.title: Slater's Friend
programme.desc: Slater's (Mario Lopez) pet dies while in Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) care.

programme.title: The Prom

programme.title: Water Damage Control
programme.desc: A woman claims a bathroom leak caused extensive water damage after a plumber made a house call; the owner of the plumbing company denies any wrongdoing.

programme.title: Chihuahua Fright
programme.desc: A chihuahua is mauled by a larger dog; neighbors fight over liability and vet bills.

programme.title: Music Video Conflict and Family Overstays Welcome
programme.desc: A singer sues for the return of money paid for music videos; the producer accuses him of violating their contract; a woman sues her brother for rent and for damage to her property; they counter with claims of harassment and invasion of privacy.

programme.title: Parking Spot Assault Caught on Tape
programme.desc: A security camera captures footage of a neighbor shoving a senior citizen to the ground in an ongoing feud over a public parking spot.

programme.title: Stop Scrolling!
programme.desc: A woman claims she made concerning discoveries on her boyfriend's phone while he was sleeping; mutual restraining orders, police intervention and alleged emotional distress come into play.

programme.title: Dueling Evictions; Baby Shoes Biz
programme.desc: A married couple move into a friends' house and end up suing them over an eviction and alleged property damage; a single mother says the owner of a children's clothing website agreed to buy her company, and they argue over the terms of that sale.

programme.title: When Parked Cars Attack and Lane-Split Decision Collision
programme.desc: A driver refuses to take responsibility for slamming into a parked car because he says the vehicle was parked illegally; a motorcyclist is flipped into the air when an uninsured driver fails to yield; each woman claims the other is to blame.

programme.title: Teen Tread Lightly
programme.desc: A man claims his landlord illegally entered his apartment and accused his teen son of walking too hard; the police are called to their shared home multiple times to intervene.

programme.title: From Flip to Flop
programme.desc: After flipping a home for profit, a realtor sues the videographer she hired to document her renovation process; he says he never signed on for a year-long job.

programme.title: Trespassing Husband and Cat Lover Chaos
programme.desc: A man sues his estranged wife's boyfriend for damages after being accused of domestic violence; ex-roommates, with two cats each, wage emotional warfare over household chores; a heated exchange leaves a woman claiming she feared for her life.

programme.title: Graphic Email Revenge
programme.desc: After a bitter break-up, a woman claims her ex-boyfriend showed inappropriate videos of her to his friends and sent a graphic email to her boss; he says she stranded him at a party and trashed his phone.

programme.title: Dash-Cam Collision and Drug Test Danger
programme.desc: Dash-cam footage of a moped's dramatic collision with a moving car weighs heavily in the determination as to which driver is at fault; a federal employee in recovery claims marijuana was being smoked by her fellow tenants.

programme.title: Minors and Majors Slander
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a young man accuses his former boss of selling alcohol to a minor and of vandalizing his car.

programme.title: Minors and Majors Slander (Part 2)
programme.desc: An employer counters his ex-employees' lawsuit with a 10K claim against them for slander and for filing a false complaint.

programme.title: Roommate Crosses the Line; Podcast Me Out
programme.desc: A lap dance leads to a heated argument between roommates which escalates into an alleged dog attack; a young man invests thousands in his longtime friend's podcast.

programme.title: Hijacked Harmony
programme.desc: A musician demands recognition and payment for his creative work on a song; he sues for the 10K court maximum for breach of contract.

programme.title: Business Review Bombshell
programme.desc: An electrical contractor sues for the 10K court maximum for negative online business reviews that he claims hurt his business; he is countersued for 10K for allegedly filing a frivolous lawsuit.

programme.title: DUI Slam Into House and Covid Cancel
programme.desc: A woman is trapped in her home with her terrified dog for hours after an impaired driver crashes through the wall; when a destination wedding is cancelled due to COVID, a young woman refuses to pay the bride refunded airline vouchers.

programme.title: Caught in a Blind Spot and Luxury Car Chew Toy
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases; in the first, a woman is accused of repeatedly backing into a teen's car; in the 2nd case, a man alleges that at the sight of two growling pit bulls on his front porch, he retreated to the safety of his new car.

programme.title: Pool Rules Fail
programme.desc: A tenant's violation of pool rules leads a property manager to take drastic action.

programme.title: Brews and Bruise
programme.desc: After the bars close, drinking continues in a park but ends when a flying beer can causes thousands in dental damages to a partygoer; former high school teammates fight over who is to blame.

programme.title: Dance No More and Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: The Judge mediates a payment dispute between a dance studio owner and a single mother; a woman says her roommate's boyfriend entered their apartment unannounced and with his own key; she claims the voicing of her safety concerns led to her eviction.

programme.title: Short-Term Job Trauma
programme.desc: A woman claims her former employer accused her of being a drug addict and withheld wages; her employer countersues for defamation of character.

programme.title: Sisters Cry Neglect!

programme.desc: Looking inside Los Angeles-based designer Dani Dazey's pink bungalow in Highland Park, Calif.

programme.desc: In this South Carolina stunner, designer Mary Welch Fox turns up the volume on style with bold choices, fearless edge, and serious design swagger; this home doesn't just bend the rules-it breaks them wide open.

programme.title: It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
programme.desc: Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

programme.title: Rustic Meets Refined
programme.desc: Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

programme.title: Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
programme.desc: Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

programme.title: The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
programme.desc: Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

programme.title: This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
programme.desc: Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

programme.title: Caroline Winkler's Cozy Space in DC
programme.desc: Step inside the charming 600-square-foot Washington, D.C., apartment of interior design YouTuber Caroline Winkler; bathed in natural light, every corner reflects a keen eye for detail and a passion for making a house entirely one's own.

programme.title: London Living With a Fashion Icon
programme.desc: Step inside the London home of fashion designer Wiggy Hindmarch, a sanctuary celebrated for its use of print, texture and color; every room acts as a playful narrative, blending the property's storied history with Wiggy's own expressive flair.

programme.title: Collected Chic: Genevieve Gorder's NYC Apartment
programme.desc: Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

programme.title: Heights of the Evergreen State
programme.desc: Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River; next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

programme.title: Meadows and Modernism
programme.desc: Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design; he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek; next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

programme.title: Peaks of Ringgold
programme.desc: Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

programme.title: Tracks and Tranquility
programme.desc: Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

programme.title: The Laws of Lighting and Colour
programme.desc: Julie breaks down the basic equations for taking the stress out of design.

programme.title: The Science Behind Kitchens & Bedrooms

programme.title: The Thanksgiving Table & More
programme.desc: Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.
