programme.desc: Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

programme.title: Raising the Bar
programme.desc: On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

programme.title: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
programme.desc: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

programme.title: The Reclaimed Kitchen
programme.desc: Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

programme.desc: Matthew gets an all-access pass to rock royalty when he visits Carnie Wilson's Los Angeles home for a tour of her music studio and to whip up her Fall-to-Your-Knees Mac and Cheese while sharing laughs, stories, and even a little harmonizing.

programme.title: Burgers and Babka: Viral Sensations
programme.desc: Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

programme.desc: In the future, glacial melting has covered 98% of earth. Sharks dominate the planet, led by a mutated alpha shark, as human survivors live in terror.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: Strange things are afoot in the depths of the sea. First a passenger plane vanishes over the Pacific Ocean. Then an oil platform is obliterated. Marine biologist Emma MacNeil is dispatched to investigate the phenomena, and, with the help of Japanese scientist Seiji Shimada, she makes a discovery that will rock the world: An enormous prehistoric shark and a giant octopus have been awakened from their icy slumbers -- and they're hungry.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Kolossus
programme.desc: Humanity is threatened when a robot is accidentally awakened at the same time as another mega shark.

programme.title: 2-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: When a Semester at Sea ship is sunk by a mutated two-headed shark, the survivors escape to a deserted atoll. But when it starts flooding, the coeds are no longer safe from the double jaws of the monster.

programme.title: 2-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: When a Semester at Sea ship is sunk by a mutated two-headed shark, the survivors escape to a deserted atoll. But when it starts flooding, the coeds are no longer safe from the double jaws of the monster.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Kolossus
programme.desc: Humanity is threatened when a robot is accidentally awakened at the same time as another mega shark.

programme.title: 5-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: A beautiful island's aquatic life faces a new terror: the 5-Headed Shark, a demented starfish-shaped monster threatening Puerto Rico's beaches

programme.title: Devil's Triangle
programme.desc: When a group of marine biologists crash land in the Bermuda Triangle, they realize they have stumbled into the lost city of Atlantis. But they quickly discover the city isn't friendly, and its humanoid inhabitants are planning worldwide domination using the piles of weapons and technology that have fallen through the Triangle over the centuries.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.

programme.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
programme.desc: When a Category 7 hurricane pummels New York, the surging flood waters bring thousands of sharks.

programme.title: Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No!
programme.desc: When a mass of Sharknados threatens America's East Coast, chainsaw-wielding hero Fin must again risk his life to save his children on spring break. But as he fights his way south, the Sharknados merge and grow bigger than ever before.

programme.title: Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No!
programme.desc: When a mass of Sharknados threatens America's East Coast, chainsaw-wielding hero Fin must again risk his life to save his children on spring break. But as he fights his way south, the Sharknados merge and grow bigger than ever before.

programme.title: Shark Week
programme.desc: A group of complete strangers find themselves isolated by a wealthy madman on his island compound. They are forced into a horrifying gauntlet where they must survive a barrage of ever deadlier species of shark.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: Enders, Zombies, Wild Beasts, and whatever twisted horrors The Man can dish out, none of it stops Addy in her pursuit of Lucy. Meanwhile, Lucy makes The Man's life a living hell, summoning all manner of Zombie obstacles.

programme.title: Heretics
programme.desc: Recovered footage documents the horror of a group teens who break into the abandoned Simmons House. What begins as a thrill-seeking adventure turns into a nightmare as they discover a dark cult intent on sacrificing them one by one.

programme.title: 8213: Gacy House
programme.desc: A group of paranormal investigators enter the home of serial killer John Gacy, hoping to find evidence of paranormal activity. As the evening progresses it seems the investigators are not prepared for the horror still within the house.

programme.title: Paranormal Entity
programme.desc: A paranormal investigator who was wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his sister finds footage of demons killing her.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln vs Zombies
programme.desc: While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Three strangers earn their way into the team and take a keen interest in Murphy. As their interest in Murphy takes a deadly turn, he must use his emerging zombie qualities to save the rest of our heroes.

programme.title: Almighty Thor
programme.desc: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

programme.title: We Were Nowhere Near the Grand Canyon
programme.desc: Driven by a horde onto sacred Native American grounds, our Heroes find two distinct halves of the same tribe trying to survive two separate ways. The "zunami" is bearing down on them all and their very survival at stake.

programme.title: The Black Rainbow
programme.desc: In a mind bending finale, the secret of Warren's dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination, the "Black Rainbow" drone launch facility.

programme.title: Atlantic Rim: Resurrection
programme.desc: Mech-bots, with even bigger and badder weapons than their predecessors, attempt to stop bio-mechanical monsters from descending on LA. But the monsters are strong too, leaving the pilots of the mech-bots scrambling to defeat the creatures.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: A race of alien robots has conquered the Earth and forced humanity underground. After three hundred years of domination, a small group of humans develop a plan to defeat the mechanical invaders in the ultimate battle between man and machine.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Whaley House
programme.desc: When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: Alien Origin
programme.desc: Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes the horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.

programme.title: Arctic Apocalypse
programme.desc: A massive influx of glacial melting triggers a new ice age in the Northern Hemisphere, forcing a family to make their away the across ice-covered landscape before they are frozen out for good.

programme.title: Frenemies
programme.desc: Doc and Our Heroes are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working Barber Shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters

programme.title: Evil Nanny
programme.desc: A couple hires a live-in nanny, who soon starts showing her neglectfulness. However, the nanny established legal residency in the home, embarking the couple on a legal battle to reclaim their home.

programme.title: The Anacondas
programme.desc: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

programme.title: The Murphy
programme.desc: Citizen Z finds himself battling thawed zombies and unable to communicate with the team. In a desperate attempt to help our Heros out on their quest to get to the CDC, Citizen Z issues an on air bounty for Murphy.

programme.title: Exorcism The Possession Of Gail Bowers
programme.desc: Based on one of the true incidents that inspired THE EXORCIST, a psychiatrist suggests that the parents perform an actual Catholic exorcism on their daughter, who actually believes she is possessed.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: After an alien space craft appears above Washington, D.C., a disparate band of residents in a small Connecticut town must fight off a unit of alien soldiers on the hunt for the President of the United States after his escape chopper crash lands nearby.

programme.title: Warren's Wedding
programme.desc: Shaken by the death of one of the group and losing faith in Warren's dream, our Heroes come upon a group of evil "Zuggalo" clown-style bandits torturing a captive.

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
programme.desc: Det. Amelia Van Helsing hunts a killer of young women. All evidence leads to the untouchable Count Dracula.

programme.title: AE Apocalypse Earth
programme.desc: A group of refugees from Earth land on an exotic planet, where they must fight ruthless aliens to survive.

programme.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: In this modern retelling of the classic tale, facing certain defeat, Merlin banishes the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth, hell-bent on destroying every last descendant of King Arthur and his Knights.

programme.title: Battle For Pandora
programme.desc: After a help signal from a research vessel makes it back to Earth, the Space Force sends a rescue ship to Pandora. They discover Pandora is already inhabited by a highly evolved species that won't give up their Earthling prisoners without a fight.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: Enders, Zombies, Wild Beasts, and whatever twisted horrors The Man can dish out, none of it stops Addy in her pursuit of Lucy. Meanwhile, Lucy makes The Man's life a living hell, summoning all manner of Zombie obstacles.

programme.title: Fracking Zombies
programme.desc: In need of gas, the team follows a suspicious stranger to a damaged oil refinery deep inside a New Jersey no-go zone packed with zombies.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.title: The Thanksgiving Episode
programme.desc: The entire Kingston-Persons clan is at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, but Suzanne's forgotten one thing, the turkey.

programme.title: The Fight Party Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne's book group and Nick's boxing-match party collide in the family room on the same night, resulting in knock-out clashing.

programme.title: The Cooking Episode
programme.desc: Nick and Suzanne go head to head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is "easy" and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

programme.title: The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode
programme.desc: Nick secretly plans a surprise for Suzanne to help her overcome a traumatic childhood experience.

programme.title: The Career Day Episode
programme.desc: For Career Day, Nick serves as a guest speaker for Kevin's class, but his message ultimately confuses Kevin's classmates.

programme.title: The Salsa Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne enlists in a salsa-dancing class with Nick, but her controlling nature soon becomes an issue.

programme.title: The Green Episode
programme.desc: The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

programme.title: The Ghost Dog Episode
programme.desc: Nick, Suzanne, and Kevin pull pranks on each other, but their addiction leads to a near-death experience.

programme.title: The We Ain't Going Out Like That Episode
programme.desc: When Nick tries to be spontaneous, but Suzanne resists and instead plans a date night that fails, they attempt to be spontaneous together--until they realize it's better if she makes plan.

programme.title: The Suzanne Theft Auto Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project. Elsewhere, Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.

programme.title: The Second Black President Episode
programme.desc: Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

programme.title: The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode
programme.desc: Kevin's burgeoning career as a child actor has a negative fallout when a potential big break goes to his head. Ted Lange guest stars.

programme.title: The Black Friday Episode
programme.desc: Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Here, Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

programme.title: The Parent Teacher Trap Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne serves on a committee at Kevin's school, but complications arise when her fellow female members disrespect her---but adore Nick.

programme.title: The She Got Game Night Episode
programme.desc: When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

programme.title: The Mother's Day Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne and Marilyn convene for a spa weekend for Mother's Day, but friction soon mounts between the two.

programme.title: The Credit Check Episode

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.desc: In a grim bid to protect her man, Tiaira Miller finds herself embroiled in deceit after Gregory Jones murders his pregnant ex; in South Bend, her tangled web of lies and hidden evidence leads to a tragic unraveling.

programme.title: A Volatile Situation
programme.desc: When a young boy discovers his pregnant mother fatally shot inside their home, investigators are determined to bring her killer to justice; as they uncover details about her love life, a killer driven by a heartless motive emerges.

programme.title: Jeremiah Anderson
programme.desc: When Quinn and Vince get handed the cold case of an 11-year-old's murder, they start tracking down old leads to bring new light to the case; as they dig deeper, a former connection to one of the killers may be the lead they need to solve this murder.

programme.title: Jonathan Kemp and Joshua Watson
programme.desc: Quinn and Vince investigate the death of a man found lying in the leaves with a gunshot wound to his torso, but as they look into it, they learn about a second victim; to find the killer, they'll have to unravel a series of carjackings and stories.

programme.title: When Love Kills: The Falicia Blakely Story
programme.desc: At 16 and already a mother, Falicia is at odds with her mom and soon begins working at a strip club. She meets Dino, a man who quickly pulls her into a dangerous life of crime that changes everything she knows.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Police unearth a sinful conspiracy when they investigate the murder of a pastor's wife.

programme.title: A Monster in the Making
programme.desc: When a woman at the peak of her career is found brutally murdered, investigators struggle to make sense of it all; as the evidence leads them to her killer, it's apparent he has tasted blood and now he wants more.

programme.title: By Any Means Necessary
programme.desc: A young woman finds solace in a new boyfriend after her father passes away; he ropes her into one of his criminal schemes; she finds herself in the midst of a brutal bloodbath.

programme.title: Love and Lies
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a young mother reunites with her childhood crush, but her new man is guarding a deadly secret that will put her and her son's lives in danger; when she gets caught in the crosshairs, she must choose to save her man or herself.

programme.title: Man, or Monster?
programme.desc: A heartbreak sends a vivacious mother of seven into the arms of a wealthy gentleman; after nearly a decade together, she discovers the monster under the mask, a notorious gang leader being hunted by the FBI and leaving a trail of bodies behind him.

programme.title: Greed: A Seven Deadly Sins Story
programme.desc: When interior decorator Zuri Maxwell meets handsome benefactor and entrepreneur Godfrey Anderson, she compromises the values and morals that should guide her in an effort to be part of the moneyed world she so desperately wants to enter.

programme.title: Loved to Death
programme.desc: A once-loving relationship turns deadly.

programme.title: Under the Influence
programme.desc: A woman's life is thrown into a dangerous tailspin after ending an affair with the dangerous lover she met in Alcoholics Anonymous.

programme.title: Deadly Duo
programme.desc: After a rancher finds the body of a young man in his field, detectives' only lead is the last person on the victim's call log; days later, another body is found under similar circumstances.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: When a promising young life is cut short on the streets of Chicago, a community bands together to demand real change in the South Side's gang-riddled neighborhoods.

programme.title: Murder Most Foul
programme.desc: When a Miami man's wife reports him missing, police set out to learn what happened to him; they learn troubling secrets of addiction and infidelity; when a foul odor permeates the neighborhood, they wonder if the truth is closer to home.

programme.title: Twice the Terror
programme.desc: After single mother, Shania Copeland, and her neighbor Leotis Lester are shot dead, detectives use witness testimony and surveillance to piece together the truth behind a senseless crime that never should have been committed.

programme.title: A Monster in the Making

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Prepping for surgery; the Level 4 project.
programme.desc: Stacey walks through the challenges of taking a new frame and components, fitting it to an old, vintage body and all the things to think about while doing it.

programme.title: The Hot Rod Coupe: Fitting Body and Sheet Metal - Mighty Mite
programme.desc: Stacey continues to fit the old '40 Chevy body on the new replacement frame; he rolls in the "Mighty Mite" for some simple fuel system upgrades.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Jeepster: Moving on up to a level 2 Restoration
programme.desc: Stacey kicks it up a notch and moves on to a level two restoration, including mechanical and cosmetic, on an old Jeepster.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: The Shining
programme.desc: Stacey shows how to assess the condition of the paint and body on a project and lays out some of the factors involved in deciding between restoring old paint, or completely re-painting the vehicle.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Sasquatch or Swamp Sprite
programme.desc: Stacey manages to find a Thiokol Swamp Spryte, a rare all-terrain vehicle with a distinct footprint, and rolls it into the shop.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Swamp Spryte: Making Tracks
programme.desc: The Thiokol Swamp Spryte is back in the shop for some much-needed restoration, and replacing the aluminum skin so she will float again; Stacey rolls in the Lil' Red Wagon for some new suspension and 50 years of Skyjacker history.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: The Painless Wiring Way
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique story of Painless Performance and how they went from making wiring harnesses in a garage to one of the most influential companies in the automotive aftermarket.

programme.title: The McLaren M6GT Story and Building Your Own Replica
programme.desc: Stacey takes a look at the supercar, McLaren M6GT; with only a handful made, the originals are collectors' items; Stacey reveals the new M6GT component car that can be built from Retroformance.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: McLaren Mid-Engine Madness and a Bundle of Snakes
programme.desc: The M6GT replica is back in the shop, and it gets serious as Stacey stuffs a 600+ HP Kaase engine into the aluminum monocoque and layers it with an exquisite bundle of snakes exhaust system from GP Headers. If you've ever dreamed of owning a modern mid-engine car with the look of a classic McLaren, this kit is for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Getting the perfect project picture and making your stereo KICK!
programme.desc: Showing people how to take the ultimate picture of their project; Stacey sits down with KICKER to look at how the audio world has changed.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Cornwell Tools and 20 Years of Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is not only showcasing 20 years of a how-to show, but also the tools that make it happen; he dives into the world of video games and pinball to show where they started, where they went and where they are now.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Stripping Paint and Restoring Panels and Parts
programme.desc: Ins and outs of stripping paint and what you might expect to see once it's done; next, Stacey walks through the steps of restoring headlight buckets.

programme.title: The Power Wagon Rules
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique history of how a WWII vehicle became the first mass-produced civilian 4x4 truck; he upgrades the electrical and fuel systems on a '49 Power Wagon, so you can drive it safely.

programme.title: The National Museum of Military Vehicles
programme.desc: Stacey visits the National Museum of Military Vehicles to check out the gear that shaped history and some of the veteran outreach programs that people can get involved with.

programme.title: The Great Crate Debate
programme.desc: Crate engine or old school; Stacey walks you through how to choose the right components to put together a special drivetrain that performs or looks the way you want it to; he drops one in his '59 Apache pickup!

programme.title: Power Wagon - A New Day Dawning...The Rist of the M6GT
programme.desc: The M6GT is back, but now she's a running, driving car, and a prototype of the car that is available from Retroformance; Stacey goes through the design, development and trial and error it takes to bring a new component car to the market.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ -- Mustang Transmission Swap
programme.desc: Stacey takes an old, beat-up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step; he shows you how to replace an old automatic transmission with a quick-shifting Tremec T5 5-speed and how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

programme.title: Show Truck With a Diesel Twist and Capping a Gladiator
programme.desc: Stacey looks at a new twist on tool storage and sets up a Jeep Gladiator for your outdoor adventure needs!

programme.title: The Stunt Double Final Reveal
programme.desc: The Stunt Double is back in the shop for its reveal and payoff; inspired by the FALL GUY truck, the Stunt Double is a ground up, frame off build of a square body Chevy truck that pays tribute to the stunt world.

programme.title: The Mod Rod, Stripping and Prepping a Cab
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in one of the show cars of the 1970s, the Mod Rod; after that, he shows how to properly disassemble the cab or body of your project and pre-fit some new components at the same time.

programme.title: The Datsun 240Z -- A Sports Car for the Masses
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a 1970s Datsun 240Z; he digs into the history of these cars and shows some of the ways to deal with the fragile parts and panels.

programme.title: Digging Into the Datsun 240Z Engine and Drivetrain
programme.desc: The 240Z project is back in the shop as Stacey digs into the magic of the original straight-six engine and drivetrain; he introduces you to the vintage Little Debbie's delivery truck with a sound system.

programme.title: Datsun 240Z Suspension and Super Pull of the South
programme.desc: Stacey rolls the 24Oz onto the lift to lay out the new brakes and suspension, adding a few race-inspired components to take the braking and handling to a different level; he showcases America's oldest motorsport, the tractor pull.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Old Truck, Old Frame, New Game
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a well-worn '59 Chevy Apache pickup and shows how to approach a project, whether you are keeping it original or planning on modifying it.

programme.title: Making the Bed on a Classic Truck
programme.desc: Stacey digs into building a brand-new bed for the '59 Apache right beside the old one!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Long Train Running
programme.desc: Stacey goes out on the rails to take a look at the restoration of the Legendary 576 Steam Locomotive.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Swamp Spryte Axles and Tracks and McLaren M6GT Chassis Testing
programme.desc: Swamp Sprite Axles and Tracks and McLaren M6GT Chassis Testing.

programme.title: The Dirt Bird
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the Joe Dirt side of things and how an old, beat up Daytona made it cool to drive old, rusty junk; after that, he shows what it takes to make a high-end replica of a down-and-dirty car.

programme.title: The Face Off
programme.desc: Stacey demonstrates how to change a four-headlight classic Chevy truck into a two-headlight classic Chevy truck, just by changing some sheet metal. Is it as easy as it looks, or are there some hidden challenges waiting to bite you?

programme.desc: An Ontario man flings into a tornado; a helicopter and jet ski rescue team go into an intense flood; an avalanche crashes a party; an adventurer survives being trapped upside down in a raging river in Papua New Guinea.

programme.title: SuperTornado: Anatomy of a Megadisaster
programme.desc: The 2011 Super Tornado carved a mile wide path of destruction through Joplin, Missouri.

programme.title: Lake Geneva: The Giant Tsunami
programme.desc: In 563 AD, Geneva was destroyed by a tsunami, and it could happen again.

programme.title: Tsunami: Facing the Global Threat
programme.desc: Tsunamis are so sudden and powerful that in a matter of minutes, they can wipe out a coastline.

programme.title: Why Our Forests Are Burning Up
programme.desc: A group of experts studying the range and impact of megafires examine why these blazes are beyond control, what makes them insatiable and what is causing the crisis.

programme.title: How to Survive on a Burning Planet
programme.desc: A team of experts introduces both ancient and newly discovered fire prevention techniques that can help confront the era of megafires to protect homes and families.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Floods are a growing threat to our planet, posing engineering and technological challenges.

programme.title: 1991: Ferrari vs. Alfa Romeo
programme.desc: Keith and Josh reflect on classic vehicles from 1991, including a Ferrari Testarossa and an Alfa Romeo Spider.

programme.title: Survivor Sting Ray
programme.desc: Keith Martin and Josh Nasar attend a Barrett-Jackson auction event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they drive a low-mileage Ferrari 512 TR and a survivor 1967 Corvette.

programme.title: Quick Silver Ford GT
programme.desc: Josh takes a spin in a 2005 Ford GT, a sports car inspired by the 1960s GT40 that achieved success at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

programme.title: Multi-Million Dollar Miura SV
programme.desc: A rare Lamborghini Miura SV, one of only five single-sump SVs sold new to the United States, hits the auction block in Arizona.

programme.title: Last Air-Cooled 911 Turbo
programme.desc: Keith cruises in a restored Alfa Romeo Giulietta Spider Veloce; Josh drives a 1997 Porsche Turbo S, which was the last 911 Turbo manufactured with an air-cooled engine.

programme.title: Mopar Muscle
programme.desc: Vehicles at a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., include a 1967 Shelby GT500 Fastback and a 1970 Plymouth 'Cuda with an original 440 Six-Pack.

programme.title: 365 GTB/4 Daytona
programme.desc: Keith and Josh attend a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they find a beautifully restored Chevrolet Chevelle SS LS5 and test out a Porsche 930 Turbo; Keith gets behind the wheel of a Ferrari 365 GTB/4 Daytona.

programme.title: The GNX -- Buick's Last Muscle Car
programme.desc: Keith Martin and Josh Nasar encounter plenty of muscle at a Barrett-Jackson collector car auction in Scottsdale, Ariz., including a Pontiac GTO Judge and a 1987 Buick GNX.

programme.title: Land

programme.title: Water

programme.desc: The Hot Summer Nights classic car show rolls into town for a day of fun, but things turn really hot that night when there is an outbreak of bar fights; Officer Rosenberg picks up a pair of underage shoplifters and gives them a valuable life lesson.

programme.title: Bikefest
programme.desc: One hundred thousand roaring motorcycles roll into the Lake of the Ozarks region for the seminal event of the season; the Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must team up with the State Troopers.

programme.title: Disturbance In Progress
programme.desc: As summer rolls on, the police officers try to keep the Lake of the Ozarks community safe; Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula gets called to the aid of a bloodied and concussed bar patron lying in the road.

programme.title: Crack the Case
programme.desc: Lost puppies, alleged pickpockets and bachelor parties keep the officers policing the Lake of the Ozarks on their toes; on the Strip Lake Ozark PD Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula must remove a rowdy woman causing trouble at one of the bars.

programme.title: Refusal To Comply
programme.desc: Summer at the Lake of the Ozarks heats up as Cpl. Stephen Riner investigates a road rage case; K9 officer Cpl. Caleb Harvey and his dog Donzi search a vehicle suspected of carrying drugs.

programme.title: Hot Summer Night
programme.desc: The Hot Summer Nights classic car show rolls into town for a day of fun, but things turn really hot that night when there is an outbreak of bar fights; Officer Rosenberg picks up a pair of underage shoplifters and gives them a valuable life lesson.

programme.title: A Dying Art
programme.desc: Art comes to the picturesque Midsomer village of Angel's Rise with the opening of a new sculpture park. When its launch is marred by murder, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to get creative if they are to crack a case where art imitates death, and everything has a deeper meaning.

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it is not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

programme.title: Harvest of Souls
programme.desc: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death arrive in Whitcombe Mallet; the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse.

programme.title: The House in the Woods
programme.desc: With the help of Acting DC Ben Jones, Barnaby investigates the garrotting of a husband and wife outside a deserted cottage near Midsomer Newton. Despite a reputation for being haunted, Winyard is a magnet for villagers, developers and conservationists. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from rumour in order to reveal the cottage's secrets - and catch the killer.

programme.title: Dead Letters
programme.desc: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

programme.title: Vixen's Run
programme.desc: The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

programme.title: Down Among the Dead Men
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Four Funerals and a Wedding
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

programme.title: Country Matters
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Death in Chorus
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Last Year's Model
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

programme.title: The Dagger Club
programme.desc: The crime drama returns for a new series. The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: Murder by Magic
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: The Ballad of Midsomer County
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates whether a ballad made famous by a late, lamented folk singer could have been the inspiration for a murder. Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: A Vintage Murder
programme.desc: Barnaby tries to find out just who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery - what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: The Christmas Haunting
programme.desc: It may be Christmas, but Charlie is given no time to familiarise himself with his new surroundings. He finds himself thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows, as furniture maker and serial philanderer Conor Bridgeman is stabbed to death with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at the manor house.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire. The crimes appear to be inspired by the macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.

programme.title: Wild Harvest
programme.desc: When wealthy farmer Martin Strickland is covered in truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads to restaurant Wyvern House and its tyrannical celebrity chef Ruth Cameron.

programme.title: The Flying Club
programme.desc: The owner of Finchmere Airfield drops dead from a plane. Astonished, Barnaby and Nelson enter the world of stunt pilots and aviation heroes, and discover a web of lies and intrigue.

programme.title: The Killings of Copenhagen
programme.desc: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

programme.title: Dance with the Dead
programme.desc: When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. However, Simon Bright was not alone - as he was hit on the head before he died. Where is his girlfriend, newcomer Laura Sharp? What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: The Animal Within
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: King's Crystal
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: The Axeman Cometh
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Death and Dust
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: A Picture of Innocence
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: They Seek Him Here
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of 'The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Death in a Chocolate Box
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: The Dogleg Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: The Black Book
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hodgson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the 'beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: The Glitch
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Small Mercies
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: The Great and the Good
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: The Dagger Club
programme.desc: The crime drama returns for a new series. The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: The Hidden Inhabitants of Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet's most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth's biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: The Queen of the Night

programme.title: Winter Time
programme.desc: Winter is the toughest test that all the Mediterranean forest's inhabitants have to pass. At that time of the year, we can see fully that life will find a way forward even in the worst circumstances.

programme.title: Comfort Kissed by Fire

programme.title: Pasta Pasta Pasta
programme.desc: Piled with pasta love: pork bolognese tortellini with cheese rose, soft ricotta gnudi in tomato sauce, creamy gorgonzola pasta with pancetta and charred veggies.

programme.title: Sweet Tooth Comfort
programme.desc: A sugar-fueled episode featuring candied-orange and caramelized white chocolate blondies with orange cream cheese icing.

programme.title: Comforting Baked Goods
programme.desc: Baked goodness reigns with cheddar-chive biscuits, poached eggs with country gravy, and a Dutch-style apple-cranberry pie spotlighting autumn flavors.

programme.title: Get to Know Your Grains
programme.desc: Cucumbers with whole wheat couscous; toasted grain soup; baked whole wheat penne and ceci beans.

programme.title: Brunch for a Bunch
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a brunch menu with a table to match! There's a blueberry smoothie bowl, potato rosti, shakshuka, stuffed French toast and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Rice Bowl
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Rice Bowl! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Carlow to London, England
programme.desc: Sheila Kirwan lives in Clonegal, Co.Carlow. Sheila lives with her husband Joe who is also a very good cook when needed. They grow a lot of their own produce, both fruit & veg, and like to attend the local farmer markets weekly in Enniscorthy.

programme.title: My Friend Linh
programme.desc: Hanoi, Vietnam: Tony returns to his beloved Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday, Tet. Together, the friends enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Mad Tony: The Food Warrior
programme.desc: Sydney, Australia: Bourdain embarks on a pilgrimage through Australia to indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Days, miles and many Australian meals later, Anthony finds himself unable to describe Tetsuya's delicious and well-earned meal.

programme.title: Jennie Garth

programme.title: Walnut Tree Revisited

programme.title: Celebratory Food

programme.title: Outdoor Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs... it is chow time.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melvyn finds himself in seafood galore as he heads to Xiamen, China this week. He meets two different families- one living in a rustic fishing village and the other, the owner of a famous restaurant chain in Xiamen.

programme.title: Far East Feast

programme.title: Abalone

programme.title: Blue Crab

programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: Set in modern-day Greece, Worlds Apart is comprised of three separate narratives, each following a love story between a foreigner and a Greek.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Dirty Dilemma
programme.desc: In today's ever-changing dating landscape, can anyone truly claim to have a pure connection devoid of lies, secrets, and trust issues? For Malika and Kyrie, their love will be pushed to the brink as they face the ultimate test.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Insert Coin
programme.desc: The untold story of how Mortal Kombat, NBA Jam, and other arcade classics were created by a ragtag crew in the back of a Chicago factory. Generating billions of dollars, they rode the wave of the booming 90s arcade scene... until a new enemy appears.

programme.title: The Cran
programme.desc: After a comedian runs into his ex at an open mic, the two become complicit in an absurd revenge crusade that puts them in the crosshairs of a rural cult in Cranwell County.

programme.title: Nothing in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Quinn is a writer dating Ann, a woman twice his age. His best friend Peter is married to Beth but having a bit of a sexual identity crisis. When a connection sparks between Quinn and Beth, it makes all four reevaluate what love means to them.

programme.title: Calla Lily
programme.desc: An experimental drama, Melanie, who was drugged and raped in college. Now ten years later, she is in an abusive relationship and has a child. A chance encounter with someone from her past leads her to re-evaluate her past.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 2
programme.desc: While continuing on their separate journeys, the Lethal Three run into each other again along with a woman they previously helped. There is something suspicious going on involving a local lord though. Will the ronin, samurai, and ninja get involved to help?

programme.title: End of the Wicked Tigers
programme.desc: Hong Kong action superstar Samo Hung helped choreograph and he co-stars in this High Noon-like tale of courage and corruption. In the early 20th century, a crime lord (Han Ying Chieh) has a small town under his thumb until a new police captain arrives to put things in order. Only one brave witness, Ma San (Charles Heung), is willing to help fight against the impossible odds. An array of spectacular fight scenes dominates.

programme.title: Rings Untouchable
programme.desc: Two kickboxers become embroiled in a world of performance-enhancing drugs and ruthless gang-rivalry. Now deadly rivals, the only way to resolve their differences is in a challenge to the death in the ring. When a power-enhancing drug has hallucinogenic side effects on kickboxer, Jack, he refuses to take it, and is then dropped by his manager. Desperate for money, he takes his teammate. Kevin's offer to deliver some cocaine, is a set-up to take the business away from the drug-lord, Henry.

programme.title: Sonny Chiba in Shogun's Samurai - Yagyuicizoku no Inbou: Episode 1
programme.desc: Following the massive success of the 1978 movie version, this TV series is newly produced by returning faces such as Director Kinji Fukasaku and actors Sonny Chiba and Kinnosuke Yorozuya. After the death of the second Tokugawa shogun Hidetada, his sons Iemitsu and Tadanaga shed family blood over the succession of the dynasty. Iemitsu's swordmaster Munenori Yagyu leads the Yagyu clan with his oldest son Jubei Yagyu and lends their swords to Iemitsu as they throw themselves into a bloody conflict.

programme.title: Mission Dynamo aka American Force 5: Mission Dynamo
programme.desc: The Vietnam War, and terrorists led by Torosky battle it out with South-Vietnamese guerrilla forces, assisted by the American Army. But for squad leader Merlin and private first class Bill the war has become so meaningless that they don't care anymore. After seeing more and more of their friends die, they decide to desert, but soon discover that there is no sanctuary in the jungle, when it's only a matter of time before Torosky's men will catch up with them.

programme.title: Enter the Panther
programme.desc: In this martial arts action movie, a young kung fu master seeks vengeance upon the villains who murdered a prominent miner.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 13
programme.desc: When Sengoku and the others arrive in a town based around prostitution, they are faced with a dilemma about the women who want to escape. The Tengu Bandits are also stirring up trouble.

programme.title: Sleeping Fist
programme.desc: Kam an undercover cop plans to report the crimes committed by Cho and his thugs. Beaten in a fight he is lucky Kid is nearby to rescue him and introduces him to Old Fox (Simon Yuen), who teaches them both Sleeping Fist Kung Fu.

programme.title: Enter the Game of Death
programme.desc: Kung Fu idol Bruce Le, takes on the mantel of the late Bruce Lee and delivers a powerhouse performance in what many consider to be his best film to date. Loosely based on Lee's original concept, and filmed in the actual location Lee had originally intended to use, Le does battle with a whole array of opponents, including the nunchaku master, snake fist fighter, wing chun expert, and a master of the mystic art of Silat.

programme.title: Master of Flying Daggers
programme.desc: Night Orchid is a notorious nickname attributed to a mysterious character that kills women, leaving an orchid as a signature after the murder. Only the Master of flying daggers, Chu Liu Hsiang can solve the mystery and restore peace to the martial world.

programme.title: Seven Steps of Kung Fu aka Kung Fu of Seven Steps
programme.desc: Little Tiger the town rascal and a pickpocket is also a kung fu disciple of the patriot Master Lee San Pai. One day Tiger steals a medallion from a stranger that is a member of a powerful gang, let by the White Haired Gerneral, who want to overthrow China with the help of Tibetan Lamas. Lee San Pai plots to beat the gang, but first Little Tiger must become and Kung Fu expert.

programme.title: Against Rascals with Kung Fu
programme.desc: Drunken master Sam the Seed takes on a young sheep herder as his newest disciple and teaches him some special kung tu techniques to help rid the town of a violent menace that has been terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Chinese Stuntman
programme.desc: Bruce Li plays a kung fu expert, who after a series of complicated events becomes a stuntman for a famous kung fu actor. He soon learns that the film's producers are trying to kill him, so they can cash in on his insurance policy.

programme.title: Ninja in the Killing Fields
programme.desc: The ruthless leader of a Ninja Organization plans to expand his drug dealing operation worldwide and a highly trained agent from America's Anti-Drug Agency is given the suicidal mission of seeking out and destroying him first.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Michelle Manu
programme.desc: Carrying the torch for the Hawaiian art of Kaihewalu Lua is Kumu Michelle Manu. Inducted into the Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame in 2016, Manu has been the biggest advocate for promoting Lua across the globe. As the first female master of the art, this DVD takes a look at her life and her history and the impact Lau has had on her life.

programme.title: Ninja Demon's Massacre
programme.desc: Police are hot on the heels of ninjas involved in international espionage and that's got ninja gang leader Willie worried. When the police try to trick him, Willie reaches his boiling point.

programme.title: Shaolin vs Lama
programme.desc: Skilled fighter Sung Li Ting is looking for a Kung Fu master who can beat him in battle and teach him new techniques. Shaolin monk Shao Si Yer introduces Sung Li to the Shaolin teachings, but Sung Li is not allowed to enter the school until the return of a Lama Monk, who stole a secret scroll containing every known fighting style from the monastery 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Seven: Shorinji Kempo
programme.desc: Mixing a martial art with a religios faith can be traced back to China over fifteen hundred years ago. Shorinji Kempo means 'Shaolin Temple Way of the Fist' and is both a fighting art and religion established by Doshin So, known as Kaiso to his many followers around the world. It is a unique combination of Karate style punches and kicks with the fluid throws of Aikido and joint-locks of Jujutsu.

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: Chan is a fighter haunted by his past. He takes a job as a dock worker in a small village. The dock owner steadily abuses his workers. The workers struggle to fight back, but only Chan is strong enough to beat the company bosses and their henchmen.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 3
programme.desc: from Shizu to assassinate Michinao Arima, lord of the Echizen Maruoka domain. Shizu's husband Murase was ordered to commit seppuku for criticizing Michinao as a vassal and died without being allowed to intervene. Shizu's husband Murase was ordered to commit seppuku (ritual suicide) for criticizing Michinao, even though he was a retainer. That night, Itto disappeared, leaving Daigoro behind.

programme.title: Born Invincible
programme.desc: All fear the White Haired Man! Director and producer Joseph Kuo, brings forth what is considered a Kung Fu Hall of Fame masterpiece! Shaw action director Robert Tai and Yuen Woo Ping and his clan join forces to bring a tour de force in action films. Carter Wong is the White Haired hermit, who has mastered Tai Chi, and uses it to deadly perfection.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 19
programme.desc: When Sengoku tries to rescue a young hostage, three "big shots" show up and interfere to save the day. But are they friend or foe?

programme.title: Nine Venoms aka The Nine Demons
programme.desc: After selling his soul to the devil, Joey is given the power to control 9 demons. With their help, Joey must save his childhood friend Gary from a bloody massacre.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 3 - Licensed to Terminate
programme.desc: Alpha, the Prince of Justice, is born to save the world from darkness and to protect mankind from the evil forces of the Black Ninja Empire, and the fearless and powerful Ninja Gordon has been chosen by his dying master to stop the nefarious Ninja Temple from killing this child. Gordon and Temple must confront each other in an ultimate showdown, using the ancient techniques of ninja combat at its best.

programme.title: Super Powerful Man
programme.desc: Fan Siu Wong returns as Riki! A military commander forces a scientist to train an army of super-combatants. The scientist's son, Ricky, formed in the same manner, is the most powerful of them all, giving him the nickname "the King of Invincible Power." The commander sends his four main killers: Wind, Rain, Thunder and Lightning, to try to kill Ricky, but they are easily defeated by him.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Tour
programme.desc: Museum founder and president Michael Matsuda provides a detailed tour of the world's first and only Martial Arts History Museum. You will learn about various forms of martial arts, their cultural impact on China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, the Philippines and Hawaii and how Asian history became part of American history. This is a very exciting tour in which you will learn so much about Asian culture and history and the positive influence on Western society.

programme.title: Golden Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Leader of the Golden Ninja, Max, is responsible for returning the Golden Ninja Warrior Statue to China, but his mortal enemy, the Red Ninja Empire, has sent their best man to stop him. A breath-taking series of events, actions and challenges ensues, as Max teams up with a female ninja to avenge her father's death and take on the might of Sakur

programme.title: 52 Masters: KALI with Alvin Catacutan
programme.desc: Sensei Ford takes a class in the Machida style of karate under Chinzo Machida.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Two: Karatedo
programme.desc: By the time the senior students of Gichin Funakoshi opened the doors of the Japan Karate Association in 1949, Shotokan Karate was already well established. Just six months after Funakoshi's death in 1957, the JKA held the first JKA All Japan Karate Championship and opened the door to Karate as a sport. Tatsuya Naka, 7th dan, a past winner of the All Japan Championships, is a new generation of JKA instructor.

programme.title: Dark Lady of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Pearl Chang portrays the Butterfly Bandit, a Robin Hood figure who wears an outlandish winged costume who literally flies and crawls along ceilings.

programme.title: Return of the Chinese Boxer
