programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: The Haunted Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits.

programme.title: Haunted and Cursed Magpie Mines
programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Ghost Dimension investigate claims of paranormal activity and a curse that has been set on to the land. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.title: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: The Haunted Mill Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mil, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, is now haunted by shadow figures and they appear to want to make themselves known.

programme.title: The Night Before the Storm
programme.desc: In this special episode, its the night before Sean and Bex are joined by their celebrity guest and they checkout The Black Horse in Pluckley Village to investigate the paranormal hauntings at the most haunted pub in the UK.

programme.title: Haunted Weir Mill
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team visit Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport. Dating back to 1790 this mill has seen accidents, suicides, murder and even occult practices. Will the team encounter the spirits or friendly, benevolent children or something darker and more malevolent that lurks within the maze?

programme.title: An Unexpected Haunted Adventure
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: Witches and Vampires Haunting Saint James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings. Will the team survive the night unscathed? Will they encounter witchcraft or a vampire that is believed to roam the grounds to this very day?

programme.title: The Wheatsheaf Horror
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: Field of Ghosts
programme.desc: Markie Beason has always sensed spirits in her home, but her family dismisses her fears-until the ghosts shift their focus to her. As the terrifying encounters intensify, Markie grows desperate for answers. When her father finally believes her, he calls in paranormal investigators to uncover the spirits' identities and help bring peace to their haunted home.

programme.title: Angels and Demons
programme.desc: When a demon haunts the home of Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats , psychics, priests and paranormal investigators fail to resolve the issue. Only Kathie herself can conquer the dark entity ... with the help of an angel.

programme.title: Blood Visions
programme.desc: The Johnson family has found what they consider their perfect home in Michigan. But it turns out to be haunted, and a demon targets their son for possession. Only the power of prayer can restore peace and sanity.

programme.title: The Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: Vision of Terror
programme.desc: After losing her husband in a tragic accident, Stacy Stowe hears ghostly sounds and assumes it's his spirit-until her daughter insists it's something evil. Dark figures prowl the home, and attacks escalate. A paranormal cleanser brings temporary peace, but a new psychic warns that unless Stacy closes the portal, the evil will never leave.

programme.title: Spirits of the Dead
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley's dream of running a horse-riding business turns into a nightmare when strange occurrences plague their New Hampshire farm. Their son hears eerie sounds, and Joanne senses a dark presence. As financial struggles mount, their horses fall mysteriously ill. When the spirit turns violent and threatens their child, Joanne calls on a Shamballa master to fight the evil force.

programme.title: The Demon's Revenge
programme.desc: Tiffany McKinnon, Billy Quattlebaum, and his daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse in Franklin, VA. While Tiffany tries to make peace with a lingering spirit, a darker entity lurks in the shadows, tormenting the family. Determined to stay, Tiffany seeks help from paranormal investigators and the church, hoping to expel the evil before it destroys their lives.

programme.title: Wicked Eviction
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, a single mother of three, relocates her family for a fresh start but her dream turns to a nightmare when her family is antagonized by multiple entities. Desperate, Tammy finds a paranormal team who reveal the true evil in the home.

programme.title: Hungry Ghosts
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: After Linda returns from India, her daughter Kara experiences terrifying events, convinced their home is haunted. Linda dismisses it-until she has her own chilling encounter. Realizing Kara was right, they turn to a clairvoyant for answers. As the truth of their haunting unravels, they must find a way to confront the unknown before it takes hold of their lives.

programme.title: Where Evil Lurks
programme.desc: The Shea family's Arkansas home seems peaceful until eerie voices and ghostly noises shatter the quiet. Believing it's the spirit of a young boy who died there, they feel at ease until a darker entity emerges, bringing terror. When one of their children suffers a serious injury, they fear the spirit is to blame. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to psychic mediums to confront the evil.

programme.title: Ghostly Voices
programme.desc: Angelina believes her home's ghost is harmless, but when her daughter starts hearing eerie voices, doubt creeps in. Medical tests reveal nothing, leading her parents to fear a supernatural cause. Desperate for answers, they seek help from a priest and a medium, who uncover a troubled spirit in need of peace-one that must be confronted before their daughter's fate is sealed.

programme.title: Nightmare Upstairs
programme.desc: Dream House When the VanLandingham family moves into an Arkansas home, their young daughters become the target of a supernatural attack by dark entities. After fruitless efforts by a Pastor and paranormal investigator, they decide to abandon their 'dream house' forever.

programme.title: The Haunting of Allen House
programme.desc: The historic Allen House in Arkansas is haunted. Mark and Rebecca Spencer knew it when they bought it. They investigate the cause of the haunting, discover the home's secret past and a previous owner who committed suicide.

programme.title: Legend Trippers
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: Evil Rises
programme.desc: While recovering from surgery, Jacinda Rearick notices orbs in photos, believing them to be her late parents. But when her son sees a dark entity and shadowy tentacles attack her, she realizes something sinister has invaded their home. As the entity grows more violent, Jacinda turns to local investigators, desperate to rid her house of the encroaching evil.

programme.title: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: The Sherman family's dream life turns into a nightmare when 17-year-old Macy is targeted by a terrifying entity. As her mother and sister experience paranormal activity, their skeptical father remains unconvinced-until he hears an unseen presence speak. With the spirit refusing to leave, the desperate family turns to experts for help before it's too late.

programme.title: Demons Never Die
programme.desc: After moving to the suburbs, Bill and Amanda Toler dismiss eerie noises-until Bill is scratched and Amanda sees an inhuman face. Paranormal investigators uncover a portal in their home and a demon that followed Bill from his job at a penitentiary. In a race against time, they must close the portal and banish the entity before it destroys the family.

programme.title: House of Sorrows
programme.desc: Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home where four people died of CO poisoning. Strange sounds and ghostly sightings soon turn sinister-Darrin and their dog are attacked. Paranormal investigators cleanse the home, but Darrin unknowingly invites dark forces back, putting his wife and newborn in grave danger. Can they escape the house's tragic fate?

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Strange occurrences in Charles Gonzales' home awaken memories of past paranormal events tied to his uncle's unsolved murder. Seeking answers, he contacts psychic Desiree Page, who warns of a deadly family curse. When a vengeful spirit attacks Charles and his girlfriend, he must confront childhood memories and uncover hidden truths before the entity traps him forever.

programme.title: Love Curse
programme.desc: For years, a dark force stalks Lee Moore in his nightmares. After he and his bride Claire move into their first home, the entity emerges, attacking Claire while she's pregnant. A ghost hunter confirms it's a demon, and experts cleanse the home. But when the hunter returns for an uninvited ritual, Lee falls mysteriously ill. Can demonologists save him before the entity claims his soul?

programme.title: Dark Wrath
programme.desc: Cindy's recurring nightmares of a dark, angry figure intensify as she moves her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Assuming it's just stress, she pushes forward, but soon, her dreams become reality. Her daughters fear their room, and an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. When the entity physically attacks her, Cindy must summon her courage to fight the evil before it harms her family.

programme.title: Demon's Lair
programme.desc: The Cranmer family believes their historic Pittsburgh home is haunted by a harmless ghost-until the activity turns violent. Seeking help from the Catholic Church, they uncover a demon and the home's dark past. As attacks escalate and walls ooze a blood-like substance, they refuse to flee, facing a terrifying battle that culminates in a desperate exorcism.

programme.title: Monster in the Apartment
programme.desc: Morgan Knudson and her friend Bob move into a downtown Edmonton flat, only to discover a dark spirit lurking. While Bob, battling cancer and loneliness, sees a harmless ghostly boy, Morgan senses something sinister. When the entity violently attacks her, she seeks a demonologist who reveals the truth-the spirit is trying to possess Bob, and Morgan must act before it claims his soul.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Randy and Marcy, both in law enforcement, face mounting stress when their son is deployed overseas. Marcy's overwhelming fear awakens a dormant spirit that feeds on her anxiety, growing dangerously powerful. As the presence tightens its grip, Marcy must stay calm and find a way to banish the evil force before it drives her to the brink.

programme.title: Gateway To Evil
programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time--and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her home...and her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has re-ignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.title: The Possessed
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: Ghost Protector
programme.desc: A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. After paranormal experts investigate they uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic Connecticut restaurant, only to be overwhelmed by forces of evil when employees and patrons are attacked. Investigators, mediums and clairvoyants are called in to rid the restaurant of its demonic past.

programme.title: Curse of the Mummy
programme.desc: After a chilling encounter at an Egyptian exhibit, Caleb Weaver is haunted by a relentless entity. Years of torment force him to flee, but when he returns home, the dark force reawakens-stronger than ever. Now, it seeks to possess him and threatens those he loves. With time running out, Caleb turns to a deliverance minister for a final battle against the ancient evil seeking his soul.

programme.title: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette's firefighter husband dies, she moves her daughters to a Long Island hamlet for a fresh start. But eerie discoveries and violent paranormal attacks turn their refuge into a nightmare. Determined to fight back, Jeanette enlists a psychic to uncover the home's dark past and a deliverance minister to confront the relentless evil threatening her family's safety.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron is fascinated by the supernatural, but her son Gene wants no part of it. When they learn their home is haunted, Sandra dives deeper into the paranormal, eventually embracing Wicca. Seeking good fortune, she unknowingly opens a portal to evil. With Gene gone in the military, Sandra must now battle the dark force she unleashed before it consumes her entirely.

programme.title: Echoes of the Past
programme.desc: Libby and Sean Johnson renovate a Vermont home, unaware of its tragic past. Soon, eerie noises fill the night, and their daughter speaks of visiting 'fairies.' As they uncover the home's dark history, ghostly activity escalates to physical attacks. Desperate for answers, Libby turns to paranormal investigators, hoping they can rid the house of restless spirits before it's too late.

programme.title: Echoes from the Grave
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Rebecca's new marriage to Daniel seems perfect, but she hides a lifelong secret-she can see and hear spirits. She has always blocked them out, but when a persistent ghost refuses to be ignored, she can no longer run. Forced to confront the entity, Rebecca must trust Daniel and enlist his help to uncover the truth before it threatens their new life together.

programme.title: The Shadowman
programme.desc: As kids, Tim and Tom Yancey love playing in the Florida woods-until a menacing presence begins watching them. When it invades their bedroom, terror traps them in their own home. With no help in sight, the nightmare follows Tim into adulthood. Decades later, he returns to confront the demon that stole his childhood, determined to reclaim his life once and for all.

programme.title: The Presence
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Cindy Sauer
programme.desc: Deadly Attachment Georgia single Mom Cindy Sauer tries to get over the sudden death of her husband when dark shadows and nightmares convince her that a demon is haunting her and her family. Cindy turns to a Pastor to exorcise the entity before it drives them literally insane.

programme.title: A Haunting in Florida
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: Deaths Door
programme.desc: Victoria Dane of New Mexico awakens from a near-­death experience to discover she is being attacked by a dark, demonic entity. With the help of investigators, she soon realizes she has opened a door to a paranormal world that may never be shut.

programme.title: When the Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits - one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: After marrying Stephen, Angela's childhood nightmares return-only now, the old hag from her dreams appears in waking life. She dismisses it as anxiety until the entity terrorizes her daughter and briefly possesses her son. Realizing the threat is real, Angela, at Stephen's urging, turns to paranormal investigators to fight the relentless evil before it destroys their family.

programme.title: Stalked by Evil
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. As the entity grows stronger, Judy fights to protect her family. When she uncovers the home's violent past, she realizes the spirit is intent on keeping Caressa trapped-and she must act before it's too late.

programme.title: Hell House
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: House of the Dead
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: The Attic
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: The Unleashed
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: Darkness Follows
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: Shape of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: Phantom Room
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: Conjuring Evil
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: Hidden Terror
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: Masks of Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: Heartland Horror
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: Skin Deep

programme.title: Cuda Grace

programme.title: Danger Zone

programme.title: Sacraments

programme.title: Apocalypse Nash

programme.title: Truth and Consequences
programme.desc: The team searches for an actress's assassin; Caitlin moves in with Nash; Inger wants Joe to go to Sweden.

programme.title: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Nash must save Cassidy from drug dealers who mistake her for another woman; Joe meets the person he has been flirting with online.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

programme.title: Curveball

programme.title: Split Decision

programme.title: Get Bananas

programme.title: Kill Switch

programme.title: Rip Off

programme.title: Skin Trade
programme.desc: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Hit and Run

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

programme.title: Line of Sight
programme.desc: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

programme.title: Hard Cell
programme.desc: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

programme.title: Missing Key
programme.desc: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

programme.title: Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Soon after Nash's daughter, Cassidy, joins the Special Investigation Unit, an escaped felon convicted with tainted evidence kidnaps her and Joe.

programme.title: Jump Start
programme.desc: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

programme.title: Lap Dance
programme.desc: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

programme.title: Land Pirates
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

programme.title: ManHunt

programme.title: Double Trouble

programme.title: End Game

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track down former SIU officer Rick Bettina, who escaped during his parole hearing to recover the money he stole.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Nash protects a newscaster from a deranged fan; Joe is caught in the middle of a crime while selling his car.

programme.title: Grave Robbers
programme.desc: Nash takes on the case of a clever con man who fakes his own death after ripping off a dangerous organized crime boss; Joe learns that his mother-in-law smokes marijuana.

programme.title: Bear Trap
programme.desc: Nash and Joe bear down on black market poachers selling animal gall bladders; the office buzzes with rumors of a romance between Nash and Rachel.

programme.title: Recover Me
programme.desc: A wealthy accounting adviser sets Rachel up for a murder, and her lack of cooperation confuses Nash until he discovers a secret from her past.

programme.title: Something Borrowed
programme.desc: Nash is flabbergasted to learn that he's legally married to Tamara Van Zant and comes to the conclusion that she's up to her old tricks again; Nick acts as a "beard" for a lesbian friend.

programme.title: Out of Miami
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Rick Hawks comes back to the Bay Area to transport a key witness in an important drug trafficking case.

programme.title: Slam Dunk!
programme.desc: Nash and Joe investigate the murder of a wealthy lawyer; Cassidy and Rachel are caught in a love triangle.

programme.title: The Partner
programme.desc: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

programme.desc: Two friends take a chance to change their lives and become partners in the world of crime, and build reputations as strong, no nonsense, business women. They soon discover it?s lonely at the top, when their enemies close in on them, while maintaining their own friendship.

programme.desc: While Todd is away at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is back home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on the two. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.

programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

It was supposed to go down like all of the others, except this time, they walk away from the scene with a body on their hands. As long as Tierra sticks to the script and doesn't utter a word, there's nothing to worry about.

programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Bad Girl Revelation
programme.desc: Bora tries to untie herself from her sister's decision while trying to get out of the drug game with her social media profession. Mob boss, Ivan, makes a mistake and sends money electronically for a hit and tries to get his refund.

programme.title: Angel and Demon
programme.desc: When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle "Demon" Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mobb, they instantly become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel's once promising future.

programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

programme.desc: When Emily rents a room from a seemingly kind landlord, she discovers his house hides deadly secrets - including past tenants, jealous lovers, and a dark obsession that may cost her life.

programme.title: Crush
programme.desc: Haunted by her past, a young woman's life is complicated by love, self-discovery, and surrounding violence.

programme.title: Cooperating Criminals
programme.desc: Tony's ambition ignites a powder keg of betrayal. Driven by Bianca's manipulation, he pushes his pill operation, ignoring Jay's warnings. As DEA Agent Harrison closes in, Jay battles his past to protect Tony. A dangerous deal with Marco, escalates the chaos, leading to overdose and murder plots. Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

programme.title: Grimy Situation
programme.desc: After being arrested at a young age during a drug deal gone wrong and spending part of her youth in prison for the attempted murder of Agent Harris, the now-paroled 30-year-old Camille Sanders has to find a way to make money without turning back to a life of crime and violating her parole. Struggling to survive with no source of income coming in, Camille's forced to live a double life to make ends meet while convincing her Parole Officer she's been

programme.title: Concealment 2: Open Marriage
programme.desc: Deandre & Nia, betrayed by each other & blackmailed by their college friend Isis, reluctantly open their marriage. Isis steals their money & disappears. Deandre seeks help to recover his losses. Both are involved in secret affairs, concealing crucial information from their partners, leading to tragic consequences.

programme.title: Holy Hip Hop
programme.desc: Fasten your seatbelt and prepare to experience the explosive world of Spiritually-Enlightening Holy Hip Hop Ministry, Music and Entertainment Glorifying GOD!!!

programme.title: Nothing without God 2: Second Chances
programme.desc: This is the second excerpt in the story of Keenan Robinson, a recent college graduate struggling to keep his head above water and finding his true calling in life. Keenan takes his younger foster brother Marvin under his wing to help guide him to a better walk with GOD. They face many life challenges and obstacles together including life and death decisions.

programme.title: Prodigal Husband
programme.desc: Ex-NFL player Kedar Ellis is depressed about his future after a career ending injury. His loyal wife Lydia encourages him to find another way to make a living. Unbeknownst to him he is tempted, loses faith and leaves. Left alone to run the household, Lydia has to keep the family afloat, but first, she must find faith, strength and forgiveness!

programme.title: Preaching to the Pastor
programme.desc: PREACHING TO THE PASTOR is a musical comedy about the controversy going on at High and Mighty Missionary Baptist Church. The Pastor has a dark secret that may cost him his title and his ministry. In the end, everyone needs to be preached to, including the Pastor.

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Getting out of rehab, losing his girlfriend, and the death of his mother; life has been rough for Travis. Determined to fix his life, Travis gets sober. That is until he meets, Pearl, a girl more dangerous than his addictions.

programme.title: Condemn
programme.desc: College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.

programme.title: God's Purpose
programme.desc: A rip-roaring saga of runaway ambition stars Chicago's own Simeon Henderson ("Chicago PD", "Empire") as an arrogant would-be news anchor whose after-word dalliance with the wrong alluring intern sets off a chain of fateful events. Director Kyle Miller brings a grand sense of melodrama to this story of broken faith and the quest for forgiveness.

programme.title: The Next Day
programme.desc: Will and Desire' meet at a bar and have a one night stand, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy. Shortly after, Desire' sees Will's cousin Ike shoot someone and becomes a witness in the investigation. Five years later after Ike has left town, and Will's name has been cleared, Desire reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren't improving, and she's on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she's forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: Evolver 62
programme.desc: Globally-renowned historian Mark Lewisohn weaves an array of short, sharp stories into a savvy and surprising reveal of a band that's remained both cutting-edge and massively popular. Drawing from his extraordinary archive, Lewisohn zips through a galaxy of real lives and times, weaving curated artefacts into an entertaining narrative.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fianc?e and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

programme.title: 3 Way Poly
programme.desc: A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

programme.title: Widower Syndrome
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal car accident a year ago, Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone. A race of desperation to find the truth, may also reveal Xavier's own sanity.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: Battered Emotions
programme.desc: Rasheada has accepted that her battle with breast cancer is inevitable but her spiritual fight is still as strong as ever. She continues her upbeat facade for friends and family, but is unsure how long it will be until she can no longer compete with her emotional life's journey. Her sister, Tara, and her best friend, Bunny, struggle with their own issues of inner demons and domestic violence, while trying to support Rasheada through her battle.

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

programme.title: Love & Mercy
programme.desc: In the late 1960s, the Beach Boys' Brian Wilson stops touring, produces "Pet Sounds" and begins to lose his grip on reality. By the 1980s, Wilson, under the sway of a controlling therapist, finds a savior in Melinda Ledbetter.

programme.title: The Sapphires
programme.desc: One ambitious manager. Four unknown singers. The tour that put them on the charts wasn't even on a map.

programme.title: Blindsided
programme.desc: A killer (Michael Keaton) terrorizes a blind woman (Michelle Monaghan) in her New York penthouse after murdering her boyfriend.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: Gretta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Gretta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Gretta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Gretta's first album.

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.desc: An outfoxed lawyer (Carrie Fisher) hires an actress (Rosanna Arquette) to seduce her ex-husband (John Sessions) by posing as his ideal woman.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

programme.title: Solstice
programme.desc: While vacationing with friends, a teenager (Elisabeth Harnois) believes that her dead twin sister is trying to contact her.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's long-standing marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book.

programme.title: Campfire Tales
programme.desc: On a desolate highway, several stranded teenagers pass the time by telling scary stories around a makeshift fire.

programme.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
programme.desc: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: 3 Generations
programme.desc: Three of the most acclaimed actors of their generations in a human comedy for today. In this family, change is relative.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Fierce People
programme.desc: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

programme.title: 3 Generations
programme.desc: Three of the most acclaimed actors of their generations in a human comedy for today. In this family, change is relative.

programme.title: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: Crystal Rogers, mother of five, vanishes, leaving her car abandoned in Bardstown, Ky.; a year later her father is shot dead while searching for her; there are multiple cases in a small town shrouded in secrets, and haunted by unsolved killings.

programme.title: Tommy's Box
programme.desc: Stephanie and Dwayne look through Tommy Ballard's box of papers and evidence in Crystal's case.

programme.title: The Search Continues
programme.desc: The FBI grills the brother of Crystal's boyfriend, Nick Houck, a Bardstown police officer; Stephanie and Dwayne follow a search of a lake where cadaver dogs pick up a scent; exploring the scene of a deadly ambush on the Bluegrass Parkway.

programme.title: Cold and Calculating
programme.desc: An FBI profiler offers chilling insights on a potential killer; family members of Bardstown's other victims speak; a mysterious white car is possibly linked to Crystal's disappearance.

programme.title: A Murder Most Foul
programme.desc: With the first anniversary of Tommy Ballard's killing approaching, Stephanie and Dwayne dive deeper into the unsolved cases after a new witness steps forward; an unexpected new lead takes them in an unforeseen -- and intriguing -- direction.

programme.title: Final Days in Bardstown
programme.desc: Stephanie and Dwayne speak with an informant who shares new information about the crimes in Bardstown; they follow up on the informant's claims and discover potential new details unknown to investigators.

programme.title: Everyone Has a Theory
programme.desc: Journalist Maggie Freleng searches for answers in the 2004 disappearance of a nursing student following a car crash in New Hampshire.

programme.title: A Reason to Run
programme.desc: Maggie investigates reasons why Maura Murray secretly drove to New Hampshire and never came home, including a possible pregnancy or an emotional phone call with her sister.

programme.title: After the Crash
programme.desc: There are questions about happened to Maura after she crashed on a rural road in New Hampshire: did she run into the woods, hop into a car with someone she knew and escape to a new life in Canada, or worse, hitch a ride with a dangerous stranger.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: New Hampshire's law enforcement community keeps their findings of Maura's case close to the chest; Maggie explores the theories related to a police conspiracy, hoping to break down a decade-long code of silence.

programme.title: Something Bad Happened
programme.desc: Killers and kidnappers are Maggie's focus as she works to find out if Maura Murray was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: The DNA results are revealed; Maggie seeks the advice of a psychic; a wild lead is pursued at the top of a mountain; Maggie sits down with Maura's family and reveals evidence released by law enforcement for the first time in 13 years.

programme.title: If Something Happens to Me
programme.desc: A young mother in Utah vanishes and the only suspect, her husband, acts suspiciously; Stephanie Bauer examines never-before-seen home video recordings that shed light on the dramatic events surrounding the disappearance of Susan Cox Powell.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: A defensive husband flees justice after the disappearance of his wife drags both of their families down deeper into destruction and tragedy.

programme.title: New Lead
programme.desc: Natalee Holloway disappears from Aruba in May 2005, and her father Dave never stops looking for her; he receives a new lead that could be the key to solving the 12-year-old mystery, but he has suspicions about the source.

programme.title: The Sting
programme.desc: Dave Holloway and a team of investigators pursue a lead that may shed light on his daughter's disappearance, with the goal of obtaining a taped confession and concrete evidence.

programme.title: The Sting: Day 2
programme.desc: The sting operation in New Orleans continues as the investigation team begins running out of time to obtain the necessary information from the co-conspirator.

programme.title: Aruba
programme.desc: TJ and his team head to Aruba to begin phase two of their investigation - attempting to obtain DNA evidence from Natalee's alleged burial site; Dave must convince his informant to go the extra mile.

programme.title: The Burial Site
programme.desc: TJ races to the location where the co-conspirator claims he dug up Natalee's remains in 2010; working with the Aruban authorities, they search for DNA that could lead to convicting those involved in Natalee's disappearance.

programme.title: The Bones
programme.desc: After two years following a lead, the investigators finally have evidence in hand that could answer the 12-year-old mystery of what happened to Natalee Holloway.

programme.title: Modern Family Murder
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a devoutly religious couple, police uncover dark family secrets, leading them to a shocking suspect.

programme.title: Dying to See You
programme.desc: When a popular college student is found slain in the middle of campus, police suspect his friends and lovers might be involved.

programme.title: A Twisted Connection
programme.desc: When a suburban mom is murdered in her own home, investigators chase down an elusive killer that no one saw coming.

programme.title: When Hate Kills
programme.desc: Police in small town Louisiana investigate the mysterious and brutal murder of a beloved neighbor with no known enemies.

programme.title: Killer in Plain Sight
programme.desc: After a college student is viciously murdered and her apartment set ablaze, police untangle a web of relationships to find a killer who's dangerously close to home.

programme.title: New Mexico Massacre
programme.desc: A couple and their special needs son are savagely murdered in rural New Mexico, leading detectives to uncover long-buried secrets in a tight-knit town.

programme.title: Deadly Intentions
programme.desc: A devoted mother about to begin a new life is murdered in her own home; detectives follow the evidence through a tangled web of relationships to unmask the killer.

programme.title: Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: When a loving father and beloved basketball coach is murdered in Tennessee, police decode a confusing array of evidence to unveil a killer who is shockingly close to home.

programme.title: Twisted Betrayal
programme.desc: When a devoted mother with a bright future in show business is ruthlessly gunned down, a number of suspects emerges; just as detectives think they have the killer in their sights, the investigation takes a jaw-dropping turn.

programme.title: Unseen Assassin
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman and his closest friend are found shot execution-style; police have little to go on until a surprising development leads investigators to a killer no one ever suspected.

programme.title: A Genius Murder
programme.desc: When a brilliant scientist and devoted family man is found beaten to death, the evidence leads to arrests, but an astounding revelation turns the investigation on its head.

programme.title: Driven to Murder
programme.desc: When police find the body of a popular taxi driver stuffed inside the trunk of his own car, which is submerged in a river, they struggle to find suspects -- until the truth begins to emerge.

programme.title: Deadly Disrespect
programme.desc: After a 35-year-old analyst for the NSA is fatally stabbed, police look at a number of suspects; detectives close in on the killer, but the investigation takes a shocking turn.

programme.title: Closet Murderer

programme.desc: A young woman is killed in her bedroom, and the evidence appears to point to a clear suspect, but it takes 30 years and new evidence to reveal a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.desc: When an athletic and popular college student is violently murdered in her apartment, police track down several surprising suspects, including one with a disturbing obsession, before crucial evidence unmasks a dangerous predator no one saw coming.

programme.title: Fatal Fast Food
programme.desc: A restaurant is robbed and the night manager murdered, leading police to investigate suspicious co-workers, a disgruntled ex-employee, and a violent serial attacker.

programme.title: A Love Lost
programme.desc: Detectives investigate a secret affair, a kidnapping plot and a racist gang when a young husband-to-be is found shot and stabbed.

programme.title: Nightmare in Shenandoah
programme.desc: When a devoted mother is stabbed to death in a horrifying attack, suspicion falls on those closest to her; a cryptic note and a violent crime spree baffle detectives at first, but they eventually track down a deranged killer no one predicted.

programme.title: Deadly Desires
programme.desc: A vibrant young mother of three is murdered in the safety of her own home and investigators look to a history of troubled romances, but when the case goes cold and police can't find the killer, a phone call leads to a culprit hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: An assassination, a bitter custody dispute and a gunman's cryptic words send police scrambling on an interstate hunt to find the killer of a beloved father and husband.
