programme.desc: When the strangling death of a young mother and bride-to-be baffles police, detectives probe a workplace grievance in search of a killer, before a cherished possession provides a link to the crime and cracks the case wide open.

programme.title: The Ties That Bind
programme.desc: A wealthy trader and father of four is gunned-down at home while his family is tied up in a closet; police dig into affairs, mob links and a missing co-worker, until a new lead and a taped phone call reveal a plot decades later.

programme.title: Wicked Night Out
programme.desc: When a young mother is found dead in a field after a night out, police scour security video to retrace a suspect's steps; the discovery of a second crime scene leads to an arrest, before high-tech forensics reveal a truth no one expected.

programme.title: A Date With Death
programme.desc: A cat-loving and recently divorced young woman dipping her toes back in the dating game is beaten and strangled in a brutal and unusual way; investigators dive into the murky world of online dating to hunt a killer who could be ready to strike again.

programme.title: Twisted Intentions
programme.desc: Detectives discover the badly beaten body of a single young woman left bizarrely staged on her bed; fear in the community grows amid a rash of nearby murders until police are handed a break when a fresh look at old evidence points to the killer.

programme.title: A Silent Death
programme.desc: A beloved teacher and mother of four silently vanishes in the middle of the night; a blood-soaked bedroom and lakeside discovery point police to a killer close to home until mysterious tracks in the mud lead to a culprit no one suspected.

programme.title: Death on the Driveway
programme.desc: When a loving father of two is gunned down on his driveway, police uncover a hidden affair and workplace grudges before a nervous witness and chilling confession reveal a vicious vendetta from a killer no one expected.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: When a family that runs a beloved vet clinic is gunned down, police investigate disgruntled tenants, a pet owner with an ax to grind and an estranged son; the case stalls until detectives uncover a twisted plot by someone who seemed above suspicion.

programme.title: When the Lights Go Out
programme.desc: When a young mother and beloved coworker is found stabbed in her bedroom, investigators are unable to pin down a killer until secret recordings and evidence stashed in a van are found.

programme.title: Blood Runs Thick
programme.desc: An execution-style shooting of a well-loved, self-made couple; early leads take police down a path of greed and desperation until a paper trail leads to a calculated betrayal shockingly close to home.

programme.title: Murder After Midnight
programme.desc: After a Texas mother is found murdered in an office bathroom, her husband admits a disturbing past while police chase down a serial killer; the case goes cold until an oversight leads to a surprise suspect and an FBI manhunt south of the border.

programme.title: Trail of Evidence
programme.desc: When a devoted mother vanishes from home, a series of grisly roadside discoveries take police on a hunt for a killer; detectives follow a path of greed and desperation until a shocking twist leads to a culprit with a bizarre motive.

programme.title: Murder in the Canyon
programme.desc: When an outgoing college student is gunned down, police investigate disapproving roommates, a psychic and an infamous serial killer; decades-old evidence reveals a killer that original detectives had previously overlooked.

programme.title: Carlsbad
programme.desc: A mother of two disappears after a night out at a local bar in New Mexico; investigators race the clock in the hopes of finding her alive, and are eventually stunned by what they uncover.

programme.title: Waterloo
programme.desc: A shooting in broad daylight in the city of Waterloo, Iowa leaves two dead; investigators Camarata and Moller follow a trail of bloody footprints to a list of suspects and an unexpected lead from a knowledgeable confidential informant.

programme.title: Baton Rouge
programme.desc: Women are found brutally murdered and panic strikes Baton Rouge; the city suspects a serial killer is on the loose; in an example of police work at its finest, detectives lead investigators to an unlikely suspect hiding a dark secret.

programme.title: Edmonton
programme.desc: When a hardworking single mother with a history of heart issues is found dead on the front steps of her home, detectives assume she died of natural causes, but as the investigation progresses, it becomes clear foul play was involved.

programme.title: Martin County
programme.desc: In Florida, a devoted mother disappears into the night after tucking her daughter into bed; investigators chase down a trail of leads that include multiple suspects, culminating in a horrifying discovery.

programme.title: Placentia
programme.desc: A mother's only hope of finding her missing 20-year-old daughter rests in the hands of a seasoned investigator from the DA's office, who takes on her case after it's been cold for seven years.

programme.title: Gainesville
programme.desc: After a college freshman goes missing without a trace, concerned friends and family talk to police about his last whereabouts; those conversations, however, raise more questions than answers when they point to a potentially deadly love triangle.

programme.title: Eunice
programme.desc: A wife returns home to find her husband shot dead, and detectives search for the truth for two years.

programme.title: CRESPELLE
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: What's Baking
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: The Power Of Food
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Let's Make Dinner
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Breakfast at Lidia's
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Italian American Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: The Olive Grove
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Potato, Potato
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: A Bright Summer Feast
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: FISH AND SEAFOOD
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Crowd Pleasers
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: It's Pasta Night!
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: The Oven is On
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Baking Bread
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: The Next Chapter
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Super Simple Seared Lamb Chops
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Garden of Goodness
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Sweet and Savory
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Prepare the Harvest
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Sympony of Pasta
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: The Sweet Life in Italy
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Cozy Wintertime Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: The Roast
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Mastering Simplicity
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Here I Come New York!
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: The Risotto Is On
programme.desc: Yellow saffron seafood and leek risotto; how to replenish stock using food scraps from the freezer; barley risotto with cabbage and sausage.

programme.title: Poached Egg
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Tomato Time
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Salt Your Pasta Water!
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Easy Going Recipes
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Treat Yourself
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: POLENTA
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Going Fishing
programme.desc: It's all about freash seafood in this episode with three of Lidia's most requested fish recipes: Clam Brushetta features crusty Italian bread, still warm from the grill with clam sauce; Halibut Baked with Mushrooms in a Lemon and White Wine Sauce is a great weekend meal as is Grouper with Potatoes and Peppers.

programme.title: Italian Style BBQ
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: ROASTING AND BAKING
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: A Warm Welcome
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Ragu
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: A Comforting Casserole
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Slow Cooking
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: My Italian American
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Summertime Fun
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Simply Lidia
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Simple Weekday Dinner Ideas
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: From Italy to America
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Fall's Flavorful Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: The Sweetest Hits
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: QUICK AND DELICIOUS BRAISES
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: A Frugal Feast
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Buonavia
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: My Family's Milk and Cheese
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Southern Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: The Vegetable Patch
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad

programme.title: BRAISING SMALLER CUTS
programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming Braised Chicken Thigh dish with Potatoes and Olives, a family favorite. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Cooking with Wine
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Trio of Heartwarming Pasta
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: What's For Dinner?
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: The Dinner Dance
programme.desc: Kale salad with avocado and pistachios; marinara sauce; no-mess cheesy baked chicken wings.

programme.title: Growing up Italian
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Everything Rice
programme.desc: Today is all about rice, and Lidia teaches viewers how to master the technique of making risotto. She starts with an Italian classic, Risotto with Mushrooms; next is Red Onions Stuffed with Rice. No food should be wasted, and Lidia shows viewers how to use risotto leftovers by making Fried Risotto.

programme.title: All in the Skillet
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Great Grains
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: All About Chicken
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. Recipes include a succulent Roasted Chicken; a simple and earthy Seared Chicken Breast with Mushrooms; and finally a dish with a little kick - Paprika Drumsticks with Peppers.

programme.title: Steak House Favorites
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: A Winter Garden
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Simply Dining In
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: GNOCCHI
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Corn: From the Kernel to the Husk
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Switch up the Spice
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: Weeknight Dinner
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Simply Salads
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a colourful summer panzanella with roasted zucchini and onions, and a warm shrimp and squash ribbon salad.

programme.title: Savor The Moment
programme.desc: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

programme.title: Family Brunch
programme.desc: Today Lidia shares some new show-stopping dishes for the perfect family style brunch that include Crostata with Kale Butternut Squash and Ricotta - made of a flaky dough filled with a creamy colorful mix of ricotta, kale, butternut squash and golden raisins. Carrot and Orange Salad is the next item on the menu-a bright dish that adds color to any meal. Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: More Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Restaurant Inspiration
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Finding the Balance
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: I Love Eggs
programme.desc: Lidia loves eggs, and in this episode, she shares four super simple recipes that feature this amazing ingredient that Lidia recalls fondly from her own grandmother's courtyard in Istria. Oregano Eggs and Anchovy Frittata are delicious appetizers or main courses. The Rustic Salad is a great meal idea with lots of complex textures and flavors. For a sweet finish, Lidia whips up Zabaglione with Fresh Fruit.

programme.title: Fruit Desserts
programme.desc: Fruit desserts have always been an Italian tradition; they are simple, delicious and the perfect way to showcase nature's bounty. In this episode, the Lidia highlights some of her fans' preferred seasonal sweets with: Strawberries with Balsamic Vinegar, a light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Fresh Fruit; juicy Nectarines and Blueberries in Prosecco and a Plum Crostata, a free form Italian tart with juicy plums.

programme.title: Fruits and Sweets
programme.desc: In Lidia's courtyard, the fruit trees would blossom with flowers in spring. In the summer, it was time to play around the trees and wait for the fruit to ripen. Today, Lidia prepares a Fig and Prosciutto Bruschetta, a delicious combination of sweet and salty. She then transforms wafer cookies into Quick & Easy Truffles. Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.title: Colorful Inspiration
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Italian Taste for Bitter Vegetables
programme.desc: Italy is one big garden with a year round growing season. Vegetables are often the stars of the meal, and today Lidia will highlight the versatility of delicious bitter vegetables like broccoli rabe, radicchio and escarole.

programme.title: Never Enough Pasta
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Chocolate and Dinner
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite chocolate desserts and one deliciously creamy risotto recipe. First, she makes a Chocolate Hazelnut Bread Parfait, a special treat she had growing up. Lidia then makes a soft and creamy spoon dessert, Chocolate Zabaglione. Lastly, she prepares a rich and smooth Risotto with Artichokes, Sunchokes, and Mint.

programme.title: Foraging Adventures
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Seafood Symphony
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Best of Zucchini
programme.desc: Zucchini sautéed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Restaurant's Greatest hits
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Keep it Fresh
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: The Fresh Catch
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Soups On
programme.desc: Soups are a delicious and comforting way to warm up especially in the winter months. On the menu today is Spicy Italian Soup, Calabria's version of vegetable soup; The Perfect Simple Salad, a simple and light side that works for any kind of soup; and an easy-to-make Butternut Squash Soup, garnished with crispy crumbled bacon.

programme.title: Bread & Beans
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: My Goats & Ricotta
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: BRAISING
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: Tried & True
programme.desc: Four cheese baked macaroni with asparagus and peas; cider vinegar spritz; spicy vinegar ribs and potatoes.

programme.title: Heartwarming Favorites
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: SEARED STEAK
programme.desc: When talking about a juicy steak, grilling often comes to mind but for Lidia, it's all about the sear. In today's episode, Lidia begins with a crispy Montasio Cheese Frico stuffed with potatoes and onions. She then makes a Seared Steak with a perfectly balanced sauce of rosemary, shallots and mixed mushrooms. Her side dish is a Braised Escarole with olive oil, pepperoncino and garlic -simple and delicious.

programme.title: A Fruitful Meal
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: An Italian Lunchbox
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: My Fruit Trees
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Our Courtyard Cantina
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Craving Fresh
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shows how to mix and balance seasonal flavors from your own garden in order to create new recipes based on what's available.

programme.title: Heartwarming Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Cold Weather Comforts
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: BRODETTO
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Wheat Harvest and Pasta
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Love Your Vegetables
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Cocktail Party
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Grow In The Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Memories of the Mountains
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Building Flavor
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: The 1980s Italian American "Evolution"
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Plan The Menu
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: A Summer Shindig
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: A Perfect Roast
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.

programme.title: Party Favorites
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: A Light Summery Meal
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: MORE PASTA
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Europe's Exit from Colonial Asia
programme.desc: The future of occupied Asia becomes murky after 1945; few people want to see colonial occupiers reassert their influence; zeroing in on conflicts in Indonesia, the Philippines and India to see how geopolitics in the region transform after the war.

programme.title: China's Civil War
programme.desc: As war rages on across the globe, China has to contend with civil war; exploring the war from its colonial roots to the establishment of the People's Republic of China; how the U.S.S.R. and the United States get involved in the conflict.

programme.title: The Unfinished Korean War
programme.desc: Why America fights a war in Korea; how the U.S.S.R. engages in the conflict; whether the United States could wage a limited war on the peninsula as it intends to; what to make of a war that ends not in peace, but in an armistice.

programme.title: Britain's Exit from Palestine, Malaya, and Kenya
programme.desc: After World War II, organized rebellions explode within the British Empire; investigating the conflicts that shake postwar Palestine, Kenya and Malaya; British counterinsurgency tactics; what these confrontations reveal about war and colonialism.

programme.title: The Trial of Socrates
programme.desc: Surveying some of history's greatest trials with a visit to ancient Athens; in 399 B.C., Socrates undergoes his trial for corrupting Athenians and disrespecting their gods; In the process, he lectures his jurors on the duty of seeking the truth.

programme.title: The Trial of Gaius Verres
programme.desc: To save the Roman Republic, Cicero charges Gaius Verres, a provincial governor, with crimes against the people; Cicero's Actio Secunda aims to educate the Roman public about the corruption and rot in its political system.

programme.title: Three Medieval Trials
programme.desc: Studying three strange trials from the Middle Ages; the first involves a dead pope put on trial; the second involves an accused adulterer's walk over red-hot ploughshares. The third involves a battle whose victor is vindicated as a matter of law.

programme.title: The Trial of Sir Thomas More
programme.desc: Traveling back to Westminster Hall on July 1, 1535, when Sir Thomas Moore stands on trial for his refusal to acknowledge King Henry VIII as head of the Church of England; one of England's most revered men ends up on the chopping block.

programme.title: The Trial of Giordano Bruno
programme.desc: Giordano Bruno's ideas on natural philosophy are dangerous to 16th-century thought; his execution represents a failure of the Roman Inquisition to perform its mission to admonish, not punish; the impact of this trial on another heresy case.

programme.title: The Salem Witchcraft Trials
programme.desc: According to Professor Linder, the Salem witchcraft trials illustrate the danger of drawing conclusions ahead of evidence; gaining a greater understanding of the legal basis for a travesty that accuses hundreds of people of practicing witchcraft.

programme.title: The Boston Massacre Trials
programme.desc: A harbinger of the American Revolution, the Boston Massacre trials reflect the heated partisanship of the times; the young attorney John Adams pays a price for his decision to represent the accused British soldiers and their captain.

programme.title: The Aaron Burr Conspiracy Trial
programme.desc: Learning whether politics and justice can be kept separate in great trials; considering the conspiracy trial of Aaron Burr presided over by Chief Justice John Marshall; no one in the United States, even the president, is above the law.

programme.title: Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War
programme.desc: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Nightmare Scenarios of Modern War
programme.desc: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries.

programme.title: The Tools of Modern Warfare
programme.desc: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups.

programme.title: From World War to Cold War
programme.desc: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR.

programme.title: Europe's Exit from Colonial Asia
programme.desc: The future of occupied Asia becomes murky after 1945; few people want to see colonial occupiers reassert their influence; zeroing in on conflicts in Indonesia, the Philippines and India to see how geopolitics in the region transform after the war.

programme.title: Westward the Course of Empire
programme.desc: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans.

programme.title: The West in the Colonial Era
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: What is a Pirate?
programme.desc: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

programme.title: Pirate Facts and Fictions
programme.desc: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

programme.title: America Enters the War
programme.desc: U.S. Marines arrive in June 1965 to protect a U.S. air base; the North Vietnamese Army and the southern Viet Cong guerrillas launch attacks.

programme.title: French Indochina and the Viet Minh
programme.desc: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries.

programme.title: Prelude to War
programme.desc: Learning about the sectional controversies and clashes that ultimately set the stage for secession and war.

programme.title: The Election of 1860
programme.desc: The presidential canvass of 1860 is the most important in U.S. history; it results in Abraham Lincoln's election as the first Republican to occupy the White House and brings sectional tensions to a head.

programme.title: The Trial of Socrates

programme.title: America: Forged in War
programme.desc: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

programme.title: George Washington Takes Command
programme.desc: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Julia Disobeys Emperor Augustus
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded
programme.desc: The portrayal of the John the Baptist's death as the whim of the young femme fatale Salome; why the truth is much more complicated; the story of Salome's mother, Herodias; how Herodias's hunger for power and recognition left her exiled and forgotten.

programme.title: Andrée de Jongh and the Resistance
programme.desc: When the Germans begin their rapid invasions across Europe, many ordinary citizens are stunned; Dedee de Jongh, a 23-year-old nurse, builds an escape line through Belgium and France to rescue stranded British airmen; her courage and ingenuity.

programme.title: The Tory Rebels Who Helped Save England
programme.desc: In hindsight, it may appear inevitable that Winston Churchill takes command; at the time, it seems unthinkable that Neville Chamberlain steps down; how a few brave politicians orchestrate one of the most striking political transitions in history.

programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: What is a Pirate?
programme.desc: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

programme.title: Pirate Facts and Fictions
programme.desc: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

programme.title: America Enters the War
programme.desc: U.S. Marines arrive in June 1965 to protect a U.S. air base; the North Vietnamese Army and the southern Viet Cong guerrillas launch attacks.

programme.title: French Indochina and the Viet Minh
programme.desc: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries.

programme.title: Prelude to War
programme.desc: Learning about the sectional controversies and clashes that ultimately set the stage for secession and war.

programme.title: The Election of 1860
programme.desc: The presidential canvass of 1860 is the most important in U.S. history; it results in Abraham Lincoln's election as the first Republican to occupy the White House and brings sectional tensions to a head.

programme.title: The Trial of Socrates
programme.desc: Surveying some of history's greatest trials with a visit to ancient Athens; in 399 B.C., Socrates undergoes his trial for corrupting Athenians and disrespecting their gods; In the process, he lectures his jurors on the duty of seeking the truth.

programme.title: The Trial of Gaius Verres
programme.desc: To save the Roman Republic, Cicero charges Gaius Verres, a provincial governor, with crimes against the people; Cicero's Actio Secunda aims to educate the Roman public about the corruption and rot in its political system.

programme.title: America: Forged in War
programme.desc: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

programme.title: George Washington Takes Command
programme.desc: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Julia Disobeys Emperor Augustus
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded
programme.desc: The portrayal of the John the Baptist's death as the whim of the young femme fatale Salome; why the truth is much more complicated; the story of Salome's mother, Herodias; how Herodias's hunger for power and recognition left her exiled and forgotten.

programme.title: Andrée de Jongh and the Resistance
programme.desc: When the Germans begin their rapid invasions across Europe, many ordinary citizens are stunned; Dedee de Jongh, a 23-year-old nurse, builds an escape line through Belgium and France to rescue stranded British airmen; her courage and ingenuity.

programme.title: The Tory Rebels Who Helped Save England
programme.desc: In hindsight, it may appear inevitable that Winston Churchill takes command; at the time, it seems unthinkable that Neville Chamberlain steps down; how a few brave politicians orchestrate one of the most striking political transitions in history.

programme.title: Who Are the Celts?
programme.desc: Examining and clarifying common preconceptions about Celtic identity; painting the initial brushstrokes on the canvas of a European culture most widely perceived as Scottish and Irish while promising much more.

programme.title: The Celts and the Classical World
programme.desc: Studying the earliest written records of the Celts from Italy, Greece and Spain, dating as far back as the sixth century B.C.; scholarly theories about the Celts' migration throughout Europe; the foundation of humanity's understanding of the Celts.

programme.title: Celtic Art and Artifacts
programme.desc: How archeological studies of Celtic artifacts have woven a rich tapestry of their millennia-old society; learning about war trumpets, gold necklaces and other recovered objects from around Europe; building an image of this ever-adapting culture.

programme.title: Celtic Languages in the Ancient World
programme.desc: The discovery of Celtic inscriptions on Spain's western coast; the possibility of a common language along maritime trade routes; revolutionizing studies of Celtic origins and migration; the long-standing theory of Central European Celtic origins.

programme.title: Caesar and the Gauls
programme.desc: How several centuries of combat against Celtic-controlled Gaul made northern Italy and southern France a dangerous place for the Romans; Julius Caesar's wars against the Gauls; famous figures of world history and their encounters with the Gauls.

programme.title: Celtic Religion and the Druids
programme.desc: Celtic religious beliefs in divination, reincarnation and human sacrifice; discovering the ancient religious figures known as druids, who served as holy men, soothsayers, and even lawyers; an insight into the Celtic version of the sacred.

programme.title: Celtic Britain and Roman Britain
programme.desc: The theory of trade-based migration to explain the arrival of the Celts' influence in Britain before the arrival of the Romans; the struggle between the Celts and the Romans over Britain; untangling a web of history on the island.

programme.title: Celts and Picts in Scotland
programme.desc: Life in Scotland during the time of a Romanized southern Britain; the warring tribes of Picts that ruled North Britain; highlights that include the ancient Pictish tongue and the truth about William "Braveheart" Wallace.

programme.title: Resilience: Rethinking the Black Death
programme.desc: The Black Death's pathology and symptoms, and Chaucer's childhood.

programme.title: Medieval Globalization and the Black Death
programme.desc: Investigating the public health consequences of globalization in the medieval period.

programme.title: Death Ships: The Spread of Plague in Europe
programme.desc: The plague's continental path and its varying rates of spread.

programme.title: Children, Plague, and Grief
programme.desc: Bubonic plague's effect on children and how whole towns cared for orphans.

programme.title: Famine, Flood, and Earthquakes
programme.desc: Exploring how three different kinds of disasters helped Europe mobilize against the plague.

programme.title: Plague Medicine: Opium, Gold, Poison Clouds
programme.desc: Exploring the role of religion, astrology, the environment and diet in medieval medicine.

programme.title: Filth: How Medieval Cities Fought the Plague
programme.desc: Exploring how and why premodern cities implemented public health measures before the plague.

programme.title: Laughter and Joy: Boccaccio's Decameron
programme.desc: Discovering how the writer Giovanni Boccaccio found humor and joy in life, even amid suffering.
