programme.title: Oldest House in Georgia
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Home is Where the Haunt Is
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!

programme.title: Empire State Haunts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Sloss Furnaces
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost of Christmas Past
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Haunted Town
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Pennsylvania Asylum
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Century of Hauntings
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: French Quarter Phantoms
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Hotel Haunts Unleashed
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Frozen in Fear
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Residual Haunts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Knights of the Living Dead
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Pearl Harbor Phantoms
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Urgent!
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Hill View Manor
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Dark Shadows
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghostly Evidence
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost of CarnegieD
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Harvesting Murder
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Wells of Horror
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Roasts and Ghosts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Murdered Matron
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: The Bloodiest 47 Acres
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri to investigate Missouri State penitentiary. Having opened in 1836,it stood as oneof the oldest and most violent prisons in America, and was referred to as "the bloodiest 47 acres". While still operational, both guards and inmates reported strange experiences at the penitentiary. It continued even after its doorsclosed. Some of the activity reportedincludes apparitions of men and women, doors slamming, and footsteps.

programme.title: Voices of Pain
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads back to the fan favorite, Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, where more activity has been reported and a nurse's wing has been opened up for TAPS to explore. The activity reported includes solid dark shadows and voices. Stave and Tango start out their night in the Death Tunnel where they hear sounds, and loud slams, but can't figure out what caused it.

programme.title: Distillery of Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Membership Denied
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Roller Ghoster
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Buyer Beware
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Flooded Souls
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Dead & Breakfast
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Moonshine & Madness
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: City Hell
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost of a Marine
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: A Family of Spirits
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Haunted by Heroes
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: The Princess and the EVP
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Please Sign the Ghost Book
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Frighternity
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: A Serial Killer's Revenge
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Camp Fear
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Rutledge, Georgia to investigate Camp Rutledge, a family friendly camp, that is anything but friendly at night. The call to help comes from a frightened mother, Melissa, who has attended the camp since she was 17 yrs, and now has a daughter old enough to start vacationing at the campsite. Melissa has witnessed many unexplained paranormal things, and wants to make sure it's safe before she takes her daughter there.

programme.title: French Quarter Massacre
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Don't Feed the Apparitions
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghostly Refuge
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Paranormal Politics
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Baton Rouge, Louisiana to investigate the Old State Capital Building. Built in 1852, this building has seen countless politicians come through its doors including congressman, Pierre Couvillon, who died during a heated debate opposing gambling. The building also survived the Civil War, during which the Union Army used the basement as a prison.

programme.title: Curtain Call
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Fear Factory
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Tunnels of Terror
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Heir Apparition
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Paranormal Pioneers
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Gloucester, Massachusetts to investigate Hammond Castle. They are joined by Josh Gates to find out if the original owners and paranormal pioneers, John and Irene Hammond haunt their property. Are the Hammonds able to talk to the living, as they once were able to do with the dead? What does a disembodied voice say that leads TAPS to believe the Hammonds might still be here?

programme.title: Higher Dead-ucation
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Due Date with Death
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Haunted Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Hollywood Horror Stories
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Mission
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Prescription for Fear
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Permanent Residents
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: All Ghosts on Deck
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghosts From Hale
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Scream Park
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.

programme.title: Ghost Friends Forever
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Vintage Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Hoover Damned
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Something in the Water
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Living the Life
programme.desc: The price of crime is often paid by the most innocent, by creativity wasted on destructive ends, but some inmates are determined to better themselves and adapt to life in prison.

programme.title: Predatory Behavior
programme.desc: To their victims, they were epitome of terror and the face of their nightmares; five of the most notorious inmates to ever appear on Lockup reveal startling insights into their shocking brands of predatory behavior.

programme.title: Reap What You Sow
programme.desc: A cell search inside the maximum-security prison results in some heated words and the discovery of a gang manifesto; inmates express their personal feelings in private to the cameras; one confronts his own mortality.

programme.title: Unraveling the Truth
programme.desc: Additional footage from the "Lockup" series.

programme.title: Horribility
programme.desc: An inmate's erratic behavior triggers the emergency response team and mental health staff; a murderer faces the death penalty while his girlfriend awaits trial in the women's wing of the same jail.

programme.title: Piece of Cake
programme.desc: An inmate with a record dating back to age 14 comes to terms with his past and present; another inmate is left cut and bleeding after he is caught off guard during a vicious assault inside the Kent County Jail.

programme.title: Outcast
programme.desc: Behind the circular walls of Kent County Jail an inmate tries to leave jail the hard way; a female inmate convicted of her fifth drunken driving charge could lose everything; an outcast inmate makes a comment that sparks both violence and panic.

programme.title: Jailing
programme.desc: A gangbanger squares off with his victim's family in court and with another inmate inside the jail; the Kent County Jail staff must deal with a former colleague gone bad.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Three?
programme.desc: Behind the razor wire topped fences and brick walls of the Kent County Jail an inmate worker deals with the pressure of trying to create the jail's most popular dish; a pair of incarcerated lovers might end up having another mouth to feed.

programme.title: The Gamble
programme.desc: A young inmate with a big personality faces problems while four other inmates are in jail after a shocking home invasion robbery and rape; one defendant will stand apart from the others, though nothing will prepare him for what's to come.

programme.title: The Hamptons
programme.desc: In Kent County Jail, a well-known inmate is back with more than 130 prior stays; an inside look at life in the one wing of the jail that inmates consider prime real estate, but where one will be expelled for good.

programme.title: Skitz
programme.desc: A routine cell search reveals an inmate on the edge, and prison officials intervene; cameras are turned over to the inmates for a glimpse behind the walls of the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: Extractions provide some of the most dramatic interactions that ever occur between inmates and staff, and few extractions in the state of Colorado have provided more drama than the ones involving Roy Slagle.

programme.title: Coffin Punch
programme.desc: The whole team gets together to test myths about survival; in Coffin Punch, Kari, Tory and Grant test the silver screen saga; Adam and Jamie question what bullet-proof is.

programme.title: End With a Bang
programme.desc: The team joins forces, placing popular sayings under the microscope to determine whether it really is "impossible to polish a turd," possible to "hit the ground running" or advisable to "end with a bang."

programme.title: Viewer Special Threequel
programme.desc: The team puts four myths sent in by viewers to the test, including finding out whether drinking alcohol can help to avoid hypothermia.

programme.title: Alaska Special 2
programme.desc: The team busts the myth about the defensive properties of Pykrete.

programme.title: Exploding Bumper
programme.desc: The teams test two myths of locomotion from the reliable horse to the sometimes-unreliable motor car.

programme.title: Seesaw Saga
programme.desc: The team designs and builds a giant see-saw.

programme.title: Thermite vs. Ice
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie put a YouTube myth to the test; the team experiments with Thermite, car stereo systems and handguns.

programme.title: Prison Escape
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test if it's possible to cling to the roof of a speeding car; Kari, Tory and Grant try to solve some jailbreak myths.

programme.title: Curving Bullets
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie find out if a sonic shock wave can shatter glass; Tory, Grant and Kari try to bend bullets around obstacles.

programme.title: Car vs. Rain
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test out theories surrounding driving in the rain; they find out whether it is possible to stay dry by putting pedal to the metal.

programme.title: Knock Your Socks Off
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the physics theory of bullet dropped vs. bullet fired; Kari, Grant and Tory test if it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

programme.title: Duct Tape Hour
programme.desc: The team explores the capabilities of duct tape.

programme.title: Dirty vs. Clean Car
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test whether a dirty car gets better gas mileage than a clean one; Kari, Grant and Tory test an old adage about hangovers concerning beer and liquor.

programme.title: Hurricane Windows
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test whether it's better to keep windows open or closed during a hurricane; liquid nitrogen.

programme.title: Crash and Burn
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test a myth of an out-of-control car crashing and burning.

programme.title: Myth Evolution
programme.desc: Exploring water heaters capabilities and well known car myths.

programme.title: Dumpster Diving
programme.desc: The team tests if diving into a dumpster is a valid way to get off a roof.

programme.title: Antacid Jail Break
programme.desc: Exploring how prisoners can escape and survive outside prison.

programme.title: Mini Myth Mayhem
programme.desc: Sending a coconut in the mail, inducing bed-wetting and making earwax.

programme.title: Boomerang Bullet
programme.desc: Exploring the elastic properties of trees and a bullets ability to bounce.

programme.title: Soda Cup Killer
programme.desc: Testing a Styrofoam cup filled with soda has against a car windshield.

programme.title: Dive to Survive
programme.desc: The crew puts movie myths to the test; they investigate whether an explosion on a boat could be survived by diving underwater; they test if phone books can be used as budget bulletproofing.

programme.title: Spy Car Escape
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie investigate the perfect car weaponry.

programme.title: Bottle Bash
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie get feisty with a bar fight fable; Kari, Grant and Tory investigate a ballistic material mystery from history.

programme.title: No Pain, No Gain
programme.desc: The team tests pain tolerance and tries to launch a backyard propane tank.

programme.title: Mythssion Control
programme.desc: The team responds to fan objections to their techniques; Tory, Grant and Kari try again to knock someone out of his socks; they test Jamie's assertion that a head-on collision has the force of a collision with a wall at twice the speed.

programme.title: Duct Tape Hour 2
programme.desc: The team tests duct tape's adhesion, load-bearing capability and more.

programme.title: Waterslide Wipeout
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie tackle the biggest, dirtiest build in MythBusters history; saving gas by making only right turns.

programme.title: Fireball Stun Gun
programme.desc: The team gets hot under the collar while playing with fire and fireworks.

programme.title: Flu Fiction
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the velocity and spread of a sneeze; they test the theory that tornadoes can turn everyday items into lethal projectiles.

programme.title: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: The MythBusters test out two shaggy-dog tales that put both of their crime-fighting canines to the ultimate test.

programme.title: Storm-Chasing Myths
programme.desc: Stars of Storm Chasers join Adam and Jamie to put tornadoes to the test.

programme.title: Cold Feet
programme.desc: The team tackles English sayings by finding out if getting cold feet literally makes your feet cold and if poop hitting a fan really gets everywhere.

programme.title: Arrow Machine Gun
programme.desc: The team covers ancient archery and driving while tipsy vs. tired.

programme.title: Inverted Underwater Car
programme.desc: Jamie risks Adam's life to revisit one of their most-harrowing myths.

programme.title: Bug Special
programme.desc: Investigating insect myths; testing if bees can lift a laptop; water repelling flies; hitting a bug on a motorcycle.

programme.title: Green Hornet Special
programme.desc: Seth Rogen joins the team for two stories from his film, "The Green Hornet:" Elevator Car Cut and Explosive Escape.

programme.title: Operation Valkyrie
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the merits of a famous assassination attempt; Kari, Grant and Tory test "slapping some sense" into someone.

programme.title: Mission Impossible Mask
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie face-off with a myth of misdirection.

programme.title: Running on Water
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test to see if they can walk on water; Tory tests if common things can be bombproof.

programme.title: Bubble Trouble
programme.desc: The team tries to float in bubbly water and split a tree with an arrow.

programme.title: Torpedo-Tastic
programme.desc: The team tests an ancient torpedo and explosive wine corks.

programme.title: Blow Your Own Sail
programme.desc: The team tests sound effects and propelling a sailboat with a fan.

programme.title: Dodge a Bullet
programme.desc: A test to determine if it is possible to jump out the way of a bullet; how hard do you hit the water when jumping from great heights?

programme.title: Fixing a Flat
programme.desc: The guys test what it would take to fix a flat tire without a spare.

programme.title: Let There Be Light
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam test a Hollywood lighting myth.

programme.title: Paper Armor
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie are exploring the physics of shock waves in water.

programme.title: Bikes and Bazookas
programme.desc: The guys test the myth that a motorcycle is a greener machine than a car.

programme.title: Walk a Straight Line
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test if blindfolded humans can travel in a straight line.

programme.title: Duct Tape Plane
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test three viral videos featuring extraordinary excavators.

programme.title: Drain Disaster
programme.desc: The experts test if a combustible sewer would rocket a manhole cover.

programme.title: Wheel of Mythfortune
programme.desc: The team picks 5 winners of the viewer request lottery as only they can.

programme.title: Toilet Bomb
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie tackle a blockbuster bathroom bomb.

programme.title: Duct Tape Island
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie are abandoned on a desert island with only sticky silver adhesive; can tape be used to find water, food, build shelter and escape?

programme.title: Fire vs. Ice
programme.desc: The guys judge an epic duel between a flamethrower and a fire extinguisher.

programme.title: Square Wheels
programme.desc: Kari, Tory and Grant hit the breaks for a date night movie myth.

programme.title: Swinging Pirates
programme.desc: The Hyneman and Captain Redbeard take a swing at a pirate movie myth.

programme.title: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: The experts pit Men against Women in the ultimate Battle of the Sexes.

programme.title: Driving in Heels
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie hit the highway with some fancy footwear.

programme.title: Revenge of the Myth
programme.desc: The whole team gets together to take fan favorites to another level.

programme.title: Bouncing Bullet
programme.desc: Taking aim at a ricochet myth; will jumping while running from an explosion soften the impact?

programme.title: Bubble Pack Plunge
programme.desc: Jumping from a building while wrapped in bubble packaging; James Bond ejector seat.

programme.title: Duel Dilemmas
programme.desc: The teams covers dueling myths and investigates two-stage missiles.

programme.title: Titanic Survival
programme.desc: James Cameron joins Adam and Jamie to try to answer the questions, did Jack (from Cameron's "Titanic") needlessly die? Is it possible that Rose and Jack could have both fit on the wooden board and survived together?

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned (now going by his real name of Matt) and Riley rise to the surface.

programme.title: All The Wrong Places
programme.desc: Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi who becomes obsessed with building a new dam on Drovers, with near tragic results.

programme.title: Digging Up The Past
programme.desc: Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles. Meanwhile, Tayler worries when Regan doesn't return on time but has her hands full caring for an injured possum with Patrick.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret that will change their lives forever. Meanwhile, Jodi is determined to help Riley make peace with his estranged father, Bill, when he visits Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reaching Out
programme.desc: Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict. Alex, angry that Marcus lied to him for so long, is doing his best to not deal with the fact that he and Marcus are brothers.

programme.title: Returned Favour
programme.desc: Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her. Meanwhile, Stevie may risk losing Alex again when she helps Marcus with a cattle deal.

programme.title: Of Hearts and Hunters
programme.desc: For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny. Jodi suggests Matt move in permanently, and we find Matt making plans to ask Jodi to marry him, but Jodi faces a gut-wrenching decision when Matt is forced back into witness protection.

programme.title: Climb Every Mountain
programme.desc: Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death and she decides to investigate the case of Jodi and Matt's murders herself. Meanwhile, Stevie has taken over a meeting that Jodi organised with Natural Resource Management and is determined to make her proud.

programme.title: Sisters are Doing It For Themselves
programme.desc: When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her. Stevie convinces Alex that they should keep their relationship a secret, but they quickly prove to be utterly hopeless at staying low-key.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong when a series of accidents and disasters threaten to ruin their relationship. Meanwhile, Kate and Riley are caught in a game of theft and deception over stray cattle, as Moira finds herself on a date with Phil Rakich.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands. Meanwhile, Regan tries her best to convince her sister to make her stay on the ranch permanent.

programme.title: Warts and All
programme.desc: Stevie is not looking forward to being nothing more than "Mrs. Alex Ryan," and there are responsibilities that her new position brings. Bryce arrives for the engagement party, bearing an unwanted pre-nup.

programme.title: Conflicts of Interest
programme.desc: The girls fight to stop Drovers Run becoming the site of a toxic waste dump. Grace forces Regan to choose between her family and her rekindled relationship with her lover who is in charge of the site testing.

programme.title: Flesh and Stone
programme.desc: Grace kidnaps a government official to prevent the toxic dump from going ahead. Regan is also fighting to save Drovers Run, though her relationships with Grace and Lyle may reach a crisis point in the process.

programme.title: All's Fair In Love and War
programme.desc: Rose arrives at Drovers Run accompanied by Stevie's mother, Helen. Rose hoped to act as a peacemaker between the two, but instead, years of bitterness pour out.

programme.title: Ever After
programme.desc: On Alex and Stevie's long-awaited wedding day, things will run smoothly if the groom is able to get out of jail in time to make it to the altar. Meanwhile, Alex's sister Ashleigh attempts to ruin the wedding and take over Killarney.

programme.title: Grace Under Fire
programme.desc: While clashing with a rich new neighbour, Heath Barrett, Grace becomes convinced she's cursed Drovers Run when a series of bizarre plagues strike the farm. Meanwhile, while Alex is away on his honeymoon with Stevie, Ashleigh runs amok when she undermines Marcus' authority on Killarney.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: ile desperately trying to resist Heath's charms, Grace questions her future on Drovers Run when she learns that her best friend has died.

programme.title: Hot Water
programme.desc: Grace may be making a deal with the devil when she accepts a secret loan from Ashleigh after the bank refuses credit to Drovers Run. Meanwhile, after Grace and Kate are taken hostage by a bankrupt farmer, Moira has a premonition that someone will get shot by the gunman.

programme.title: Leaving the Nest
programme.desc: Stevie returns from her honeymoon and plans to spend the summer with Rose before she starts university, but Rose has plans of her own which involve taking a year off to travel overseas. Meanwhile, Grace is forced to take desperate measures to repay Ashleigh, and Riley trains a new horse.

programme.title: Spark From Heaven
programme.desc: Rose returns from the hospital in a wheelchair and is involved in a freak car crash that may not have been an accident. Moira convinces the girls to do a naked rain dance, with unexpected results, and sceptic Phil gains a new respect for Moira's psychic gifts.

programme.title: The Courage Within
programme.desc: While the girls are investigating a mysterious explosion at the fuel dump, wheelchair-bound Rose is trapped at the homestead during a brazen robbery attempt. Meanwhile, Marcus and Heath clash over Grace's controversial drought-proofing plan, and Ashleigh blackmails Grace into lying to the police.

programme.title: Divided We Stand
programme.desc: Stevie's loyalty to Drovers Run is tested when she moves into Killarney. Meanwhile, Grace is trying to move ahead with her drought-proofing plan. Kate falls for Mitch, an ex-army mate of Riley's, who arrives with a dark secret and Riley makes a dangerous enemy when he rejects Ashleigh's advances.

programme.title: On The Prowl
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run team up with the men from Killarney to hunt the dangerous beast that is killing Drovers stock. Meanwhile, Riley discovers Mitch is trading stolen army weapons, and while Riley's unwilling to turn him into the police, Ashleigh has no such qualms.

programme.title: Fanning the Flames
programme.desc: Blinded by love, Kate decides to go on the run with her outlaw boyfriend Mitch. Meanwhile, Drovers Run and other local farms are the victims of a professional arsonist.

programme.title: My Enemy My Friend
programme.desc: Grace faces an uphill battle to save Ashleigh's life when they are left stranded in the bush after being involved in a serious car accident on an isolated road. Meanwhile, an expensive stud bull is poisoned on Drovers Run, and the girls are convinced someone is trying to bankrupt them.

programme.title: Knight In Shining Armour
programme.desc: During preparations for a Medieval Fair organised for drought relief, Grace is shocked when Heath proposes marriage. With Ashleigh having called in her loan and Drovers under threat, the girls decide to hold an auction to raise the necessary cash, selling off everything they can spare.

programme.title: The Short Cut
programme.desc: Grace takes drastic action to capture a cattle thief, and the girls uncover Ashleigh's secret plan to bankrupt Drovers Run. The girls team up to try and stop her before it's too late to save the ranch.

programme.title: Seeing Is Believing
programme.desc: It's Halloween and odd things occur on Drovers Run as the horror stories the girls tell over dinner start to come true. Kate is convinced she has killed Ashleigh in a hit-and-run accident, but can't find the body anywhere.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: The arrival of a mysterious stranger forces Grace to reconsider her future with Heath. He wants to move them to Queensland to take over a horse stud and set up camp drafting school.

programme.title: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: Marcus suspects Heath is cheating on Grace, but jealousy might be clouding his judgement. Grace starts to question Heath's love for her until Heath surprises her with an amazing gift.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve, and Alex makes a surprise return from Argentina to visit Stevie. Meanwhile, Grace finds proof of Heath's infidelity, and Kate and Riley finally admit their attraction to each other when they kiss under the mistletoe.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: The car accident has thrown everyone off balance. Kate is obsessed with proving Riley survived, Grace tries to find the mystery person who rescued her, and Patrick mistakenly feels he's invincible.

programme.title: The Pitfalls of Love
programme.desc: Grace and Marcus are trapped at the bottom of an abandoned mine shaft, and help needs to arrive before Grace develops severe hypothermia. Kate helps Father Dan by caring for a cantankerous elderly woman who has some useful advice for grieving Kate

programme.title: Wild Ride
programme.desc: Stevie's wild-at-heart former rodeo mate, Sharon, visits Drovers Run and turns everyone's lives upside down. Meanwhile, Marcus sacrifices his chances in a major horse endurance race to save Ingrid from an abusive rider.

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Kate is finishing her pipe project when she comes across a young runaway, Jamie, broken down on the stock route. She tries to talk to him, but he runs, stealing her car. Eventually, Kate catches Jamie.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: There seems to be an intruder haunting Drovers and Moira is spooked by strange noises in the night. Eventually, they discover the culprit: a grubby, nine-year-old girl called Lily. Moira is suspicious, and when her dad, Frank, picks her up, he is clearly hiding something.

programme.title: Close Enough to Touch
programme.desc: Alex returns from Argentina and his reunion with Stevie begins blissfully. Moira has helped her set up a romantic picnic spot for their first supper together since the honeymoon.

programme.title: Bringing Up Wombat
programme.desc: Stevie decides to leave Drovers Run and move to Killarney to secure her son's future, but in the wake of the tragedy, she makes a series of rash management decisions that do just the opposite.

programme.title: Three Sisters
programme.desc: Jaz returns to Drovers Run and clashes with Grace, leaving Regan stuck playing the role of peacemaker. Stevie, however, is glad to see Jaz and feels their old tensions are behind them. Jaz volunteers to help out around the farm but discovers she's picked up the wrong bag at the bus stop.

programme.title: Dammed
programme.desc: The girls of Drovers Run band together with the local community to stop a massive dam being built upstream. When Olympic-hopeful Jaz is made the face of the campaign, she finds herself blackmailed by pro-dam farmer Terri Barker, who threatens to reveal an explosive secret from her past.

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns. Jane wants to set the record straight with her daughter about why she left, but Tayler is wary. Meanwhile, baby Xander has not smiled yet, and it's worrying Stevie immensely.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big Trouble
programme.desc: Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank head off to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal that will take away their water. Meanwhile, Phil gives Moira a personal and surprising gift.

programme.title: Love and Let Die
programme.desc: Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her. Jaz needs to decide how to deal with the situation. Frank's hopes for a stable family life take a pounding when he learns that his ex-wife has a new job in Queensland and intends to take Lily with her.

programme.title: A Dog's Life
programme.desc: Marcus has been looking for a new overseer for weeks, but given his constant clashing with Ben, neither of them can accept that Ben is right for the job. The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.

programme.title: My Prince Will Come
programme.desc: After finding her horse from Europe grazing in the paddock, Jaz is surprised to discover she has been personally delivered by Mischa. The others are stunned to discover Mischa is a wealthy prince and Jaz's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Snogging Frogs
programme.desc: Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme to clear her name, Grace threatens to report him to the officials if he puts Jaz at risk by going through with his plan. Moira debates telling Phil she is pregnant, and his reaction is far from what she expected.

programme.title: The Merry Widow
programme.desc: Rumours run amok after the ball, as the town believes Steve is dating Marcus. Repercussions occur when one man, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler takes it upon herself to dig up gossip on him to bargain with.

programme.title: Show Pony
programme.desc: Following a costly accident, Ben helps Jaz try to determine what is spooking her horse, Annie, as she hopes to use her for work on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Grace discovers that some of the new Drovers cattle have been stolen, and Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.

programme.title: Every Move You Make
programme.desc: Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Ingrid is scared of what he might do if he finds out about her relationship with Marcus. Meanwhile, Phil is trying to make Moira feel better and has planned a special evening.

programme.title: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: Out of the hospital after being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and he will not let anyone stand in his way. Ingrid is more concerned than ever for her own safety, as well as that of her friends who did their best to help her.

programme.title: The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical. During the preparations, she finds out that Phil's son is getting married, but Phil isn't planning to attend the wedding, and she decides to interfere.

programme.title: Into the Valley of the Shadow
programme.desc: Hit hard by the drought and facing a growing debt, the very future of Drovers Run is at stake. The girls need help to shear all their sheep in one day to get them to a sale in time if they hope to save the ranch.

programme.title: The Long Paddock
programme.desc: With the land of Drovers Run on the line, Stevie musters all her determination to do the impossible. Meanwhile, Grace resolves her feeling for Marcus and faces a difficult decision, while Patrick and Tayler make their plans.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Half-sisters Tess and Claire are reunited when they take over the family ranch, Drovers Run, after their father's death.

programme.title: Ducks on the Pond
programme.desc: It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer. Tess witnesses some strange events and uncovers a secret.

programme.title: Don't Mess with the Girls
programme.desc: Jealousy abounds as Claire competes in the rodeo and two men compete for Tess's affection; Becky's reputation gets her in trouble.

programme.title: Who's the Boss?
programme.desc: Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.

programme.title: Taking the Reins
programme.desc: Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse, forcing her to wonder whether she truly belongs at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: Tess finds out that Jack loved Claire; Meg and Claire discover more about Becky's life when she returns to the truck stop.

programme.title: Pride and Joy
programme.desc: Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run. Tapped out of cash, she has no choice but to offer him her father's old mahogany desk, which is steeped in sentimental value for her and Tess.

programme.title: Stir Crazy
programme.desc: When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help. Tess and Nick search for the horses on motorbikes while Alex and Claire take to the skies in a helicopter.

programme.title: Into The Woods
programme.desc: Just when Tess thinks she's beginning to get the hang of ranch life, the hunt for a dangerous wild boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws her skills into question.

programme.title: Haunted
programme.desc: Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run. The pain of dealing with loss forces each of them to find a way to deal with these life-altering events.

programme.title: Who's a Big Girl Now?
programme.desc: The youngest member of the Drovers Run family is ready to celebrate her 18th birthday in style, but no one seems very interested in helping her mark such a special occasion.

programme.title: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light when an innocent question by Tess re-opens a very ugly wound.

programme.title: True Love and Consequences
programme.desc: When Bill Tilson decides to sell up and move to the city, Claire sees the precariousness of her own situation and it prompts her to work harder than ever to keep Drovers Run.

programme.title: Dirty Pool
programme.desc: Theft is on everyone's mind since there are cattle duffers working in the district and a flock of Claire's sheep has gone missing.

programme.title: If the Boot Fits...
programme.desc: When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run. In spite of a few doubts, Claire gives her a new pair of boots to honour the occasion, and it turns out that Tess will truly have to earn them.

programme.title: Playing to Win
programme.desc: The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality, and a sudden drive to defy whatever fate may have in store by pursuing a rapid expansion of his property.

programme.title: Girls Night Out
programme.desc: After reaping good profits at the sheep sales, the girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.

programme.title: More Than One Way...
programme.desc: Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex. Her dream of developing a quarter horse breeding program at Drovers Run looks as if it may be close to coming true and she's using it as an excuse to push Tess away.

programme.title: The Italian Stallion
programme.desc: When Alberto, a good-looking itinerant Italian, rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him. At first, Meg isn't too worried as Alberto will be moving on.

programme.title: Lover Come Back
programme.desc: When Tess finds an old psychology textbook, she becomes obsessed with trying to figure out the real reasons for people's actions. Tess, however, is not prepared for the truths she uncovers about those around her, and also faces something she is reluctant to answer herself.

programme.title: Friends Like These
programme.desc: After a grubby day with the cattle, Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit. And they've got news, big news: they've got a lease on the café they all dreamed about and they want Tess to come back to the city with them ASAP.

programme.title: Deep Water
programme.desc: Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match as part of her fund-raising efforts for the Miss Gungellan quest, and Brian decides it's high time to reacquaint himself with Becky.

programme.title: Love Conquers All
programme.desc: Darlene's alcohol abuse spins out of control; Cordelia drinks to cope with dumping Taylor.

programme.title: Return of the Juice, Death of the Truce

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias Presents: The Gentleman Jerry Rocha

programme.title: Pizza, Puppets, and Passionate Play
programme.desc: Geppetto brings Pinocchio to life, a stressed pizza shop, and a dramatic dinner table.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show

programme.title: The Little Train Robbery

programme.title: Bedloe Strikes Again

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.title: The Loaded Goat
programme.desc: Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: Return to Green Acres
programme.desc: Cast members from the original TV series are reunited when Oliver tries to save Hooterville from greedy developers.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Washed-up stuntman Luo can barely make ends meet, let alone take care of his beloved stunt horse, Red Hare. Luo reluctantly seeks help from his estranged daughter and her lawyer boyfriend when notified the horse may be auctioned off to pay his debts. Luo and Red Hare become an overnight media sensation when their fight with debt collectors goes viral.

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. programme.desc: Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

programme.title: Opie and the Spoiled Kid
programme.desc: Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

programme.title: The Great Filling Station Robbery
programme.desc: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

programme.title: Andy Discovers America
programme.desc: Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

programme.title: Aunt Bee's Medicine Man
programme.desc: Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
programme.desc: Gabriel Iglesias performs in Honolulu, sharing tales from his childhood and career with an adoring crowd.

programme.title: Exit Strategy
programme.desc: James must move in with his girlfriend of three months after being evicted from his place, and soon he discovers that he doesn't want to be with her anymore. His hope is to get her to break up with him but still let him sleep on the couch.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: Fluffy and the crew explore Hawaiian cuisine; trekking through a rainforest in search of the perfect poi; muddy obstacle course.

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: "Superheroes"; "Fixed Expressions"; "Old Job, New Job"; "Narrate"; "World's Worst"; "Props"; "Party Quirks."

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: "Remote Control"; "Film Dub"; "Old Job, New Job"; "News Report"; "Props"; "Sound Effects"; "Moving People"; "Party Quirks."

programme.title: Pizza, Puppets, and Passionate Play
programme.desc: Geppetto brings Pinocchio to life, a stressed pizza shop, and a dramatic dinner table.

programme.title: Nostalgia, Construction, and Comedy Challenges
programme.desc: Nostalgia, lazy construction crews, bizarre riddles, and a desperate assistant take over.

programme.title: Moon Missions and Mobsters
programme.desc: A moon mission, ATV mishaps, endless news taping, and mobster surprises.

programme.title: Poker, Prison, and Ice Fishing
programme.desc: Bookstore blowups, poker-faced mobsters, icy patience, and wild celeb cameos.

programme.title: The Darlings Are Coming
programme.desc: Andy unexpectedly has his hands full as The Darlings, a family of musicians from the mountains, arrive in Mayberry to meet a bus due the next day.

programme.title: Andy's English Valet
programme.desc: Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.

programme.title: Barney's First Car
programme.desc: Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho (Jackie Chan), an undercover operative for the CIA, decides to give up his career and marry his girlfriend, Gillian (Amber Valletta). First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Legally Blondes
programme.desc: British twin sisters (Milly Rosso, Becky Rosso) experience culture shock when they attend school in California.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Best of Wake Up Barstool
programme.desc: Outspoken and unfiltered takes on some of the biggest stories in sports, featuring Dave Portnoy and the Barstool crew.

programme.title: The Herd With Colin Cowherd
programme.desc: A thought-provoking, opinionated and topic-driven journey through the top sports stories of the day with host Colin Cowherd.

programme.title: First Things First
programme.desc: "First Things First" is a daily sports talk show hosted by Nick Wright, Chris Broussard and Kevin Wildes. Wright, who started his broadcasting career as a critically acclaimed radio host, is joined by longtime sports reporter and commentator Chris Broussard, and sports television producer, personality, sports radio talk show host, and podcaster Kevin Wildes, as they explore and energetically advance the biggest stories in sports.

programme.title: First Things First: OT
programme.desc: Nick Wright, Chris Broussard, Kevin Wildes and OT anchor Danny Parkins offer their opinions on the day's sports stories.
