programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Finals Starter
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.

programme.title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: London and South East - Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North East: Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: North East: Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: North East: Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Central Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Central Main and Dessert
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: North West Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Scotland Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Scotland Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: South West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: South West Mains and Dessert
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Wales Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Wales Main and Dessert
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish 'The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury Festival.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter and Fish
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main and Dessert
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland recreate their four-course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There is also a guest judge: rapper Loyle Carner.

programme.title: The Finals: Starter
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to grime. The rivals are cooking to impress Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton, and Andi Oliver.

programme.title: The Finals: Fish Course
programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: The Finals: Main Course
programme.desc: The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios. They will be cooking for the judges' food critic, Matthew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worthy of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: The Finals: Dessert
programme.desc: Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

programme.title: The Finals: Banquet
programme.desc: The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

programme.title: Scotland Fish
programme.desc: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course. Graham is in a confident mood but returning finalist Jak and self-taught Jimmy are pushing him hard. Will the pressure prove too much for ambitious Graham?

programme.title: Scotland Main
programme.desc: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Today it's the Scottish chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow, and with one chef in the lead after a triumphant main, the pressures on for the other two to plate up perfection.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, who will help decide which chef will go forward to the National Finals.

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: Three of the south-west's finest chefs, Jude Kereama, Josh Eggleton and Dominic Chapman attempt to impress a veteran judge with their starters. As the only newcomer, Jude is determined to plate up a winning dish, but he faces stiff competition.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: The three south-west chefs fight it out for the fish course. Despite schoolboy errors during the starter, experienced Dominic is determined to get a high score on the course. But will newcomer Jude, a seafood master, overcome his nerves to plate up?

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course as the three south-west chefs go head-to-head. Newcomer Jude is brimming with determination and confidence as the main course battle hits the kitchen.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: The south-west chefs have one last chance to impress as they face the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining south-west judges must cook their entire menus again for judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. Joining the judges is Radhika Bynon, a member of the Forest Gate Women's Institute, a modern urban group of women.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Stephen Gomes, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael are challenged to plate up perfect starter courses for this week's veteran judge. It's the first time in the Great British Menu kitchen for all three chefs, so who will triumph and who will fall?

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: Stephen Gomes, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael fight it out for the fish course. Experimental chef Stephen is determined to prove himself with a fish course honouring the WI's tradition of preserving, but he's up against stiff competition.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course with the Welsh chefs going head-to-head. With all three chefs paying homage to Welsh lamb; Adam with a refined dish, Phil with a dish dedicated to his Mum and Stephen with a lamb dish celebrating the WI.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It's the tricky dessert course and the last chance for the Welsh chefs to secure their place in tomorrow's regional final. With everything to play for, the pressure is fierce. Only two can make it through, and one will leave the competition for good.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Welsh chefs cook their four courses again for the judges. One chef will be chosen to represent Wales in the national finals, taking them a step closer to cooking at the banquet.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Former champion Chris is back for glory and determined to reach the banquet, but he's up against two newcomers with their sights firmly set on victory.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold are cooking their fish courses. Ambitious Ben is determined to steal Chris's regional crown, but under fierce scrutiny from this week's formidable veteran, will the pressure to deliver spell melt down?

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course for three of Northern Ireland's finest chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold. Ambitious Ben is out to prove himself with a perfect lamb main course.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and the Northern Irish chefs are all striving for one of the two spots in the Regional Final. The pressure is intense, and in the end one chef must leave the competition empty-handed.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North Irish chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - award-winning food writer Felicity Cloake.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen are going head-to-head this week for a chance to represent the North East region in the National Finals. Today it's a battle for starter course, and the first chance to impress their formidable veteran chef.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: It's the fight for the fish course, as three of the North East's finest chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - are out to impress. After his risky starter caused a stir yesterday Michael is planning another controversial dish in honour of the WI's support of women's rights.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: Three of the North East's most dynamic chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - go head-to-head cooking their main courses. Michelin-starred Tim is super keen to bag the first ten of the week, but Michael and Mini are hot on his heels.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course. It's been a week of highs and lows, modern audacious dishes and classic masterpieces but with only two places up for grabs cooking for the judges, at the end of today who will leave the competition empty-handed?

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - WI president Kirsty Bowen from Sheffield - who will help decide which chef will go through to represent the North East in the National Finals.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis. Today's the starter course, and after failing to cook for the judges last year Mark's out to redeem himself, but he faces stiff competition in executive chef Eve and young gun Matt.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis - go head-to-head. Eve and Matt are hoping their classic approach to cooking fish will win the day whilst Mark is going all out with a fishy take on a traditional dessert recipe.

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis. Mark remains determined and focused on his battle to get to judges chamber this year, but as the pressure to plate up perfection reaches fever pitch, will all three chefs get a dish to the pass?

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: It's the North West chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow. It's the end of the road for one chef, but who will it be?

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North West chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by award-winning food writer Sabrina Ghayour, and together they'll decide which chef will go on to represent the North West in the National Finals.

programme.title: London South East Starter
programme.desc: It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt Gillan is determined to make it to this year's banquet, but he faces fierce competition in the two newcomers.

programme.title: London South East Fish
programme.desc: The London and South East chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund - go head-to-head with their fish courses. Lee is hoping his modern plate of mackerel and passion fruit will outclass Matt and Mark's more traditionally inspired salmon dishes.

programme.title: London South East Main
programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt is determined to bring home a 10 with his ambitious celebration of the billy goat but has he bitten off more than he can chew?

programme.title: London South East Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and the London and South East chefs are striving to secure one of the two spots in tomorrow's Regional Final. The scores are close, so it's all to play for, as today marks the end of the competition for one man.

programme.title: London South East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by Mary Gwynn, author of the official WI centenary cookbook. Together they'll decide which chef goes through to represent the region in the National Finals.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Three of the Central Region's finest chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge with their starters. With big boots to fill, Angela Hartnett's protégé Pip is the only newcomer in the kitchen. Will she beat the boys to claim victory?

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: The three Central Region chefs - newcomer Pip Lacey, 4th time competitor Richard Bainbridge and returning chef Jason Hodnett - fight it out in the fish course. Pip is hoping to outclass her rivals with a smoked haddock dish inspired by her Grandma.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course with three Central Region chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett. Once again Jason is taking risks with his unusual collection of ingredients.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: It's the last chance for the Central Region chefs to impress, with the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges so with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central Region chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They'll be joined by former chair of the Women's Institute Helen Carey, who will help decide who will have the glory of representing the region in the National Finals.

programme.title: Finals Week: Starter
programme.desc: It's the starter course, and eight of the finest chefs in the country are battling it out to plate up impeccable dishes worthy of the Women's Institute. The judges are joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, but after Oliver reveals that this year it will be much tougher to make it onto the judge's shortlist, who will keep their cool and secure a place?

programme.title: Finals Week: Fish
programme.desc: It's the battle for the fish course. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist with their starters are hoping to do better. The judges are joined by Kristy Bowen, who knows the impeccable standards the WI will expect.

programme.title: Finals Week: Main
programme.desc: It's main course day, the half-way point in Finals Week, and those chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat. With only dishes judged to be perfect in with a chance at reaching the WI banquet, the standards are higher than ever before.

programme.title: Finals Week: Dessert
programme.desc: It's the last chance for the eight regional champions to get a dish in contention for the final banquet. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist are going all out. The judges are joined by Mary Gwynn, the author of the WI centenary cookbook.

programme.title: Finals Week: Banquet
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. It's the culmination of months of hard work as the winning chefs strive to plate up perfect dishes for the Women's Institute ladies at London's historic Draper's Hall.

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UK's best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.

programme.title: Melissa Huckaby

programme.title: Drunkest Arrests

programme.title: Sex Lies and Video Tape

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: In Independence, MO a deeply religious couple's marriage runs into trouble. When they seek spiritual counseling things go from bad to worse and one of them indulges in an affair which leads to murder.

programme.title: Terror and Fear
programme.desc: A former pizza parlor manager gets more than annoyed when his festive bonus payment is less than he is expecting. Mitchell Sims decides that armed robbery is a quicker way to get money, and unleashes a reign of terror in South Carolina.

programme.title: Dose of Evil
programme.desc: In La Jolla, CA, investigators discover an unsettling site - a body surrounded by rose petals. Kristin Rossum says her husband Greg, a business manager, had been feeling unwell throughout the day before he mysteriously stopped breathing.

programme.title: Message from the Grave
programme.desc: In Flint, MI, Chuck Miller arrives at his brother's salvage yard and discovers a body. At first it looks like a robbery gone bad but as homicide investigators delve deep they uncover a steamy affair involving an ex-cop.

programme.title: Road Rage Violence
programme.desc: Daytona Beach, Fla., officers pursue a vehicle; Toledo, Ohio, officers respond to a violent road rage incident.

programme.title: Convenience Store Convict
programme.desc: After hours of surveillance the Bounty Hunters track down a female fugitive at a convenience store wanted for skipping bail. The Bounty Hunters attempt to capture a fugitive known for being violent and carrying weapons.

programme.title: Resisting Arrest
programme.desc: After only two hours the Bounty Hunters track and arrest a fugitive with a failure to appear on a felony drug conviction. This arrest involves a car chase to capture a female fugitive wanted on felony counts of forgery and receiving stolen property.

programme.title: A Deadly Disappearance
programme.desc: Susan McFarland vanishes in 2002. Her husband, Richard, and Rick Clemmer are linked to her abandoned car, a bloody SUV, and her death.

programme.title: Clare Wood
programme.desc: In April 2007, lonely Clare Wood met 40-year-old fairground worker George Appleton online. Initially, it seemed perfect, he appeared reliable and caring. However, her father and brother were wary of him, leading to friction in their relationship.

programme.title: The Perverted Preacher
programme.desc: A Mobile preacher, killed his wife for discovering his abuse of her daughter. The truth emerges when the girl, pregnant with his child, reveals all.

programme.title: James Fairweather
programme.desc: 2014. James Fairweather is no ordinary teenager. Unlike his peers, he immersed himself in dark, violent games and websites after school. With no friends, the internet became his escape. His parents hoped he'd be fine, but the signs were troubling.

programme.title: Murder of Moriah Wilson
programme.desc: Brian Ziessler claimed an unknown gunman killed his wife of 30 years. But after reviewing security footage, detectives uncovered a shocking truth: the loving grandmother's killer was someone much closer to home.

programme.title: Grandma Shoots

programme.title: Stolen UTV

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Love's Christmas Journey Part 2
programme.desc: Viuda recientemente, Ellie visita a su hermano Aaron durante Navidad. Pero las festividades son amenazadas cuando Aaron desaparece.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: How will flatmates Mercedes and Jason decide between exotic Catahoula pups Brynn and Bristol? And is Vada, a cattle-bull mastiff cross, the right dog for Correan and her adorable son Rocco?

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn calf. There's a 'cuteness overload' when Julian meets Finlay and his beloved hamster, Christopher Nibbles. Bella, the much-loved rescue sausage dog, needs life-saving surgery. Can Peter save her? Julian visits an old friend, Dobby the lama - but Dobby may not be so pleased to see him. Peter pops in on elderly colourful farmers the Greens.

programme.title: Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off to the zoo.We take a hidden camera into the den of red pandas, and then see them take their first steps. Baby bears enthrall us with their playful behavior, and baby baboons enjoy time in the water.

programme.title: Desert Babies
programme.desc: Today we visit some of the deserts and dry areas of the world. Coyote pups, meerkats, and baby bison are some of the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: It's a landmark day at the hospital in Huddersfield, as Shona and the team use a new electro chemotherapy treatment on a pet pygmy goat's cancerous tumour. Peter heads into surgery with an elderly Lhasa apso who's been suffering with a painful eye problem.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright work together to try to save a working sheepdog. They are also both needed at a local farm, where a cow is in agony.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his 3 legs. Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb. Elsewhere, Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm to solve a problem.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes to a dramatic emergency at Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm, where a new mum desperately needs his help. But rural North Yorkshire isn't always the ideal place to drive when time is of the essence, and Julian gets stuck behind not one, but two tractors.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter gets an emergency call from Ivor Shaw. He's found one of his calves limping, and Peter suspects her little leg is broken. Julian is overwhelmed when 18 rats are brought onto the practice. A blind sheep and a stray dog are treated.

programme.title: More Winter Babies
programme.desc: We spend time chilling out with babies in the cold of winter. Shorter days and snow mean that the babies need their winter coats.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb that was born with a life-threatening cyst full of spinal fluid on its head, which will require delicate and painstaking surgery to safely remove. Julian is called out in the middle of the night to save a cow that has experienced dangerous complications while giving birth, a pig is resistant to being castrated, and a dog swallows a bottle of e-cigarette liquid.

programme.title: Spring Babies
programme.desc: The changing of seasons means changes for Earth's creatures. Spring is one of the greatest changes from the cool of winter to the blooming of the land. We spend time with the youngsters born at this time of the year. Red deer, reindeer, goats and baby lynx are among those featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian is called to see cattle farmer Richard's cow, a young mum, who has a badly infected foot. Her condition is so bad that Julian may have to take drastic action... Will he be able to get mum back on her feet and reunited with her baby?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Wendy the wallaby is struggling but can Peter to save her? Julian performs urgent surgery to save Griff the terrier. Peter's battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn twin lambs. Julian pregnancy tests a pedigree herd which reveals Lawrence the bull might have a problem. An eye-watering test should reveal the truth.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: A 15-year old farmer's favourite calf is struggling with a suspected hernia. And, as Matt investigates Maggie's condition, all might not be as expected. Julian heads into theatre to remove one of the largest lumps his team have ever seen on a dog.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hunky Tom Rigby meets his match in Keira the kelpie. And will this be it for serial dater Lily the pug when she meets human Lily and her family in the meeting pen?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's birthing season on Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm. And after Julian turns up just in time to see one baby born, it's the cria who arrived yesterday that needs his help. Kestrel has deformed legs and he's struggling to walk, let alone run.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright must battle a blizzard to reach a patient on a remote farm. Cynthia the pigmy goat is cute and loveable but has a problem. In an out-of-hours emergency, poorly cat Emily is unsteady on her paws, while Digz the dog is lucky to be alive after a hit-and-run. Peter is also called out to assist graduate vet Katie with an emergency caesarean.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: There's a royal appointment at Cannon Hall Farm as Matt helps a goat with a broken leg in front of a high-profile onlooker - Her Royal Highness Princess Anne. Julian treats a tiny tortoise and has to check if Nigel's cows are pregnant.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian faces the tricky task of castrating a group of alpacas whose owner has been using holistic techniques to pacify them. Peter treats a Yorkshire Terrier and the team try to save a stray cat whose leg has been snapped in two.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 9

We follow the recovery of Snoopy, a young dog found collapsed on the edge of a road. The lurcher was just skin and bones when she was spotted. In Shropshire, inspector Kate Parker comes to the aid of Rocko, a tiny puppy living in unsuitable conditions.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Farmer Rob rushes into the Grace Lane practice with a struggling pregnant ewe belonging to his son, William. Julian and Anne deal with a lump on an alpaca's lip. Shona and Martin remove a tumour from a Springer Spaniel's rib-cage.

programme.desc: In North Yorkshire Inspector Clare Wilson responds to a call from a member of the public reporting a house full of dogs, apparently in need of help. When she arrives she finds 5 Yorkshire terriers all living in one room, and one needs her urgent attention.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton, Peter Wright and their staff deal with more animal emergencies. This episode includes a dog facing an emergency operation to remove a tumour and a prolapsing sheep that has to be treated on the car park.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter's under extra pressure when he heads out to see Charlie the horse - he belongs to his niece Jess. She's always loved horses and rides them competitively, so Charlie needs his wolf teeth removing so they don't interfere with the bit.

programme.title: Farm Babies
programme.desc: We are visiting the farm to meet up with the baby animals, piglets, chicks, lambs and calves keep us entertained.

programme.title: More Spring Babies
programme.desc: Coyote pups enjoy a romp, baby fox cubs spend time attacking mum's tail, and beavers have fun in the water.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm where Bernie the boar is strangely off his food. Peter's worried that the problem could be serious, but examining a big boar who's not feeling well isn't easy.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter's called out to a cow with stomach problems, he calls in reinforcements from his new Grace Lane Practice. Julian has a surprise examining a pregnant dog. A frisky Shetland Pony and a lizard with a dead tail end are also treated.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Are happy new couple Tim and Fiona the right fit for the 'cloud on legs' Frosty? She's a plucky Pomeranian but, at 11, isn't getting any younger. And will kelpie Schnitzel find love this time around?

programme.desc: Julian dashes to an emergency - Vet Matt needs an experienced pair of hands. A young heifer, Bonnie, is struggling to give birth naturally. Peter sees old pal Benji the bouncy border terrier who has been vomiting and is in grave danger.

programme.desc: In this episode, Peter is mystified by the contents of Khufu the cat's stomach after his owner is concerned that he has totally lost his appetite. Peter performs surgery on the cat but when he opens its stomach, he gets the shock of his life!

The group face their toughest challenge of their year so far.

programme.title: Snow Babies

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: The second of this 2 part special follows Inspector Lyndsey Taylor who last episode rescued four dogs from squalid conditions.

programme.title: Episode 10

programme.title: Episode 3

programme.title: Episode 7

programme.desc: Julian is called out to a calf with a large lump, while other patients include a pair of pygmy goats, a farm full of feral cats and Fern, a sick spaniel. The staff also find time to spring a birthday surprise on Peter Wright.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter has an emergency at the practice in Kirkbymoorside, when a local farming couple rush in their pregnant Texel ewe. Julian operates on a terrier suffering with bladder stones. Peter visits the Green's farm to see a lonely donkey.

programme.desc: Collette and her son Cailean are fanatical ferret fanciers and have 39 at their home! But their prize-winning, champion ferret favourite, Teddy, has a problem. They've spotted a lump and Collette fears the worst. Can Peter save Teddy?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Amrita is willing to give a troubled soul a home but gets more trouble than she bargained for with Jack Russell cross Oreo in the meeting pen.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian heads to the historic Harewood House near Leeds to check on some goats who are moving to a new enclosure. But catching them isn't going to be easy. In fact, it proves quite painful!

programme.desc: The largest abscess Julian's ever seen is on a bull's backside - a waterfall of pus is coming! Peter meets Thor the giant rabbit as well as North Yorkshire's best dressed dog. And, just a few hours old, a lamb is rushed into surgery.

programme.desc: Today we are in the wilds of Australia exploring the outback, the bush and even its beaches. Among the babies we see kangaroo joeys, platypuses and koalas.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian must treat a pregnant heifer with a pelvis that may be too small to give birth, while a cat that lost a leg after being run over by a car suffers another injury in a road accident, but this time, no treatment may be possible.

programme.desc: Can big goofball Wolfie the Wolfhound win over a pair of terrified tots? Meanwhile, the tables are turned when vivacious Chez meets timid Mini Foxie Olive. Finally, will lovable Lab Chai be Laurel and Darrell's perfect pooch?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Greyhound Alinta needs to turn her life around after a hard start as a racing dog; Louise and her son Jack need a playful soul to fill their lives with joy. Will Bear, the cattle cross, be the one?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian and Peter must both operate on dogs with tumours. Other patients include hens with an eye infection, a cow having a caesarean, and three surprisingly speedy tortoises.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian sets up a blood bank for baby alpacas, but collecting donations is harder than expected. Peter is woken at 2am by an emergency call-out for a pregnant cow, and must be at his sharpest to deliver the calf safely. A sheepdog undergoes treatment to remove a tumour, a cat is in need of castration, and Katie visits a bad-tempered pig with very sore eyes.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Mangalitsa pig breeder Lisa is worried about her boar Hal, who has a large lump on his neck. A famous client brings their dog to the practice. Matt is in uncharted waters as he heads to a local college to operate on one of their fish.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter comes to the aid of a cow that has suffered a prolapsed uterus. He also meets elderly cat Sawsa, while Julian helps farmer Chris artificially inseminate his pigs. Plus, owner Betty is concerned when her beloved lhasa apso Billy develops a lump on his tummy and a persistent eye infection.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: An old friend of Peter heads down to the practice with a sheep who had one lamb last night, but is struggling to give birth to her second. Although neither vet nor farmer are feeling optimistic for the unborn lamb's chances.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Two babies' lives hang in the balance. Peter rushes into Skeldale on his day off to try and save Richard Bell's lamb, who was badly injured when he was born just a few hours ago. And at Suzanne Benson's trekking centre, Julian's treating a very poorly one-week old llama called Noah.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When the RSPCA receives a report that a couple who are banned from keeping animals have got new dogs, Inspector Clare Wilson is quick to act. But, when she arrives at the property, it looks like the job is going to be slightly bigger than first anticipated...

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian and Peter have to cope with two night-time emergency call outs. New vet Esme performs her first emergency caesarean and a pack of bloodhound pups cause mayhem in the surgery.

programme.title: Episode 2

programme.title: Newport Cwmcarn
programme.desc: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

programme.title: Horsham
programme.desc: The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson are on a mission to create a family garden in Horsham in Sussex for James, Charlotte and their young daughter Esmé. The trouble is, at the moment, their garden is about as exciting as a blank sheet of A4 paper.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

programme.title: Leyton
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Cadeby and Sussex
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Wakefield and Swindon
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens

programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano acompañan a Lupita al mandado lo que no es una buena decisión porque tienen que enfrentarse al güero, mientras que doña Cuca y Nacho se quedan solos en casa.

programme.title: Ya bailaron (zócalo)
programme.desc: Albertano se sube al metro a cantar para pedir dinero, se encuentra con el Vítor vendiendo discos piratas y se enoja con él porque quiere quitarle la clientela. Un policía les ordena a Albertano y al Vítor que se bajen.

programme.title: Academia de policía
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano impiden un robo en la colonia, deciden cumplir una labor muy importante y se enlistan en la academia de policía, pero la autoridad no está lista para recibir a este par tan peculiar.

programme.title: Vecinos ruidosos
programme.desc: A Lorena le incomodan los ruidos que hacen los recién casados, Silvita y Luis. Germán se encargará de arreglar la tubería tapada del departamento de Lorena.

programme.title: Frankie regresa
programme.desc: Frankie regresa a vivir al edificio, con Lorena y con Benito, pero con la condición de que encuentre trabajo. Pero, en vez de eso, escribirá una nueva película.

programme.title: La llegada de Vanessa
programme.desc: Vanessa regresa y los vecinos deben ponerla al día sobre todo lo que ha ocurrido. Benito aprovecha que sus padres no están e invita a su novia Liz a ver una película en su casa.

programme.title: La cocina de Silvita
programme.desc: Como Luis le ha preparado el desayuno, Silvita se encargará de prepararle a su esposo un platillo espectacular.

programme.title: El hojalatero
programme.desc: Al vecindario llega un mecánico, quien pondrá su taller en la calle justo afuera del edificio. Cris motivará a Pedro para que limpie el departamento por primera vez.

programme.title: El súper episodio del súper
programme.desc: La familia Peluche va al supermercado y luchan por un lugar de estacionamiento. Federica se pone celosa de que Ludovico habla gustosamente con la señorita de la carnicería.

programme.title: Juego de roles
programme.desc: Federica intenta seducir a Ludovico, pero él no se da cuenta y ella llora porque perdieron la llama de la pasión. Ludovico y Federica buscan como reavivar su matrimonio y hacen un juego de cambio de personalidad.

programme.title: Valle del Nabo
programme.desc: El novio de Bibi, Manuel, la invita a Valle del Nabo a pasar el fin de semana. La familia de Bibi los alcanza en casa de Manuel. Manuel termina con Bibi por ser amargada y rara.

programme.title: Día de las Madres
programme.desc: La familia P. Luche festeja el Día de las Madres de una manera muy particular. Ludovico intenta componer el baño, pero un plomero muy guapo lo ayudará.

programme.title: Reparaciones
programme.desc: Federica contrata un carpintero guapísimo para arreglar una puerta. Ludovico se pone muy celoso de Sebastián, el carpintero, y quiere demostrar que él puede hacer las cosas mejor. Ludovico hace un desastre en su casa.

programme.title: El cumpleaños atrasado de Ludovico
programme.desc: Federica tiene un plan para hacer que Ludovico la lleve a comer a un nuevo restaurante. La familia Peluche conoce a Eduardo Santamarina. Todo sale muy mal en la cena.

programme.title: Patadas de ahogada
programme.desc: Es el cumpleaños de Albertano y doña Lucha le organiza una fiesta, María se pinta el cabello y se pone su más lindo vestido para recuperar a Albertano, le dedica canciones compuestas por ella y le recita un poema. Doña Lucha se siente mal.

programme.title: Angeloterapeuta
programme.desc: Albertano le pide tiempo a María para pensar en el futuro de su relación y ella va con un brujo para pedirle ayuda. Doña Lucha intenta hablar con el chino sobre sexualidad, por lo que van a la fonda de Don Carmelo, donde ella termina ebria.

programme.title: Sexy calendario
programme.desc: A Doña Lucha se le ocurre hacer un calendario sexy con todas sus vecinas, pero no se vende como ella esperaba. María se pone colágeno en los labios para conquistar a Albertano.

programme.title: Se busca
programme.desc: El Chino consigue trabajo probando videojuegos y provoca que Albertano busque el empleo de sus sueños. María decide buscar novio por internet y, durante una de sus citas a ciegas, el chico la cambia por Betsabé.

programme.title: Celos por catálogo
programme.desc: María busca darle celos a Albertano y busca un hombre guapo en un catálogo. Al verlos, Albertano se muere de celos y le confiesa al Chino que la quiere y le duele verla con alguien más.

programme.title: La boda Imposible
programme.desc: Albertano le confiesa a Lucha que está enamorado de María y quiere casarse con ella. María debe decidir si quedarse con Albertano o iniciar una vida al lado de un nuevo amor.

programme.title: El novio
programme.desc: Lichita lleva semanas sin hablarle a la Nena porque tiene novio y le exige que termine su relación. Renata propone que hagan una comida para que puedan conocer al novio de la Nena.

programme.title: Prueba de embarazo
programme.desc: Nena averigua que ella está embarazada.

programme.title: Votación
programme.desc: Adolfo se niega a ayudar con la manutención del hogar de la familia López y se lleva a La Nena a vivir a una comuna. La familia al extrañar a La Nena propone un acuerdo.

programme.title: La nueva dueña
programme.desc: Los López se preocupan porque la nueva dueña del edificio correrá a las familias que excedan de cuatro integrantes. Plácido le explica el porqué son 10.

programme.title: Mala suerte
programme.desc: La dueña del edificio comunica a los López que subirá la renta, pero Plácido por andar apostando, no tiene dinero para pagar. Los López consiguen dinero como pueden.

programme.title: Limitados
programme.desc: Plácido implementa un plan de austeridad en su casa para ahorrar, pero todo lo juega en sorteos. De pronto se entera de que se ganó un automóvil, pero no tiene teléfono para hacer la llamada y reclamarlo.

programme.title: Entre abogados te veas
programme.desc: Miranda demanda a Paco por el tiempo perdido en su noviazgo. Unos peculiares abogados tratan de llegar a un acuerdo.

programme.desc: Toña se encuentra indecisa porque no sabe si casarse con Brayan o Pascual. Una vez que se decide, celebra su despedida de soltera.

programme.title: La boda de Toña
programme.desc: Llega la boda entre Toña y Brayan tras los excesos de las despedidas de solteros.

programme.title: Clavado en La Quebrada
programme.desc: Toña se va de fiesta a Acapulco para olvidar a Brayan. Él quiere recuperarla, pero, para volver con ella, tendrá que saltar de La Quebrada.

programme.title: Y volver volver
programme.desc: Brayan se avienta de La Quebrada para obtener el perdón de Toña, pero todo se complica cuando Irmita visita a un Brayan convaleciente.

programme.desc: A los héroes no se les hace fácil comenzar una nueva vida, mientras que estrellas del mundo grupero graban un disco en su homenaje. A Zacarías, ya convertido en solista, se le suben los humos.

programme.desc: Ludovico le enseña a manejar a Bibi. Federica quiere deshacerse de Maradonio. Bibi choca el carro de Ludovico y la meten en la cárcel.

programme.title: El funeral del Merengues
programme.desc: En el velorio de Merengueti, Ludovico se da cuenta de que el muerto tiene el reloj que perdió en la mañana e intenta quitárselo.

programme.title: Federica ardiente
programme.desc: Federica se encuentra con Arsenio, un antiguo novio millonario. Federica de pronto empieza a tener mucho dinero. Ludovico está destrozado por el engaño de Federica.

programme.title: La boda de Régulo
programme.desc: Régulo hace todo lo posible por no invitar a Ludovico, por su fama, pero los chismosos de la oficina lo echan de cabeza.

programme.title: El loco corte de pelo
programme.desc: Con la reunión de exalumnos de Federica a la vuelta de la esquina, ella se siente algo insegura por su apariencia. Entonces decide hacerse un arriesgado cambio de look.

programme.title: El genio bursátil
programme.desc: Ludovico se mete en problemas en el trabajo cuando trata de ayudar a Don Camerino en asuntos financieros. Tratando de resolver el desorden, Ludovico complica todo aún más, pero Junior lo ayudará a salir del problema.

programme.title: La Navidad perfecta
programme.desc: Ludovico sufre un infarto y muere. Santa Ninel le pide cambiar su forma de ser para antes de Navidad si no quiere morir. Ludovico hace todo por cambiar con su familia.

programme.title: Recuerdos
programme.desc: Ludovico habla de su familia: cuando conoció a Federica, cuando se enteró de que iba a ser padre y de otros graciosos momentos que han marcado su vida.

programme.title: Las cosas de don Roque
programme.desc: Germán le entrega a Vanessa cosas que le dejó don Roque, por lo que ambos lo recuerdan y homenajean. Lorena aprecia a Soledad, la nueva amiga de Benito.

programme.title: El tamalero
programme.desc: Como el tamalero no deja dormir a Luis, este le pide que le baje a su bocina. Luis se consigue varios enemigos por dejar sin trabajo al tamalero. Ale se niega a ser una señora, por lo que pensará en hacerse un cambio de look.

programme.title: Los paramédicos
programme.desc: Por pedirle a Morris que ponga en su tarea que son paramédicos, Rocko y Ale deben ir a la escuela a dar un curso de primeros auxilios. Llegan nuevos vecinos al departamento 301.

programme.title: La tanda
programme.desc: Como Lorena no incluyó a Magda en su ahorro colectivo, ella hará una propia. ¿Podrá convencer a los vecinos de entrar a su ahorro y abandonar la de su vecina? Germán no atiende la puerta del edificio como los vecinos se lo han pedido.

programme.title: Los ex
programme.desc: Luis le pide a Silvita que deje de hablar con su ex, pues se siente incómodo, sin sospechar que Maru, ex de Luis, llegará a la puerta de su casa. Además, la obra de arte de Jorjais.

programme.title: El cumpleaños de Germán
programme.desc: Todos se olvidan del cumpleaños de Germán, a pesar de estar invitados a la fiesta. Lorena y Frankie le dicen a Benito que volverá a los castings.

programme.title: Orígenes
programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: La casa del millón
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: El regreso
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Los muebles
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: La venta del edificio
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: El sueño angélico
programme.desc: María de Todos los Ángeles es una mujer que siente que se está haciendo vieja sin haber encontrado el amor de su vida. Ella tiene un sueño en el que los ángeles anuncian que pronto el amor de su vida va a llegar.

programme.title: El perro de los focos
programme.desc: María decide provocar un encuentro con Albertano para verlo directamente a los ojos y descubrir si es el amor de su vida. La vida de Albertano corre peligro y María se arriesga para salvarlo.

programme.desc: Carmelo queda encerrado probando la alarma del negocio. María sueña que debe ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para conquistar a Albertano, y para eso prepara unos deliciosos chiles, aunque esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.

programme.desc: La euforia por el feng shui y por limpiar desata un conflicto entre familias. Doña Lucha y María intentan controlar a todos con el feng shui, y organizan un concurso.

programme.desc: En su búsqueda por trabajo, Albertano es contratado por María de todos los Ángeles, pero sucede una tragedia que Rosa Aurora tendrá que arreglar.

programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano están muy preocupados porque Don Nacho está desaparecido y comienzan una investigación para dar con el paradero del quinto inquilino de la casa.

programme.desc: Paco cree que Miranda lo irá a buscar para pedirle perdón por su infidelidad en Acapulco, pero ella le confiesa que está embarazada.

programme.desc: Penn State defeated Utah 35-21 in the 2023 Rose Bowl, pulling away in the second half with two explosive touchdowns of over 80 yards. programme.title: Rutila juega con fuego
programme.desc: Aurelio le reclama a Rutila su relación con Omar y le ordena que se aleje del presidente para evitar problemas.

programme.title: Nazareno acorralado
programme.desc: Aurelio encierra a su hijo Nazareno para que le dé el riñón. Casillas le dice a Amalia que le haga entender a su hijo que le tiene que dar el riñón por las buenas o por las malas.

programme.title: Aurelio rescata a Luzma
programme.desc: Aurelio salva a Luzma. Casillas sufre al ver que su hija casi muere por meterse las drogas que él mismo produce.

programme.title: Casillas aleja a Luzma
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Luzma que es un estorbo en su vida. Casillas le hace sentir a su hija que no la quiere, para que acepte irse con Mónica para su tratamiento.

programme.title: Listo para la cirugía
programme.desc: Aurelio se prepara para entrar a la cirugía. Casillas le pide a Rutila que se encargue de todo mientras lo operan.

programme.title: Nuevo peligro para Aurelio
programme.desc: La operación de Aurelio Casillas es un éxito. La Felina intenta infiltrarse en el hospital para eliminarlo. Hay problemas en el panel de invitados del embajador de Venezuela.

programme.title: Víctor celoso de Aurelio
programme.desc: Víctor piensa que Mónica sigue interesada en Aurelio. Los celos del hijo de Chacorta lo llevan a dudar del amor de Robles.

programme.title: La cabeza del embajador
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Esperanza que va a matar al embajador. Casillas está dudando de su amante y sospecha que lo quiere traicionar.

programme.title: Tras la felina
programme.desc: Aurelio y Rutila descubren que la Felina eliminó a Norma. Los Casillas ordenan que busquen a la Felina y la eliminen.

programme.title: Mónica se alía con la Felina
programme.desc: Mónica busca a la Felina para lavar el dinero de Víctor. Robles se la va a jugar toda para negociar con la colombiana.

programme.title: Dalvio desenmascarado
programme.desc: Ismael le dice a Aurelio que Salvio es el Ingeniero. Casillas se sorprende al saber que el novio de la Tata es uno de sus enemigos.

programme.title: Mónica sospecha de La Felina
programme.desc: Mónica presiente que la Felina la quiere traicionar. Robles sospecha que la colombiana le quiere poner una trampa.

programme.title: Ataque en marcha
programme.desc: Aurelio prepara a sus hombres para atacar al Ingeniero. Casillas teme que su enemigo le haga daño a su hijo y a la Tata.

programme.title: La Tata defiende a su novio
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a la Tata que su novio es su enemigo. La madre de Ismael se niega a creer que Dalvio es un narco.

programme.title: La Tata enfrenta al Ingeniero
programme.desc: La Tata enfrenta al Ingeniero por mentirle. La madre de Ismael le dice a Dalvio que su hijo es de Aurelio Casillas.

programme.title: Víctor se siente traicionado
programme.desc: Víctor pelea con Mónica por sus celos; cree que ella continúa enamorada de su tío, Aurelio Casillas. La Tata llama a Aurelio para aclararle su situación con el Ingeniero.

programme.title: Pedido especial de Mónica
programme.desc: Mónica Robles llama a Aurelio Casillas y le hace un pedido muy especial antes de salir al encuentro de la Felina.

programme.title: Contra los colombianos
programme.desc: Víctor y Mónica se enfrentan a los colombianos. Rivero se comunica con Esperanza para interrogarla sobre su relación con el general Carreño.

programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas y Víctor se enfrentan por Mónica; Aurelio está preocupado por la seguridad de Mónica y su hijo.

programme.desc: Mónica y Aurelio se hacen una importante confesión. Feyo llega de sorpresa al bar de la Tata para averiguar qué es lo que se trae entre manos el Ingeniero.

programme.desc: Chacortica anuncia que compró una hacienda para vivir con su mujer, Mónica, y con los niños que van a adoptar.

programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas sufre al saber que la mujer que ama, Mónica Robles, se irá con su sobrino. Las maras poco a poco recuperan el territorio de Víctor.

programme.desc: Aurelio amenaza a Víctor para que siga sus órdenes. Chacortica le dice a Casillas que a él nadie lo manda y que sus negocios son cosa suya.

programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Ismael que va a ser su mano derecha. Casillas quiere que su hijo sea su sombra en sus negocios.

programme.desc: Chacorta, ansioso por conocer la respuesta de Mónica, espera a ver su reacción ante la sorpresa. Omar sigue con el plan de Rutila.

programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Víctor que debe controlar a las maras. Chacortica le asegura a su tío que no hay bronca con los Salvatruchas.

programme.desc: Aurelio le ordena al presidente armar la guerra. Casillas le deja claro a Omar que debe atacar a los colombianos.

programme.desc: Aurelio sentencia a muerte a Eva Ernestina. Casillas no le perdona a Gallardo ensuciar a su hija con el presidente.

programme.desc: El narco está en la mira de Aurelio Casillas por haber contado todo a las autoridades. Emiliana Contreras logra sacar a su padre de la cárcel.

programme.title: El turno de Garnica
programme.desc: Aurelio amenaza de muerte al general Garnica. Casillas le quiere cobrar al militar la violación de su hija Rutila.

programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas le cobra al general Garnica la humillación por la que tuvo que pasar su hija Rutila.
